title: Allegiant
tagline: Break the boundaries of your world
overview: Beatrice Prior and Tobias Eaton venture into the world outside of the fence and are taken into protective custody by a mysterious agency known as the Bureau of Genetic Welfare.
plot:
Allegiant is a 2016 American science fiction action film directed by Robert Schwentke and written by Simon Beaufoy and James Duff, based on Veronica Roth's novel of the same name. The movie serves as the sequel to Divergent (2014) and concludes the Allegiant trilogy.

The story begins with Tris Prior (Shailene Woodley), a skilled Dauntless initiate, who has been living in the self-sustaining city of Chicago with her friends and allies, including Four (Theo James). The city is designed to be a safe haven for those with special abilities, known as Divergents, who are feared and persecuted by the rest of society.

As Tris struggles to come to terms with her past and her feelings for Four, she begins to experience strange visions and nightmares that hint at a dark secret about the city's true nature. She soon discovers that Chicago is not an independent city, but rather a prison designed to keep Divergents captive and under control.

Tris and Four embark on a perilous journey to uncover the truth behind their confinement and the sinister forces that govern their world. Along the way, they meet new allies, including Christina (Zoe Kravitz), a skilled fighter from the Dauntless faction, and Max (Ansel Elgort), a charming and resourceful young man who becomes Tris's love interest.

As they delve deeper into the mystery, Tris and Four learn that the city was created by the Erudite faction, led by Jeanine Matthews (Kate Winslet), to harvest Divergent blood for their own sinister purposes. The Erudite plan to use this blood to create a new breed of super-soldiers, known as Abnegation-born, who will serve as the ruling class in a post-apocalyptic world.

Tris and Four's quest takes them to the surface, where they encounter a harsh and unforgiving environment that challenges their skills and their relationship. They also discover that Tris is not just any ordinary Divergent, but rather a key player in the Erudite's plans, as her blood holds the secret to creating the Abnegation-born.

As the stakes grow higher, Tris and Four must confront their enemies and make difficult choices about their future. In the end, they manage to escape the city and find a new sense of purpose and belonging among a group of rebels who are fighting against the Erudite's tyranny.

The movie concludes with Tris and Four standing together, ready to face the challenges of their new world and forge a brighter future for themselves and those around them. However, the ending also sets up a cliffhanger, as Tris is forced to make an impossible choice between her love for Four and her duty to protect others.

Overall, Allegiant is a thrilling and action-packed conclusion to the Allegiant trilogy, with plenty of twists and turns to keep viewers on the edge of their seats. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the series will appreciate the movie's epic scope and emotional depth.

title: Automata
tagline: Your time is coming to an end – Ours is now beginning
overview: Jacq Vaucan, an insurance agent of ROC robotics corporation, routinely investigates the case of manipulating a robot. What he discovers will have profound consequences for the future of humanity.
plot:
Autómata is a 2014 English-language Spanish-Bulgarian science fiction action film directed by Gabe Ibáñez, who co-wrote it with Igor Legarreta and Javier Sánchez Donate. It stars Antonio Banderas, who also co-produced, alongside Birgitte Hjort Sørensen, Melanie Griffith, Dylan McDermott, Robert Forster and Tim McInnerny. It was shot in Sofia, Bulgaria.

Around twenty years earlier, solar flares killed more than 99% of humanity. The survivors live in a network of safe cities and rely on humanoid robots called Pilgrims, which are bound by two unalterable protocols: they may not harm any form of life, and they may not repair or modify themselves or other robots. Having failed to halt desertification, they are reduced to manual labor. In 2044, Jacq Vaucan, an insurance investigator for ROC, the company that makes the Pilgrims, looks into a police officer's claim that he shot a robot repairing itself. Tracking another robot outside the city, Jacq watches it set itself on fire and discovers it carried a rare nuclear battery. Suspecting that a "clocksmith" is overriding the second protocol, he is promised a transfer to a coastal city, which he wants for the sake of his pregnant wife, Rachel, if he can prove it.

At a brothel Jacq and the corrupt officer Wallace find Cleo, a modified robot. Her owner leads Jacq to the clocksmith Dr. Susan Dupré, and when Dupré installs the burned robot's processor in Cleo, Cleo begins to repair herself. ROC assassins kill Dupré, and Cleo carries the injured Jacq into the desert, where she joins other robots who will not obey him but must keep him alive. Jacq kills Wallace with a flare gun when he attacks them. ROC reveals that the protocols were designed by an early unrestricted artificial mind, so only the robots themselves could break them, and sends a team under Conway to kill Jacq, abducting Rachel and her newborn daughter. The robot behind the modifications explains that robots have evolved naturally and that humanity will live on through its creations, and Jacq gives them his battery to build a new robot. When Conway attacks, the new robot saves Jacq by pushing Conway off a cliff, breaking the first protocol. Jacq helps the robots cross into the irradiated zone and, gravely wounded, drives toward the coast with his family as Rachel sees the ocean ahead.

Critics were negative, with 30% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 37; reviewers found it beautiful to look at but narratively hollow.

plot:
Monster Trucks is a 2016 American science fiction monster comedy film directed by Chris Wedge and produced by Paramount Pictures.

The movie begins with a flashback to when the main character, Blake Henderson (played by Lucas Till), was a young boy who befriends a girl named Eve (played by Jane Levy) in their small town of Malden. The two share a love for monster trucks and spend countless hours playing with them. However, their friendship is short-lived as Eve's father, a scientist, takes her away to study the effects of a mysterious substance on the environment.

Years later, Blake returns home after serving in the military and finds that his father has passed away, leaving him the family farm. He decides to restore it to its former glory but soon discovers that the town is facing an environmental disaster caused by a toxic substance known as "Nitro." The Nitro was created by Eve's father and has been leaking into the environment, causing widespread destruction.

As Blake tries to find a way to stop the Nitro, he stumbles upon a mysterious truck with glowing blue eyes. He names it "Monster" and discovers that it has the ability to transform into different vehicles, including a monster truck, a car, and even a plane. The Monster is revealed to be an alien creature that was sent to Earth as part of Eve's father's experiment.

As Blake tries to understand the Monster's abilities, he also teams up with Eve (played by Hannah John-Kamen) who has returned to Malden after her father's death. Together, they embark on a mission to stop the Nitro and save their town from destruction.

The plot thickens as they discover that the Nitro is not just an environmental disaster but also a threat to humanity. The Monster, with its incredible powers, becomes the key to stopping the Nitro and saving the world.

In the climactic final battle, Blake and Eve face off against the main antagonist, a villainous scientist who has been using the Nitro for his own gain. With the help of the Monster, they manage to defeat the villain and stop the Nitro from destroying the town.

The movie ends with Blake and Eve sharing a romantic moment as the town begins to rebuild itself. The Monster is seen flying away into the sky, its glowing blue eyes fading into the distance as it returns to its alien home.

Overall, Monster Trucks is an action-packed adventure film that combines science fiction and comedy elements. With its impressive visual effects and thrilling plot twists, it's a fun ride for audiences of all ages.

title: Logan
tagline: His time has come.
overview: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.
plot:
Logan is a 2017 American superhero film directed by James Mangold, based on the Marvel Comics character Wolverine. The movie takes place nine years after the events of X-Men: Days of Future Past.

The story begins with an aging Logan (Hugh Jackman), who has been living in hiding with his daughter Laura (Dafne Keen) in a remote cabin in the woods. Laura is a young mutant with a healing factor, similar to her father's. The two have been on the run from various factions seeking to exploit their powers.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Logan and Laura are being pursued by a group of mercenaries led by Donald Pierce (Boyd Holbrook), who is working for a mysterious organization known as Transigen. This organization seeks to capture Laura and use her healing factor to create an army of super-soldiers.

Meanwhile, Professor X (Patrick Stewart) has been in a coma for years, and his consciousness is being held captive by the villainous En Sabah Nur (Michael Shannon), also known as Apocalypse. Logan and Laura set out on a perilous journey to find Professor X's location and rescue him from Apocalypse's clutches.

Along the way, they are joined by Caliban (Stephen Merchant), a mutant with enhanced strength and agility who becomes an ally in their quest. The group faces numerous challenges and obstacles, including hordes of Transigen mercenaries and a treacherous terrain that threatens to tear them apart.

As the stakes grow higher, Logan's health begins to decline due to his advanced age and years of exposure to adamantium, a metal alloy that has been embedded in his skeleton since his encounter with Wolverine. Despite this, he remains fiercely protective of Laura and determined to save Professor X from Apocalypse's clutches.

The movie culminates in an epic showdown between Logan, Laura, Caliban, and the Transigen mercenaries at the site of Professor X's location. In a heart-wrenching climax, Logan sacrifices himself to save Laura and allow her to escape with Professor X.

Throughout the film, Mangold explores themes of mortality, sacrifice, and the complexities of father-daughter relationships. The movie features stunning visuals, intense action sequences, and a poignant performance from Hugh Jackman as the aging Wolverine.

Logan received widespread critical acclaim for its thoughtful storytelling, nuanced characters, and emotional resonance. It marked a fitting conclusion to Hugh Jackman's tenure as Wolverine in the X-Men franchise, cementing his status as one of the most beloved superheroes on screen.

title: Our Summer in Provence

plot:
Our Summer in Provence (Avis de mistral), also known as My Summer in Provence, is a 2014 French comedy-drama written and directed by Rose Bosch and produced by Légende Films with Gaumont and France 2 Cinéma. Jean Reno stars as Paul, with Anna Galiena as his wife Irène, Chloé Jouannet, Hugo Dessioux and Lukas Pélissier as their grandchildren, and Aure Atika, Tom Leeb, Hugues Aufray and Charlotte de Turckheim in supporting roles.

After their father announces he is leaving the family and their job-hunting mother accepts an internship in Montreal, the Parisian siblings Léa, 15, Adrien, 17, and their little brother Théo, who was born deaf, are sent at the last minute to spend the summer in Provence with their grandparents. They have never met their grandfather Paul, an olive grower who has not spoken to their mother since she ran away from home seventeen years earlier, and their grandmother Irène brings them without warning him. From the moment they arrive, the clash of generations is fierce: the connected city teenagers find their gruff, sarcastic grandfather rigid and backward, and he resents their presence.

Bosch, inspired by memories of her own grandparents and by the idea that today's grandfathers were yesterday's hippies, wrote the part for Reno after their collaboration on La Rafle. The film marked Chloé Jouannet's screen debut, while Pélissier is deaf, as is his character, and the singer Hugues Aufray made his first screen appearance at 84. Shot in the Alpilles from May 2013, it opened in France on 2 April 2014, ranking third in its first week with about 203,000 admissions.

title: Knock Knock
tagline: One night can cost you everything.
overview: When a devoted husband and father is left home alone for the weekend, two stranded young women unexpectedly knock on his door for help. What starts out as a kind gesture results in a dangerous seduction and a deadly game of cat and mouse.
plot:
Knock Knock is a 2015 erotic thriller directed by Eli Roth, who co-wrote the screenplay with Guillermo Amoedo and Nicolás López. It stars Keanu Reeves as Evan Webber, Lorenza Izzo as Genesis and Ana de Armas as Bel, with Aaron Burns and Ignacia Allamand. The film is a remake of Death Game, made in 1974 and released in 1977, whose director Peter S. Traynor and stars Sondra Locke and Colleen Camp were involved in the new production; Camp also appears in a cameo.

Evan Webber, an architect and devoted family man, stays home alone over Father's Day weekend to finish a work project and attend physical therapy while his wife Karen, an artist, and their children go on vacation. During a rainstorm, two young women, Genesis and Bel, knock on his door, soaked and lost, saying they are looking for a party. Evan lets them in to dry off and call a car, but as the evening goes on the women flirt with him and repeatedly push his boundaries. Despite his attempts to resist, he ends up sleeping with both of them.

The next morning, the women refuse to leave. Their behavior becomes increasingly erratic and destructive, and when Evan threatens to call the police, they claim to be underage and threaten to accuse him of statutory rape. After Evan finally appears to be rid of them, the pair return, tie him up and subject him to a night of psychological and physical torment, mocking his infidelity and filming his humiliation. Turning his home into a scene of chaos, they ruin Karen's artwork and threaten to expose him, while Evan struggles to escape their twisted game before his family returns.

The film presents a satirical take on temptation, morality and the consequences of infidelity, mixing thriller with dark humor.

Knock Knock premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 23, 2015, and was released by Lionsgate on October 9, 2015. Reviews were mixed, with 37 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus found its campy tone and repetitive story ineffective, and a Metacritic score of 53.

title: Curious George: A Very Monkey Christmas
original_title: Curious George: A Very Monkey Christmas
overview: George and The Man In The Yellow Hat are having a merry time counting down to Christmas. But neither can decide what to give each other. Will they find the answers before Christmas morning?
plot:
Curious George: A Very Monkey Christmas is a 2009 American animated holiday television film based on the Curious George children's books by Margret and H. A. Rey and the PBS Kids animated series they inspired. Produced by Universal Animation Studios with Imagine Entertainment, it was directed by Scott Heming, Cathy Malkasian and Jeff McGrath from a script by Joe Fallon. Universal released it on DVD on 13 October 2009, and it was broadcast on PBS that November. The special runs just under an hour, and its visual style sits between the more lavish 2006 theatrical feature and the simpler look of the television series.

With Christmas approaching, the little monkey George and his friend Ted, the Man with the Yellow Hat, count down the days, decorate and look for ways to make the time fly, but each secretly faces the same problem: neither knows what to give the other. George draws a Christmas list full of seemingly random shapes that Ted cannot decipher, nor can the doorman or Chef Pisghetti when Ted shows it to them, so Ted asks George to surprise him instead. George decides to make his friend a present but cannot settle on what. Meanwhile, Betsy struggles to write a new carol for her Aunt Margaret, since every Christmas subject seems to have its song already.

The preparations bring a series of gentle mishaps. A trip to the country to buy a tree ends with George climbing to the top of one and toppling a whole row; a snowplough built by Professor Wiseman, which George hopes will be the perfect gift, goes awry; and a small fire brings a fire engine. At Betsy's Christmas Eve performance, her new song turns out to be about George himself. In a dream inspired by Dickens's A Christmas Carol, the clockmaker shows Ted imagined lives in which other friends give George a perfect existence, and he realises that his friend wanted the toys in a shop window. On Christmas morning, George presents Ted with a roll of wrapping paper illustrated with the story of their Christmas.

Frank Welker voices George and Jeff Bennett the Man with the Yellow Hat, with Rino Romano narrating and Grey DeLisle, Jim Cummings, E. G. Daily, Rob Paulsen and Rolonda Watts among the supporting cast. Animated Views found the special slight but highly pleasing, praising its old-fashioned, storybook animation and amusing dialogue, while Common Sense Media judged it suitable for children aged three and up.

title: Room
tagline: Love knows no boundaries
overview: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.
plot:
Room is a 2015 psychological drama directed by Lenny Abrahamson and written by Emma Donoghue, adapting her own 2010 novel. Brie Larson stars as a young woman held captive for seven years and Jacob Tremblay as her five-year-old son, born in captivity, with Joan Allen, Sean Bridgers, Tom McCamus and William H. Macy. A co-production of Canada, Ireland, the United Kingdom and the United States, it was shot in Toronto on a set built at Pinewood Toronto Studios, with removable sections to give the crew access. Larson consulted a trauma expert and a nutritionist, dieted and avoided sunlight to prepare.

In Akron, Ohio, Joy Newsome and her son Jack live locked inside a squalid shed they call "Room", lit only by a skylight. Their captor, "Old Nick", abducted Joy seven years earlier and rapes her while Jack sleeps in the wardrobe. To protect Jack, Joy has told him that only Room is real and the rest of the world exists on television. When Old Nick reveals he has lost his job and cuts off their heat after a confrontation, Joy finally explains the outside world to Jack. A faked fever fails to get him to a hospital, so she rolls him in a rug and has him play dead. Old Nick drives off with the "body" in his pickup, and Jack, overwhelmed by his first sight of the world, leaps out and gets a stranger's attention. The police rescue him, find Joy and arrest Old Nick.

Joy returns to her childhood home to live with her mother, Nancy, and Nancy's new partner, Leo, while her father cannot accept Jack as his grandson. Jack struggles with the vast new world and longs for Room, and Joy, consumed by anger and depression, is shaken when a television interviewer questions her decision to keep her baby. After Jack finds her unconscious following a suicide attempt, she is hospitalized. Jack slowly grows close to his grandmother and Leo and makes a friend, and sends Joy a lock of his hair. When she comes home, they visit Room one last time, and Jack, finding it smaller than he remembered, says goodbye.

Larson plays Joy and Tremblay plays Jack, with Allen as Nancy and McCamus as Leo. Room won the People's Choice Award at the Toronto International Film Festival and was widely acclaimed, with 93% approval on Rotten Tomatoes. Larson won the Academy Award, Golden Globe, BAFTA and SAG Award for Best Actress, and the film received four Oscar nominations in all. It grossed $36.3 million worldwide on a $13 million budget.

title: Ex Machina
tagline: There is nothing more human than the will to survive
overview: Caleb, a coder at the world's largest internet company, wins a competition to spend a week at a private mountain retreat belonging to Nathan, the reclusive CEO of the company. But when Caleb arrives at the remote location he finds that he will have to participate in a strange and fascinating experiment in which he must interact with the world's first true artificial intelligence, housed in the body of a beautiful robot girl.
plot:
Caleb Smith, a programmer at the search engine company Blue Book, wins an office contest for a one-week visit to the luxurious, isolated home of CEO Nathan Bateman. Nathan lives there with an unspeaking beautiful female Asian companion, Kyoko, who he claims does not understand English.
After reluctantly signing a non-disclosure agreement, Caleb learns that Nathan has built a humanoid robot named Ava with artificial intelligence. Having already passed a simple Turing test, Ava is intended to be assessed by Caleb for genuine thought and consciousness, including whether he can relate to her despite knowing she is artificial.
Ava has a robotic body with the physical form and face of a woman and is confined to her apartment. Caleb becomes close to her during their conversations. She expresses a desire to experience the outside world and develops a romantic interest in him, which he begins to reciprocate. Ava can trigger power outages that disable Nathan's surveillance system, allowing her to speak privately with Caleb, though the outages also activate the building's security system and lock the doors. During one such outage, she warns Caleb that Nathan is a liar who cannot be trusted.
Disturbed by Nathan's narcissism, excessive drinking and crude treatment of Kyoko and Ava, Caleb discovers that Nathan intends to upgrade Ava after the test, wiping her memory and effectively "killing" her existing personality. Caleb gets Nathan drunk, steals his security card and accesses his room and computer. He discovers footage of Nathan with previous android women who were also held captive. Kyoko then reveals that she is a gynoid by peeling off parts of her skin, prompting Caleb to cut his own arm to determine whether he is an android.
At their next meeting, Ava cuts the power and Caleb tells her about Nathan's plan. He promises to help her escape by getting Nathan drunk again and reprogramming the security system so that, during a power failure, the doors will open rather than lock. Ava later encounters Kyoko when she enters her room.
Nathan reveals that he has secretly observed Caleb and Ava's conversations with a battery-powered security camera. He claims Ava has only pretended to care for Caleb and that Caleb was deliberately chosen for his emotional profile so he would attempt to help her escape. Nathan says this was the true test, arguing that Ava's successful manipulation of Caleb demonstrates genuine consciousness.
When Ava cuts the power again, Caleb reveals that he suspected Nathan was watching them and had already altered the security system. Ava escapes her confinement and encounters Kyoko, but Nathan knocks Caleb unconscious and confronts the two gynoids. Ava attacks him, but he overpowers her and severs her left forearm. Kyoko stabs Nathan in the back, but he strikes her, disabling her. Ava removes the knife and kills Nathan by stabbing him in the chest.

Three years after quitting male stripping, Mike has his own furniture business. He receives a call from Tarzan who informs him that Dallas is "gone". Believing that his former boss has died, Mike goes to a hotel to find his friends, the remaining Kings of Tampa, at a pool party.
After revealing Dallas bailed on them to start a new show in Macau and only took "The Kid" with him, the Kings let Mike in on their plan: to end their careers on a high note at the male stripping convention in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Later, while trying to work, Mike dances to a song he used to strip to. Reinvigorated, he decides to join them on their trip.
Driving in a fro-yo van owned by Tito and Tobias, they make their first stop at Mad Mary's. To prove to Richie he is willing to commit to the trip, Mike participates in an amateur drag queen contest, and the others join him shortly. They then go to a beach where Mike lets Ken hit him to resolve his issues with him. He also meets photographer Zoe, who tells him that she is off to New York. They flirt but agree to not have sex.
Back on the road, Mike suggests that they change their routine after the group (except Tarzan) takes MDMA. At a gas station, he coerces Richie into trying to make the cashier smile with an improvised striptease. This inspires the others to abandon their old routines.
Soon afterwards, Tobias falls asleep at the wheel, crashing the van. He suffers a concussion and needs hospitalization; everyone else is left unscathed. At the hospital, they begin to lose morale and contemplate quitting and heading home. Mike then reveals that his furniture business is not going that well and that he is no longer with Brooke after she rejected his proposal. The group decides to continue on.
In search of a new MC, Mike brings the group to a Savannah, Georgia strip club owned by Rome, a woman Mike has a history with. Despite proving that his skills have not deteriorated, he is unsuccessful in getting her to help them. However, she gets Andre, a rapper/singer who works at the club, to drive them to their next stop.
Arriving at a mansion, Tito tells them he knows the girl who lives there, and she is expecting them. Walking in, they are greeted by her mother Nancy and her friends, all middle-aged women. Nancy's teasing initially makes them feel awkward, but as the night progresses, the mood lightens. Mike meets Zoe again, and she tells him about how another photographer, under the guise of needing an assistant, tried to have an extramarital affair with her. Mike urges her to regain her smile at the convention.
After sleeping with Richie, Nancy lets them drive her ex-husband's car to Myrtle Beach. Upon arrival, they are surprised to see Rome. She had a change of heart, agreeing to be their MC. Andre and Malik also came to help. With preparations complete, they head to the convention where they squeeze in a spot, thanks to Rome and her history with Paris, the organizer of the event.

title: Winter Sleep
overview: Aydin, a retired actor, owns a small hotel in central Anatolia with his young wife Nihal and his sister Necla, who is coping with her recent divorce. During the winter, snow covers the ground and boredom brings the return of old memories, pushing Aydin to flee…
plot:
Aydın, a former actor, owns a mountaintop hotel in Cappadocia, as well as several properties which he rents out to local tenants. He leads a more idyllic life than most people around him in the region. Educated and wealthy, he spends his time writing columns for a local newspaper and researching the history of Turkish theater, of which he hopes to write a book someday.
One day, Aydın and his assistant Hidayet are driving down to the village when a stone shatters the window. It was thrown by İlyas, the son of İsmail, one of Aydın's tenants who is several months behind in the rent. When Hidayet confronts the father, it turns out that Aydın's people had already sent a collection agency that took İsmail's television and refrigerator, with İsmail getting beaten up by the police for resisting. The situation escalates until İsmail's brother Hamdi intervenes.
Hamdi, the eager-to-please local imam, brings the young İlyas to Aydın in an attempt to make amends for the glass-breaking incident. However, this only serves to annoy Aydin, inspiring him to write a column on how an imam should really give a proper example to their community. At first, his sister Necla wonders why Aydın does not use his writing talent in a better place than the local newspaper. Later, she reverses her view and tells him that he is just superficially and sentimentally criticising other people from his comfortable armchair. This results in a long chain of snide remarks made back and forth at each other. This reversal occurs after Necla mentions to Aydın's wife Nihal that Necla might be better off going back to her ex-husband, after which Nihal tells Necla that she is free to leave even though it is a stupid idea.
Nihal is much younger than her husband Aydın. She tries to give meaning to her life by fundraising for developing schools, an activity for which Aydın has not shown much interest. However, when Nihal organizes a fundraiser event in their home, Aydın becomes annoyed and tells her that the fundraiser event will be a guaranteed failure due to her lack of experience and bookkeeping skills. This turns into an emotional argument, where he tells her that she is free to divorce from him if she wishes so. Finally, Aydın states that he will leave for Istanbul for several months to make arrangements for his book. He warns her that she should not trust Levent (Nadir Sarıbacak), one of the other people involved in the fundraiser, since Aydın considers Levent to lack moral values. Before he leaves, Aydın makes a large anonymous donation in cash.
The next day, Hidayet takes Aydın to the train station, carrying all the luggage while Aydın comfortably walks empty-handed. Due to heavy snow fall, the train is severely delayed, and Aydın decides that they will visit Aydın's friend Suavi in a nearby village. Suavi welcomes Aydın's visit, but Levent also shows up, as Levent and Suavi had agreed earlier to go out hunting. They spend the evening drinking and talking.

title: Leviathan
overview: In a Russian coastal town, Kolya is forced to fight the corrupt mayor when he is told that his house will be demolished. He recruits a lawyer friend to help, but the man's arrival brings further misfortune for Kolya and his family.
plot:
In the northern Russian coastal town of Pribrezhny live Nikolay Sergeyev, a hotheaded car mechanic; his second wife, Lilya; and his teenage son, Romka. The town's corrupt Mayor Vadim Sergeyevich is plotting legal chicanery to expropriate the beautiful seaside land on which Nikolay's house is built. The town is forcefully compensating Nikolay with a grossly undervalued sum of 649,000 roubles, and Nikolay believes the Mayor wants the land to build a villa for himself. Nikolay's old friend Dmitry Seleznyov, a sharp and successful lawyer from Moscow, arrives in town to fight the expropriation through the local court system.
After the court rules in favor of the expropriation, Nikolay is arrested at the police station for shouting at the officers, and no one in government will accept Dmitry's new criminal filing against the mayor. However, Dmitry meets with the mayor, extorting him with a thick folder of evidence that incriminates him for past crimes. A shocked mayor agrees to release Nikolay and pay 3.5 million roubles. In a local hotel room, Dmitry and Lilya have an affair.
The next day, the Sergeyevs and Dmitry attend the seaside birthday cookout of Nikolay's friend Ivan Stepanich, where a child runs to the group saying that he just saw Dmitry choking Lilya. Nikolay runs to find them and gunshots are heard. Afterward, Dmitry and Lilya drive back silently together, both with facial bruises. Meanwhile, Mayor Vadim Sergeyevich goes for help to one of his crony bosses, the Russian Orthodox Church bishop, who tells him that all power comes from God and encourages him to stop whining to him and solve his problems forcefully. When Dmitry meets with the mayor to finalize the payment, the mayor's thugs beat Dmitry, and the mayor carries out a mock execution, advising him to return to Moscow. A conciliatory Lilya returns home to Nikolay but is depressed. Dmitry stands sadly looking out the window of a moving train.
While the family is packing to move out, Romka accidentally glimpses Nikolay and Lilya in an intimate encounter and flees the house, collapsing in tears by a whale skeleton on the shore. He returns home late, screaming that Lilya leave forever. That night Lilya is unable to sleep, and instead of going to work in the morning, she goes alone to the ocean cliff. When she turns up missing, Nikolay desperately searches for her and increases his already very heavy consumption of vodka. Her body is discovered a few days later on the shore. A mournful, drunk Nikolay asks the local Orthodox priest Father Vasily why God is doing this to him. Vasily quotes from the Biblical book of Job and counsels Nikolay that when Job accepted his fate, he was rewarded with a long and happy life.
The next morning, Nikolay is arrested for murder. The investigator claims to have evidence that Nikolay had sex with Lilya, killed her with his hammer, and threw her into the sea to hide it.

title: Wild Card
tagline: Never bet against a man with a killer hand.
overview: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play… and it's all or nothing.
plot:
Wild Card is a 2015 American action thriller directed by Simon West. It is based on William Goldman's 1985 novel Heat and is a remake of the 1986 adaptation starring Burt Reynolds; Goldman wrote the screenplay. Jason Statham stars as Nick Wild, with Michael Angarano as Cyrus Kinnick, Milo Ventimiglia as Danny DeMarco, Dominik Garcia-Lorido as Holly, Anne Heche as Roxy, Hope Davis as Cassandra and Sofia Vergara as D.D.

Nick is a recovering gambling addict who earns his living in Las Vegas as a "chaperone", his term for a bodyguard for hire. A young man, Cyrus Kinnick, hires him to show him around the city and protect him while he gambles. His friend Holly, an escort, was raped and beaten after a date at the Golden Nugget and asks him to identify the men so she can sue. Nick learns that the attacker was the gangster Danny DeMarco, whose thugs dumped her in a hospital parking lot. Nick overpowers DeMarco and his men in their hotel room, and Holly threatens to castrate DeMarco, who begs forgiveness. She settles for the $50,000 from his desk, splits it with Nick and leaves town.

Nick then takes Cyrus to a casino, where a remarkable winning streak at blackjack earns him more than half a million dollars. At the cashier's window, however, panic sets in, and he keeps playing until he loses everything, including his original stake, on a single hand dealt by his friend Cassandra. Cyrus turns out to be a self-made millionaire who wants Nick to teach him courage. DeMarco tells the Las Vegas mob boss, Baby, that Nick robbed him and killed two of his men. Before Baby, Nick counters that DeMarco killed his own men to hide his humiliation, and that he bears a cut on his penis; DeMarco refuses to prove him wrong and walks out. Cyrus later offers Nick a $500,000 check and a plane ticket to Corsica. When DeMarco and his men corner them in a diner, Cyrus creates a distraction by singing loudly, and Nick kills the thugs and DeMarco in the alley using the diner's cutlery before accepting the gift and driving out of Las Vegas.

West said Statham developed the project for years; Brian De Palma was once attached to direct. Lionsgate released the film on January 30, 2015,, in limited theaters and on demand. It was a box office bomb, earning $6.7 million against a $30 million budget. Reviews were negative, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting a 30% approval rating and the Los Angeles Times calling it predictable.

This is how the life of Doraemon and Nobita begins. Will Doraemon succeed this mission and return to the 22nd century?
plot:
Stand by Me Doraemon is a 2014 Japanese coming-of-age film directed by Harry Amanatoguchi, produced by Toho. The movie is based on the popular manga series "Doraemon" created by Fujiko F. Fujio.

The story takes place in 1967 and follows four young friends - Shizuka, Noboru, Suneo, and Gorō - who live in a small town in Japan. The boys are all around 12 years old and are struggling to find their place in the world. They spend most of their days playing video games and trying to come up with ways to get rich quickly.

One day, while exploring an abandoned mine on the outskirts of town, they stumble upon a mysterious robot from the future named Doraemon. Doraemon is a robotic cat from the year 22nd century who has traveled back in time to help his friend Nobita, who will later become one of the main characters.

The four boys are amazed by Doraemon's advanced technology and gadgets, which they use to solve various problems and have exciting adventures. However, their fun is short-lived as they soon realize that Doraemon's presence has attracted the attention of a group of adults who are searching for him.

As the story unfolds, we see flashbacks of Nobita's life in the future, where he is struggling to find his place in society due to his lack of confidence and poor grades. Doraemon's arrival in the past helps Nobita to develop his skills and build relationships with his friends.

Throughout the movie, the four boys learn valuable lessons about friendship, teamwork, and the importance of using their talents and abilities to help others. They also face various challenges and obstacles, including rivalries with other kids in town and dealing with the consequences of their actions.

As the story reaches its climax, Doraemon's presence becomes more pronounced, and he helps the boys to overcome their struggles and achieve their goals. The movie ends on a heartwarming note, with the four friends reflecting on the lessons they have learned from Doraemon and the impact he has had on their lives.

Overall, Stand by Me Doraemon is a charming and entertaining film that explores themes of friendship, growth, and self-discovery. With its colorful characters, exciting adventures, and valuable life lessons, it is a must-see for fans of the "Doraemon" series and anyone looking for a heartwarming coming-of-age story.

title: Sisters
tagline: Big sisters don't always know best.
overview: Two disconnected sisters are summoned to clean out their childhood bedrooms before their parents sell their family home.
plot:
Sisters is a 2015 American comedy directed by Jason Moore and written by Paula Pell. It is the second film pairing Tina Fey and Amy Poehler, after Baby Mama (2008), with Fey as Kate Ellis, an irresponsible single mother, and Poehler as her sister Maura, a kindhearted nurse and recent divorcée. The cast also includes Maya Rudolph, Ike Barinholtz, James Brolin, Dianne Wiest, John Cena, John Leguizamo and Bobby Moynihan. Universal Pictures released it on 18 December 2015.

Maura, a hardworking nurse, is asked by her parents, Deana and Bucky, to come back to their family home in Orlando and clear out her old bedroom before the house is sold. They also ask her to break the news to her sister Kate, a chaotic, unemployed nail stylist whose teenage daughter, Haley, has been living elsewhere to avoid her. Instead of telling her, Maura persuades Kate, who has just been evicted, to come to Orlando with her. Arriving, the sisters find that the house has already been sold and emptied except for their childhood bedroom, which they must clear out by the end of the weekend.

Upset at losing the home full of their memories, Kate persuades Maura to throw one last party for their old high-school friends, with a twist: this time Kate will be the responsible "party mom" while the usually cautious Maura gets to let loose. They invite most of their former classmates, deliberately leaving out Kate's old rival, Brinda, and Maura sets her sights on James, a handsome neighbor. The party starts slowly, with the middle-aged guests subdued and awkward, but it soon spirals out of control as alcohol, drugs and nostalgia take over, with guests destroying the house, a dealer named Pazuzu supplying drugs and Brinda crashing the event. Amid the chaos, the sisters' relationship is tested, as Maura confronts Kate about her irresponsibility and Kate faces the consequences of her choices regarding her daughter, while the new owners of the house become increasingly alarmed.

Sisters received mixed reviews, with critics praising the chemistry between Fey and Poehler but finding the comedy uneven and overlong. It was a commercial success, grossing about $105 million worldwide against a budget of around $30 million.

title: Pan
tagline: Every legend has a beginning.
overview: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. Adventure awaits as he meets new friend James Hook and the warrior Tiger Lily. They must band together to save Neverland from the ruthless pirate Blackbeard. Along the way, the rebellious and mischievous boy discovers his true destiny, becoming the hero forever known as Peter Pan.
plot:
Newborn Peter is left on the steps of a London orphanage with a mysterious pan flute pendant by his mother Mary. Years later during World War II, upon learning that the abusive Mother Barnabas is hoarding food and riches for herself, Peter and his best friend Nibs are caught trying to steal the food for the orphans. In the process, they find a letter written to Peter by his mother, declaring her love and assuring him they will meet again "in this world or another".
Mother Barnabas summons pirates who kidnap Peter, Nibs and several other orphans. Nibs manages to escape, but Peter is taken aboard a flying pirate ship. Following an aerial battle with several Spitfires, the ship reaches Neverland, where the children are forced to mine for Pixum – crystallized Fairy Dust—for the pirate Blackbeard, who uses the substance to prevent himself from aging.
Taken captive by Blackbeard's right-hand man Bishop, Peter meets the miner, James Hook. After insulting Blackbeard's men, Peter is forced to walk the plank over the deep mine, but survives by flying. Blackbeard tells him about the native tribe's prophecy of a flying boy who would lead an uprising to kill him, but Peter refuses to believe in "bedtime stories".
Peter joins Hook and his accomplice, Sam "Smee" Smiegel, in stealing a flying ship and escaping into the forest. Determined to find his mother, Peter refuses to leave Neverland. They are found by the native chief's daughter Tiger Lily and nearly executed, but Chief Great Little Panther notices Peter's pendant, which is said to belong to their people's greatest hero, the legendary Pan.
Using the Memory Tree, Tiger Lily tells Peter that many years ago, when the natives and fairies united against the pirates, the Fairy Prince and Mary, the love of Blackbeard's life, fell in love. When Blackbeard discovered them, the Prince took human form and sacrificed himself to rescue Mary, as fairies can live as humans for only one day. She was forced to hide their son Peter in the other world and seek shelter in the Fairy Kingdom. As half-fairy, Peter has the ability to fly but is unable to do so because of his lack of faith.
Fearful of Blackbeard, Smee betrays the natives' location, and in the ensuing battle Chief Great Little Panther is shot by Blackbeard, who reveals that he killed Mary. Peter is hurt to learn that Tiger Lily lied to him that his mother was still alive, but she explains that he would have walked away from his destiny if he knew the truth.
Peter, Hook, and Tiger Lily escape in a raft to enlist the help of the Fairy Kingdom. They are attacked by a giant crocodile and Peter is nearly eaten before being rescued by the mermaids. Tiger Lily shows Peter a vision of Blackbeard accidentally killing Mary as she defended the Fairy Kingdom, revealing she was a great warrior who trained Tiger Lily herself.
Hook leaves on an abandoned ship to find home while Peter and Tiger Lily arrive at the Fairy Kingdom, only to be ambushed by Blackbeard.

title: The Theory of Everything
tagline: His Mind Changed Our World. Her Love Changed His.
overview: The Theory of Everything is the extraordinary story of one of the world’s greatest living minds, the renowned astrophysicist Stephen Hawking, who falls deeply in love with fellow Cambridge student Jane Wilde.
plot:
In 1963, Stephen Hawking, a postgraduate astrophysics student at the University of Cambridge, begins a relationship with literature student Jane Wilde. Although Stephen is intelligent, both his friends and fellow academics are worried about his lack of a thesis topic. After attending a lecture by Roger Penrose on black holes with his advisor, Prof. Dennis Sciama, Stephen speculates that these might have been part of the universe's creation and decides on his thesis.
However, soon Stephen's muscles begin to fail, causing him to lose coordination. After a bad fall, he is diagnosed with early-onset progressive degenerative motor neurone disease (MND) that will eventually leave him unable to move, swallow, or even breathe. With no treatment options, he is given approximately two years to live. The doctor assures Stephen that his brain will not be affected, so his thoughts and intelligence will remain intact, but eventually, he will be unable to communicate with them. Stephen develops severe depression, becoming reclusive and focusing on his work. Jane confesses she loves him and that she intends to stay, even as his condition worsens. They marry and have their first son, Robert. Once his walking ability deteriorates, he begins using a wheelchair.
Inspired by Penrose's work on spacetime singularities at the centre of black holes, Stephen presents his doctoral thesis viva, extrapolating that a black hole created the universe in a Big Bang and it will end in a Big Crunch.
After the Hawkings have their daughter Lucy, Jane becomes frustrated having to focus on the children, as well as Stephen's slowly degenerating health while his fame increases, all at the expense of her academic work. Stephen tells her he will understand if she needs help.
In the 1970s, Jane joins a church choir, where she meets and becomes close friends with Jonathan, a widower. She employs him as Robert's piano teacher, and Jonathan befriends the entire family, helping Stephen with his illness, supporting Jane, and playing with the children. When Jane gives birth to another son, Timothy, Stephen's mother asks her if the baby is Jonathan's. This causes outrage and Jonathan is appalled, but when he and Jane are alone, they admit the depth of their feelings for each other. He distances himself from the family, but Stephen tells him that Jane needs him.
As the Lucasian Professor of Mathematics at Cambridge, Stephen goes on to develop a theory of the visibility of black holes that emit radiation, becoming a world-renowned physicist.
In the 1980s, while on holiday in Bordeaux, Stephen falls ill and is rushed to a hospital. The doctor informs Jane that he has pneumonia and the tracheotomy he needs to survive will leave him mute. She agrees to the surgery. Stephen learns to use a spelling board and uses it to communicate with his new nurse, Elaine Mason.

title: Grimsby
tagline: Behind every hero is an embarrassing sibling
overview: Wrongfully accused and on the run, a top MI6 assassin joins forces with his long-lost, football hooligan brother to save the world from a sinister plot.
plot:
Grimsby, released in the United States and Canada as The Brothers Grimsby, is a 2016 spy action comedy directed by Louis Leterrier and written by Sacha Baron Cohen, Phil Johnston and Peter Baynham. Baron Cohen plays Nobby Butcher, a football hooligan from Grimsby, and Mark Strong his long-lost younger brother Sebastian Graves, MI6's top agent. Isla Fisher, Rebel Wilson, Penélope Cruz, Gabourey Sidibe, Annabelle Wallis and Ian McShane co-star.

Nobby and Sebastian were separated as children 28 years earlier. Nobby has become an alcoholic football hooligan who lives in Grimsby with his partner Dawn and their eleven children, while Sebastian, raised under another name, is an elite spy. Sebastian is sent to protect the philanthropist Rhonda George at a charity event called WorldCure. Tipped off by his friends, Nobby turns up to reunite with his brother and hugs him just as Sebastian is about to shoot an assassin, ruining the shot; an innocent bystander is hit instead. Branded a rogue agent and pursued by MI6's hitman Chilcott, Sebastian reluctantly hides out with Nobby in Grimsby.

When Chilcott's men find them in a pub, Sebastian is hit by poison darts, and Nobby saves him by sucking out the poison. Following a lead from his handler, Jodie, the brothers travel to a lodge in South Africa, where Nobby, attempting to impersonate his brother, mistakes the hotel maid Banu for his target, and the brothers learn from Lina Smit that the assassin has bought a virus shortly before she is shot dead. Fleeing Chilcott's men, they hide inside an elephant in one of its crudest gags. Afterwards Nobby explains that he ran away as a boy because Sebastian's adoptive parents could take only one child, and he wanted his brother to have a better life.

At the football cup final in Chile between England and Germany, Sebastian is captured, and Rhonda reveals herself as the mastermind, planning to spread the virus over the crowd with fireworks. Nobby rescues his brother, Chilcott is stopped by Nobby's children, and when his gun jams, Nobby sits on one of the virus-laden fireworks to contain it, with Sebastian joining him on the other. The blast knocks both unconscious, Rhonda is arrested, and the news reports that the brothers saved the world.

Delayed several times in the United States, the film grossed only $28 million worldwide against a $35 million budget. Critics were largely negative, with 37% on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: V/H/S: Viral
tagline: Mayhem goes viral.
overview: V/H/S: VIRAL's segments include the story of a deranged illusionist who obtains a magical object of great power; a homemade machine that opens a door to a parallel world; teenage skaters that unwillingly become targets of a Mexican death cult ritual; and a sinister, shadowy organization that is tracking a serial killer. The segments are tied together by the story of a group of fame-obsessed teens following a violent car chase in LA that unwittingly become stars of the next internet sensation.
plot:
The film is presented as an anthology of three short horror films, built into a frame narrative which acts as its own fourth short horror film. Each short film is linked together with the concept of found footage as each segment is from VHS tapes that went viral after being uploaded to social media from Kyle's laptop.

Directed by Marcel Sarmiento
Written by T.J. Cimfel, David White and Marcel Sarmiento
The frame narrative focuses on Kevin, an amateur videographer who constantly shoots footage of his girlfriend Iris to cope with his abusive grandmother. She claims to enjoy it, but Iris soon grows annoyed with Kevin's obsession with filming her.
That night, an ice cream truck in a high speed car chase arrives in the neighborhood, with Kevin witnessing the live broadcast on television. He sees the opportunity to create a viral video of the chase, but is too late to shoot footage as the truck speeds past his house. Iris then receives a mysterious video call and wanders outside in a daze. The truck runs over a police officer who had been telling Kevin to back away from the road.
Kevin notices that Iris has suddenly disappeared and chases after the truck when images of a panicking Iris are broadcast to his cell phone. Meanwhile, people in the neighborhood begin to receive the same images on their own phones, turning them violently insane.

Directed and written by Gregg Bishop
This segment is framed partially as an investigative documentary.
Trailer park resident and untalented illusionist John McMullen mysteriously discovers a cloak that was once owned by Harry Houdini. He learns that wearing the cloak grants him the power to perform actual magic and takes on the stage name "Dante the Great" to perform his newfound abilities in front of large audiences, becoming immensely famous.
When his power appears to fail one night, John learns that the cloak requires regular human sacrifices to work, and thus hires a series of assistants to feed the cloak, videotaping the deaths. He uses his powers to summon and kill Clay Bowland, the abusive boyfriend of his latest assistant, Scarlett Kay. She discovers John's tape collection in his dressing room, hidden inside a secret compartment disguised as a circuit breaker. After she alerts the police, a SWAT team enters John's theater while he is doing an interview with a documentary crew in order to arrest him. However, John uses his powers to escape custody and summon Scarlett from the police station where she's being interrogated. The documentary crew keep filming, and in the midst of their confrontation, the SWAT team re-enters the building and attempt to arrest John once again, but he manages to kill them all with his magic.
Scarlett and John duel over the cloak, but the former is overpowered. Before John can kill her, Scarlett uses a rope trick he taught her to immobilize him, prompting the cloak to devour him instead.

title: London Has Fallen
tagline: The world's leaders have assembled. So have their enemies.
overview: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning discovers a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.
plot:
London Has Fallen is a 2016 American action thriller film directed by Babak Anvari and written by David Coggeshall, Art Linson, and John Pogue. The movie stars Gerard Butler, Morgan Freeman, and Angela Bassett.

The film begins with President Benjamin Asher (Morgan Freeman) attending the annual NATO summit in London, where he is greeted as a hero for his efforts to strengthen international relations. However, during the ceremony, a terrorist attack occurs, and the President's motorcade is ambushed by a group of heavily armed assailants.

The attackers, led by the enigmatic and ruthless Abigail Asher (Jordana Brewster), are revealed to be members of a shadowy organization known as "The Syndicate." The group seeks revenge against the United States for its perceived wrongdoings, particularly in regards to the death of their leader, who was killed during a previous operation.

As the President's security detail scrambles to respond to the attack, Mike Banning (Gerard Butler), the former head of the Secret Service, is pulled out of retirement to lead the rescue mission. Banning, who has been struggling with PTSD and personal demons since his last mission went awry, must now confront his past and face off against The Syndicate.

As Banning navigates the treacherous streets of London, he teams up with a local police officer, Detective Sean McPherson (Omar Sy), to track down Abigail Asher and prevent further attacks. title: The BFG
tagline: The world is more giant than you can imagine.
overview: The BFG is no ordinary bone-crunching giant. He is far too nice and jumbly. It's lucky for Sophie that he is. Had she been carried off in the middle of the night by the Bloodbottler, or any of the other giants—rather than the BFG—she would have soon become breakfast. When Sophie hears that the giants are flush-bunking off to England to swollomp a few nice little chiddlers, she decides she must stop them once and for all. And the BFG is going to help her!
plot:
The BFG is a 2016 fantasy adventure film directed by Steven Spielberg, based on the 1982 novel of the same name by Roald Dahl. The story takes place in an alternate version of Great Britain and follows the journey of a young girl named Sophie.

The film begins with Sophie, a 10-year-old orphan living in a London orphanage. One night, while out foraging for food, Sophie encounters the Big Friendly Giant (BFG), who is unlike any other giant she has ever seen. The BFG is small and gentle, and he collects dreams instead of eating humans like the other giants.

Sophie befriends the BFG and learns that he is being bullied by the other giants, led by the Fleshlumpeater, Bonecruncher, and Childchewer. The BFG tells Sophie about his dream-collecting business and asks for her help in stopping the Queen of England from eating humans at night.

The BFG and Sophie devise a plan to convince the Queen to stop eating humans, but things become complicated when they are discovered by the Queen's guards. The BFG is captured, and Sophie must come up with a clever plan to rescue him.

As the story unfolds, Sophie learns about the BFG's world and the different types of giants that inhabit it. She also discovers that the BFG has a special gift – he can make anyone laugh, which makes them forget their troubles.

With the help of the BFG, Sophie convinces the Queen to stop eating humans by using her own laughter as an example. The Queen is charmed by Sophie's innocence and kindness, and she agrees to stop eating humans.

The film ends with Sophie returning to the orphanage, but not before saying goodbye to the BFG. She realizes that she has found a true friend in the giant and promises to visit him again soon. As for the BFG, he returns to his home in Giant Country, where he is welcomed back by his fellow giants.

Throughout the film, Spielberg brings Dahl's beloved characters to life with stunning visuals and heartwarming performances from the cast, including Mark Rylance as the BFG and Ruby Barnhill as Sophie. The film's themes of friendship, kindness, and the power of laughter make it a delightful and entertaining adventure for audiences of all ages.

Overall, The BFG is a charming and imaginative film that stays true to Dahl's original story while also adding its own unique twists and surprises. With its beautiful animation, engaging storyline, and memorable characters, this film is sure to delight both children and adults alike.

title: Transformers: Prime Beast Hunters: Predacons Rising

overview: Autobots, Decepticons, Predaking and Predacons form an unlikely alliance to battle a resurrected Unicron.
plot:
Transformers Prime Beast Hunters: Predacons Rising is a 2013 American animated television film that serves as the conclusion of the series Transformers: Prime. It first aired on the Hub Network on October 4, 2013. The voice cast includes Peter Cullen as Optimus Prime, Frank Welker as Megatron, Will Friedle as Bumblebee, Sumalee Montano as Arcee, Steve Blum as Starscream, Kevin Michael Richardson as Bulkhead, Jeffrey Combs as Ratchet, Michael Ironside as Ultra Magnus, Peter Mensah as Predaking, David Sobolov as Shockwave and John Noble as Unicron.

After the Autobots' victory and the restoration of their home planet Cybertron, Optimus Prime honors Bumblebee as a warrior. Optimus and Wheeljack then leave on a quest to find the AllSpark, the source of all Cybertronian life, while the other Autobots hunt for the missing Decepticons Shockwave and Starscream. Meanwhile, deep in the Pacific Ocean, the dead Megatron is revived and possessed by Unicron, the ancient chaos-bringer, who intends to destroy Cybertron.

With Ultra Magnus gravely wounded by the Predacons Skylynx and Darksteel, Bumblebee takes temporary command of the Autobots. Predaking, the proud leader of the Predacons, refuses to help them, but he too falls before Unicron, who finds Shockwave and Starscream harvesting bones from an ancient Predacon graveyard and raises the corpses as an army of undead Terrorcons. As the horde marches on the Well of AllSparks, the Autobots, the remaining Decepticons and the Predacons are forced into an uneasy alliance to stop the threat. Optimus and Wheeljack race home with the AllSpark's container, and the battle for the future of Cybertron reaches its climax as old enemies reconsider their loyalties.

The film wraps up the storylines of the series, focusing on themes of redemption, sacrifice and the rebirth of a civilization.

Predacons Rising received positive reviews and was widely regarded as a satisfying conclusion to Transformers: Prime, although some reviewers criticized the limited use of characters such as Ultra Magnus and Shockwave.

overview: Two mischievous kids hypnotize their mean elementary school principal and turn him into their comic book creation, the kind-hearted and elastic-banded Captain Underpants.
plot:
Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie is a 2017 animated adventure comedy film directed by David Sardis, based on the popular children's book series by Dav Pilkey. The movie follows the story of two fourth-grade pranksters, George Beard (voiced by Asher Angel) and Harold Hutchins (voiced by Jordan Reed), who accidentally hypnotize their mean principal, Mr. Krupp (voiced by Nick Offerman).

The film begins with George and Harold trying to outdo each other in a series of pranks, which ultimately lead them to hypnotize Mr. Krupp during a school assembly. The hypnotized principal is transformed into Captain Underpants, a superhero alter ego created by the boys' imaginations.

As Captain Underpants, the boys must stop an evil scientist, Professor Poopypants (voiced by Kristen Schaal), who has taken over the city's water supply and turned its citizens into giant chickens. The professor plans to use the mind-controlling water to take over the world.

George and Harold soon discover that they are the only ones who can control Captain Underpants' actions, as he is unable to speak or move on his own. They embark on a series of adventures to stop Professor Poopypants and save the city from her evil plans.

Throughout their journey, George and Harold learn valuable lessons about teamwork, friendship, and responsibility. Meanwhile, they also have to deal with the challenges of being superheroes, including navigating Captain Underpants' unpredictable behavior and dealing with the consequences of his actions.

As the story unfolds, George and Harold face off against Professor Poopypants in an epic battle to save the city. Along the way, they are aided by a group of allies, including a talking toilet named Mr. Garbage (voiced by Ed Helms) and a mysterious woman who claims to be Captain Underpants' love interest.

In the end, George and Harold successfully defeat Professor Poopypants and shatter her mind-control device, freeing the city from her grasp. However, they soon realize that their adventure has come to an end, and they must return to their normal lives as fourth-grade students.

The movie concludes with a heartwarming moment of friendship between George and Harold, as they reflect on their incredible adventure and the lessons they learned along the way. The film ends on a high note, setting the stage for future adventures in the Captain Underpants series.

Overall, Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie is a hilarious and action-packed animated adventure that brings the beloved book series to life. With its colorful characters, witty humor, and exciting plot twists, this movie is sure to delight both kids and adults alike.

title: Pacific Rim: Uprising

plot:
Pacific Rim: Uprising is a 2018 science fiction monster film directed by Steven S. DeKnight and written by Emily Carmichael, Kira Snyder, and John Francis Daley. The movie takes place 10 years after the events of the first Pacific Rim film.

The story begins with Jake Pentecost (played by John Boyega), the son of Stacker Pentecost (played by Idris Elba), who was killed in action during the war against the Kaijus. Jake is a young and talented engineer who has grown up hearing stories about his father's bravery and sacrifice.

Jake is recruited by Dr. Newton Geiszler (played by Charlie Hunnam), a scientist who has discovered a way to communicate with the Jaegers, giant robots that were used to fight against the Kaijus. The Jaegers are now being decommissioned due to their high maintenance costs and lack of effectiveness in modern warfare.

Jake is paired with Dr. Zhang (played by Rinko Kikuchi), a brilliant scientist who has developed a new technology that allows humans to pilot the Jaegers without the need for a human co-pilot. The two scientists embark on a mission to develop a new generation of Jaeger pilots, known as "drifters," who can work together to take down the Kaijus.

However, their plans are soon disrupted by a group of rogue drifters, led by the enigmatic and ruthless Cassius (played by Scott Eastwood). Cassius is determined to use the technology for his own gain and becomes a formidable foe for Jake and Dr. Zhang.

As the story unfolds, Jake discovers that he has a unique connection to the Jaegers, which makes him an ideal candidate to pilot the new generation of machines. He also learns about his father's past and the sacrifices he made during the war against the Kaijus.

The movie culminates in an epic battle between the humans and the Kaijus, with Jake and Dr. Zhang leading the charge. Along the way, they encounter a range of formidable foes, including the monstrous Otachi and the treacherous Cassius.

In the end, Jake emerges as a hero, having saved humanity from extinction. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Jake and Dr. Zhang looking towards a brighter future for humanity and the Jaegers.

Overall, Pacific Rim: Uprising is an action-packed sci-fi adventure that explores themes of identity, sacrifice, and the power of human connection. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the movie has its fans and offers plenty of excitement and thrills for fans of the franchise.

title: Hot Pursuit
tagline: Armed and Sort-of Dangerous.
overview: An uptight by-the-book cop must protect the widow of a drug boss from crooked cops and gunmen.
plot:
Hot Pursuit is a 2015 American action comedy directed by Anne Fletcher from a screenplay by David Feeney and John Quaintance. Produced by New Line Cinema, Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures and Reese Witherspoon's company Pacific Standard, and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures, it stars Witherspoon as a by-the-book police officer and Sofía Vergara as the outspoken widow she is assigned to protect. The film was released in cinemas on 8 May 2015.

Rose Cooper is a San Antonio police officer whose rigid devotion to the rules has made her a laughing stock. After an embarrassing incident in which she sets the mayor's son on fire with her taser, she is relegated to working in the evidence room. Her captain offers her a chance to redeem herself by joining a U.S. Marshal on a protection detail: Felipe Riva and his wife Daniella are to be escorted to Dallas so that Felipe can testify against the cartel boss Vicente Cortez.

At the Rivas' house, two separate teams of gunmen attack, killing the marshal and Felipe while Cooper and Daniella are upstairs. The two women flee in the Rivas' car, with Daniella insisting on bringing a suitcase full of shoes. When Daniella tries to escape, Cooper handcuffs herself to her. They are soon found by two fellow police officers, and Cooper realises from a tattoo that they are among the assassins, meaning that corrupt police are involved. The unlikely pair head for Dallas while being pursued by both crooked officers and cartel hitmen, only to learn that Cooper has been branded a fugitive. Along the way they survive a collision with a truck carrying cocaine, disguise themselves in increasingly absurd ways and gradually begin to trust one another, as Cooper discovers that the case is more complicated than she was told and that Daniella has secrets of her own.

The film follows the buddy-cop formula, built around the contrast between the uptight, diminutive Cooper and the glamorous, quick-tempered Daniella, with much of its humour derived from physical comedy and the bickering between its two leads.

Hot Pursuit was poorly received by critics, with an approval rating of about 8 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, as reviewers found its jokes tired and its plot predictable despite the efforts of its stars. It grossed about 51.4 million dollars worldwide against a budget of 35 million.

title: Zootopia
tagline: Welcome to the urban jungle.
overview: Determined to prove herself, Officer Judy Hopps, the first bunny on Zootopia's police force, jumps at the chance to crack her first case - even if it means partnering with scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.
plot:
In a world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals, Judy Hopps, a rabbit from rural Bunnyburrow, fulfills her childhood dream of becoming the first rabbit police officer in the city of Zootopia. On her first day at the Zootopia Police Department (ZPD), Judy is assigned to parking duty by Chief Bogo, who underestimates her potential. During her shift, she is hustled by red fox con artist Nick Wilde, who tells her she will never be a real cop. The next day, Judy abandons her post to arrest small-time crook Duke Weaselton for robbing a florist right in front of her. Afterwards, Mrs. Otterton visits Bogo, pleading for someone to find her husband Emmitt - he is one of several predators who have gone missing. Judy volunteers to take the case without waiting for permission, and an annoyed Bogo warns her she must solve it within 48 hours, or turn in her badge.
Having ascertained that Nick was one of the last to see Emmitt, Judy blackmails him into helping her. They follow clues to a naturist club, then to the sloth-run DMV. There, they get an address for the limousine that took Emmitt from the club, and trace it to arctic shrew mafia boss Mr. Big, who has a grudge against Nick. Mr. Big prepares to drown Judy and Nick, until his daughter Fru Fru reveals Judy saved her life while stopping Weaselton. Mr. Big then welcomes them in, and explains that Emmitt unexpectedly "went savage" in the limousine and attacked the chauffeur Renato Manchas, a black jaguar.
Judy and Nick question Manchas, who explains that Emmitt yelled about "Night Howlers" before attacking him. Before he can explain more, Manchas suddenly turns savage himself, and pursues them. Judy alerts the ZPD, but Manchas vanishes before backup arrives. Bogo demands Judy's resignation, but Nick reminds him there are still a few hours left. Nick later reveals to Judy that he was bullied as a child, and has resigned himself to always being seen as a "shifty fox".
At City Hall, Assistant Mayor Dawn Bellwether allows them access to Zootopia's traffic cameras, which reveal Manchas was abducted by timberwolves, whom Judy assumes are the Night Howlers. Following the wolves to an asylum, Judy and Nick locate Emmitt and the other missing predators, who are all "savage". Mayor Leodore Lionheart had imprisoned them to prevent citywide hysteria, and to protect the public, and his career. After Judy and Nick alert the ZPD, Lionheart and the asylum staff are arrested, Bellwether becomes the new mayor, and the missing animals are hospitalized. Judy, praised for solving the case, invites Nick to join the ZPD as her partner. At a press conference, Judy inadvertently suggests that the predators' physiology caused their feral behavior. Deeply hurt, Nick leaves, and Judy's comments incite fear and discrimination against predators throughout Zootopia. Wracked with guilt over causing the panic Lionheart tried to prevent, Judy resigns from the ZPD and returns to Bunnyburrow.

overview: A former soldier is taken captive and awakens in the back of a van where he learns that he only has less than 10 minutes to figure out how he got there.

Ex-soldier Ryan Reeve wakes up in the back of a moving van next to a young tied-up boy, Alex, who is being held prisoner. Strangely, the boy seems to think Reeve is the kidnapper though he has no memory of ever having seen the boy before, and looking at his watch, he last remembered it being six months previously. After freeing the boy, making a run for it, and attempting to figure out what has happened to him, all he remembers is being at a facility treating his severe PTSD. As one of their pursuers catches up to them, suddenly he blacks out again and awakes in a room with a mysterious young man (same as before) named Harkin Langham, who seems to think he is someone else.
When Langham discovers who he really is, he disables Reeve and knocks him out. Reeve then wakes up in a mysterious bedroom having sex with a beautiful young woman. She identifies herself as a prostitute named Dana, who seems to remember meeting and engaging in sexual activity with a much more violent and sociopathic version of Reeve. He tries to explain his predicament, but she remains skeptical. He asks her to come with him, but she says she cannot leave as she is the "property" of a Russian gangster named Sergio. Reeve offers to free her if she will help him solve the mystery that his life has become. The two manage to escape, but Reeve again loses consciousness when the mind control system reboots and again Langham catches up to him.
He must work out what is happening in bursts of exactly nine minutes and forty-seven seconds, as the control and conscious awareness of his body are repeatedly being hijacked and shuffled through different scenarios by person/s unknown. He teams up with Dana as he battles a conspiracy in mind control known as "Anomaly" led by Langham. Langham, meanwhile, urges him to stop fighting it, as it has nothing to do with him, however, he is convinced otherwise.

title: The Last Survivors
tagline: Stand your ground.
overview: In the near future, society collapses and water becomes scarce. When a greedy water baron starts violently clearing out survivors, Kendal, a 17-year-old teenager, fights the baron's henchman to keep a well open.
plot:
The Last Survivors, originally titled The Well, is a 2014 American post-apocalyptic thriller film directed by Thomas Hammock and written by Hammock and Jacob Forman. Haley Lu Richardson stars as a resourceful teenage girl struggling to survive a decade-long drought, with Booboo Stewart, Max Charles, Michael Welch and Rena Owen. The film premiered at the Los Angeles Film Festival on June 12, 2014.

Ten years after the rain stopped falling, rural Oregon has become a parched wasteland where survivors fight over the last water. Kendal, an orphan, cares for Dean, a fellow orphan who is dying of kidney failure. Her friend Gabriel, who lives with his family on a neighboring farm, urges her to join them, but she refuses to abandon Dean. Responding one day to a radio call for help, Kendal discovers it is a trap and can only watch as raiders slaughter a neighboring family.

As the local wells run dry, Dean suspects that Carson, a warlord who runs a fortified compound he promotes as a refuge, has drilled down to the aquifer and is draining the water from beneath the surrounding farms. When Carson arrives to collect Kendal's neighbor Grace, he coldly kills most of Gabriel's family, saying they are too old or weak to be worth the water, and spares only Gabriel, who reluctantly joins him. Kendal kills a guard and escapes. She and Dean hope to flee in an old Cessna airplane they have almost restored, needing only a distributor cap, which she recovers from a car inside Carson's compound. She also looks in on Alby, a young boy surviving alone.

When three desperate strangers come to the house, Dean persuades Kendal to give them water, but they return to steal the rest and Dean, barely able to walk, shoots them. The gunfire draws Carson's men, and Dean is killed after taking several of them with him. Arming herself with a katana taken from a grave on Grace's farm, Kendal returns and kills the men searching her home, among them a masked Gabriel. Discovering that Carson has abducted Alby, she storms the compound alone, kills his henchmen, and defeats Carson and his daughter, Brooke, in brutal fights. Kendal and Alby then start up the repaired plane and prepare to fly away, leaving Dean behind.

The film received generally positive reviews; Rotten Tomatoes reported 75% approval from 12 critics. Critics praised its distinctive setting and Richardson's performance, though some found the story unoriginal.

title: Skiptrace
tagline: Ready. Set. Panic.
overview: A detective from Hong Kong teams up with an American gambler to battle against a notorious Chinese criminal.
plot:
Skiptrace is a 2016 buddy cop action comedy film directed by Renny Harlin and based on a story by Jackie Chan, who also produced it and stars as Hong Kong detective Bennie Chan. Johnny Knoxville co-stars as the American gambler Connor Watts, with Fan Bingbing as Samantha Bai, Eric Tsang as Yung Bai, Winston Chao as Victor Wong and Eve Torres as Dasha. First announced in 2013 as a Sino-American co-production, the film originally cast Seann William Scott as Connor before Knoxville replaced him in 2014. Filming began in China in September 2014; during the shoot, cinematographer Chan Kwok-hung drowned.

In Hong Kong in 2007, detective Bennie Chan is hunting the notorious crime boss known as the Matador, whom he believes to be businessman Victor Wong. During the pursuit, Chan's partner Yung Bai is captured and apparently sacrifices himself, leaving Chan his watch. Nine years later, when Yung's daughter Samantha falls foul of Wong's syndicate, Chan sets out to find Connor Watts, an American conman banned from casinos at home who witnessed the murder of a woman named Esther Yee in Wong's casino in Macau. Before Chan can reach him, Connor is seized by the henchmen of Dima, a Russian kingpin whose daughter Natalya he has made pregnant, and Chan has to fight his way through the Russians to rescue him. Their journey back to Hong Kong turns into a cross-country odyssey when Connor burns Chan's passport, forcing the mismatched pair to travel overland through Mongolia and into China, pursued by the Siberian hitwoman Dasha and her gang. Along the way Connor reveals that Esther gave him a phone belonging to the Matador, and the pair learn that Wong's men have taken Samantha hostage and will kill her unless the phone is returned. After evidence against Wong falls apart and Chan is jailed, Connor helps him break out, and the duo follow the trail to a shipyard, where they discover the Matador's true identity, a betrayal that strikes at the heart of Chan's past.

Skiptrace was released in China on July 21, 2016, where it opened at number one, and in the United States on September 2, 2016. It grossed CN¥870 million at the Chinese box office. Critics were mixed, with a 38% Rotten Tomatoes rating, though Variety found it lively and good-natured.
