title: Scooby-Doo! Frankencreepy
tagline: Scooby-Doo and those "meddling kids" Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are back in this all-new adventure!
overview: Scooby-Doo and those "meddling kids" Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are back in this all-new original movie! Velma discovers she's inherited her great-great-uncle Dr. Von Dinkenstein’s cursed castle in the terrifying town of Transylvania…Pennsylvania, that is. Just when the Gang persuades Velma to go claim her inheritance, the ghost of Dinkenstein Castle blows up the Mystery Machine as a warning! Now the Crew must spring back into action, but this time it's personal! Who's responsible for the Dinkenstein monster? What family secret has Velma been hiding? Will Fred recover from the loss of his beloved Mystery Machine? Can any helpless snack survive Scooby and Shaggy's monster-sized appetites? This Scooby-Doo adventure has enough spooky fun to make the whole family come alive!
plot:
Velma is notified by Cuthbert Crawley, a lawyer for her family, about inheriting her great uncle's castle in the Germany-influenced Pennsylvanian town of Transylvania. At his office, Velma turns the offer down, replying that she wants nothing to do with her uncle, puzzling her friends. Crawley understands, but soon reveals there is a curse over the property and those who fall victim to it will lose what they love dearly. As the gang leaves, the Mystery Machine is soon destroyed by a mysterious figure wearing an iron mask that is revealed to be the ghost of Velma's baron ancestor. The Mystery Machine's destruction then leaves behind a warning that advises the gang against visiting Transylvania, but Fred declares that is where they are going to find the perpetrator.
Out of options, the gang travel to Transylvania via an express train. When pressured by the gang, Velma reveals the truth about her ancestry – her actual surname is Von Dinkenstein and the baron's ghost is likely her ancestor, Basil, who was said to have created a monster, which inspired Mary Shelley to conceive her novel, Frankenstein. When the train suddenly starts to pick up speed as the gang gets its passengers to safety in the last car, they find the Baron at the front of a train instead of its conductor as he sabotages the train's control panel before informing the gang that the Von Dinkenstein curse is now in effect and disappearing. The gang manage to save the last car, everyone on it and themselves just as the train derails and is destroyed after crashing into a clock tower. As the gang arrive in town, they are introduced to Inspector Krunch, its burgermeister and hunchback Iago, who takes them to the castle, where they meet its housekeeper, Mrs. Vanders. They arrive in its laboratory and find the supposed monster preserved in a block of ice. Perturbed by this revelation, Velma vows to recreate the experiment in order to prove the falsehood of the monster's existence. As the rest of the gang leave, Vanders shows Velma a machine, which hypnotizes her.
Strange things begin to happen when the gang goes to a festival being held in the town – Daphne enters a state of vulnerability upon finding that she has suddenly gained some form of morbid obesity after trying on a dirndl at a local clothes shop; Shaggy and Scooby win an eating contest, but upon trying on some handmade lederhosen, they suddenly lose their appetites and develop a sense of courage; and Fred continues to mourn over the Mystery Machine – the former two later being revealed to be caused by the Von Dinkenstein curse. Iago then arrives and saves the gang, who soon become threatened by the townspeople, and informs them that Velma has gone insane.
When they return, Velma has appeared to have indeed lost her sanity due to her success in bringing the monster back to life.

title: Jarhead 2: Field of Fire
tagline: Find the courage, fight together.
overview: Battle-scarred and disillusioned by the war, Corporal Chris Merrimette is put in charge of a unit whose next mission is to resupply a remote outpost on the edge of Taliban-controlled territory. While driving through the hostile Helmand province, a Navy SEAL flags down their convoy and enlists the unit on an operation of international importance: they must help an Afghan woman famous for her defiance of the Taliban escape the country. Without tanks or air support, Merrimette and his team will need all the courage and firepower they can muster to fight their way across the war-torn country and shepherd the woman to safety.
plot:
Jarhead 2: Field of Fire is a 2014 American direct-to-video war film directed by Don Michael Paul from a screenplay by Berkeley Anderson and Ellis Black. Although it borrows its title from Sam Mendes's Jarhead (2005), it is a sequel in name only, with an unrelated story and characters set during the war in Afghanistan. Josh Kelly stars as Corporal Chris Merrimette, with Cole Hauser as Navy SEAL Fox and Stephen Lang, Esai Morales, Bokeem Woodbine and Danielle Savre in supporting roles.

Merrimette, a Marine who has grown battle-scarred and disillusioned with the war, is given command of a tight-knit unit for the first time. Their assignment seems routine for a supply detachment: drive a convoy through some of the most dangerous Taliban-held territory in Helmand province to resupply a remote outpost at the edge of enemy-controlled ground. On the way, however, they are flagged down by Fox, a special operations officer who tells them their mission has changed. He is escorting Anoosh, an Afghan woman who has become famous for defying the Taliban and a symbol of resistance to them, and she must be brought to safety so she can deliver a speech at the United Nations.

The operation quickly turns into a fight for survival. Taliban forces ambush the Marines, inflicting casualties and leaving them no way back to the Green Zone except on foot, and the survivors must cross hostile country with no communication and no air support, and with only Fox's experience of the land and its people to guide them. Merrimette, whose experience until now has been limited to supply runs, must hold his unit together and protect Anoosh as they fight their way through one of the most dangerous places on Earth, while tensions flare between some of the Marines and their local allies and interpreters before giving way to mutual respect. As the Taliban close in, the Marines must rely on their courage and firepower to see Anoosh to safety, at heavy cost.

Released on home video and digital platforms in 2014, the film was followed by Jarhead 3: The Siege (2016) and Jarhead: Law of Return (2019). Common Sense Media judged it a better-than-expected war movie that conveys the Marines' esprit de corps and does not shy away from casualties, despite a formulaic story, while DVD Talk called it markedly average in concept, performances and script.

title: Barbie and the Secret Door
tagline: You never know what you can do unless you try.
overview: It's the ultimate fairytale musical! Barbie stars as Alexa, a shy princess who discovers a secret door in her kingdom and enters a whimsical land filled with magical creatures and surprises. Inside, Alexa meets Romy and Nori, a mermaid and a fairy, who explain that a spoiled ruler named Malucia is trying to take all the magic in the land. To her surprise, Alexa has magical powers in this world, and her new friends are certain that only she can restore their magic. Discover what happens when Alexa finds the courage to stand up for what's right and learns that the power of friendship is far more precious than magic.
plot:
Barbie and the Secret Door is a computer-animated musical fantasy of 2014 directed by Karen Lloyd, the 28th entry in the Barbie film series. Kelly Sheridan voices Princess Alexa, with Brittany McDonald providing her singing voice, Ashleigh Ball as the fairy Nori, Chanelle Peloso as the mermaid Romy and Tabitha St. Germain as the villainous child princess Malucia; Christopher Gaze, Andrea Libman and Andrew Francis are also in the cast.

Alexa is the shy princess of a modern-day kingdom who shrinks from her royal duties. To encourage her, her grandmother gives her a storybook about a princess who discovers she has magic, and while reading it Alexa finds a hidden door in the palace gardens. Stepping through, she lands in the magical land of Zinnia, where her dress is transformed and a wand appears in her hair. She meets Nori, a fairy who has lost her wings, and Romy, a mermaid who has legs instead of a tail, both thrilled that a princess has arrived to fix their troubles.

Their realm is menaced by Malucia, a spoiled young princess born without magic, who seizes it by force from every creature she can catch and stores it in her sceptre. In a glade where fairies, mermaids and unicorns hide from her, Alexa slowly learns to use her wand but cannot restore her friends, whose magic is trapped in the sceptre. Hoping to protect the Queen Unicorn, the most magical being in the realm, the three set out to find her but unwittingly lead Malucia and her minions to her, and the queen is captured. Alexa finds the door home yet chooses to stay. At Malucia's palace the friends watch the villain drain the unicorns' magic, and Alexa challenges her to a magical duel over who is the true princess. Noticing that the overloaded sceptre is cracking, Alexa lets Malucia take all her magic, and the sceptre bursts, releasing every stolen power. Now able to work magic without a wand, Alexa returns it to its owners and goes home with new confidence, while Malucia's parents come back from holiday and scold her for her schemes.

The film features songs such as "If I Had Magic" and "I Want It All", with a soundtrack album released in August 2014. It was released on DVD on 16 September 2014, debuted on Nickelodeon that November, and grossed about $2 million in limited theatrical runs overseas.

title: Lava
overview: Inspired by the isolated beauty of tropical islands and the explosive allure of ocean volcanoes, Lava is a musical love story that takes place over millions of years.
plot:
Lava is a 2014 animated film by Pixar that tells the story of two volcanoes, Ma and Kai, who fall in love despite being destined to erupt at the same time. The movie explores the theme of self-discovery and the importance of embracing one's true nature.

Ma, the older volcano, is content with her life, but feels a sense of restlessness as she approaches her eruption date. She longs for something more, but isn't sure what that is. Kai, on the other hand, is young and carefree, but struggles to find his place in the world. As they spend more time together, they learn to accept and appreciate each other's differences.

The film also touches on the theme of letting go and accepting change. Ma and Kai must come to terms with their impending eruption and the fact that their love may not be meant to last. The movie shows how they can find happiness in the present moment, even if it means embracing uncertainty and impermanence.

Overall, Lava is a heartwarming story about finding one's true self and learning to love and accept others for who they are.

title: The Martian
tagline: Bring Him Home
overview: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.
plot:
The Martian is a 2015 American science fiction film directed by Ridley Scott, based on the novel of the same name by Andy Weir. The movie follows the story of astronaut Mark Watney, played by Matt Damon.

The film begins with the Ares III mission to Mars, where Watney and his crew are sent to explore the planet's surface. During a severe dust storm, the crew is forced to evacuate, but in the chaos, Watney is presumed dead and left behind. However, he manages to survive the storm by using his ingenuity and knowledge of botany.

As the days pass, Watney realizes that he has become stranded on Mars with limited supplies and no communication with Earth. He uses his skills as a botanist to grow food in the Martian soil, which becomes crucial for his survival. Meanwhile, back on Earth, NASA's mission control team, led by Vincent Kapoor (Chiwetel Ejiofor), discovers Watney's transmission signal and realizes that he is still alive.

The crew of the Hermes spaceship, which was sent to rescue Watney, returns to Mars with a new plan to extract him. However, due to the harsh Martian environment and limited resources, they face numerous challenges in their mission. The team also faces opposition from NASA's director, Ted Mendez (Mackenzie Davis), who is skeptical of the crew's ability to save Watney.

As the story unfolds, Watney uses his wit and resourcefulness to overcome various obstacles, including a malfunctioning toilet that threatens to kill him, and a Martian dust storm that could destroy his habitat. He also uses his knowledge of botany to create a makeshift food source, which becomes essential for his survival.

Meanwhile, back on Earth, the crew of the Hermes spaceship faces their own challenges as they try to come up with a plan to rescue Watney. The team's dynamics are put to the test as they work together to overcome the odds and save their stranded colleague.

The film's climax features an intense and suspenseful sequence where the Hermes crew finally manages to extract Watney from Mars, but not before he has to make a difficult decision that could have potentially saved his life. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Watney returning to Earth as a hero, thanks to the ingenuity and determination of the crew.

Throughout the film, Ridley Scott's direction brings out the best in Matt Damon's performance, capturing the character's wit, humor, and resilience in the face of adversity. The supporting cast, including Chiwetel Ejiofor, Mackenzie Davis, and Jessica Chastain, deliver strong performances that add depth to the story.

Overall, The Martian is a gripping and inspiring film that showcases the power of human ingenuity and determination in the face of seemingly insurmountable challenges.

title: Bokeh
overview: On a romantic getaway to Iceland, a young American couple wake up one morning to discover every person on Earth has disappeared. Their struggle to survive and to reconcile the mysterious event lead them to reconsider everything they know about themselves and the world.
plot:
Bokeh is a 2017 science fiction drama film written and directed by Geoffrey Orthwein and Andrew Sullivan. Maika Monroe and Matt O'Leary star as Jenai and Riley, two American tourists in Iceland who wake one morning to find that everyone else on the island has vanished. Arnar Jónsson plays Nils, an old man they meet later, with Gunnar Helgason as Ivar.

Jenai and Riley tour Iceland's landmarks, with Riley shooting on his father's old Rolleiflex because he prefers to capture the imperfections of a moment rather than let a digital camera correct them. At an old church, a priest speaks of simpler pre-Christian times, and Jenai mentions that her own father is a preacher. During the night Jenai sees strange flashes of light in the sky, and the next morning the pair find their lodging deserted. The city's streets and shops are empty, nobody answers their calls, Jenai cannot reach her family in America, and television shows only test signals, though power and water still work. Riley chooses to treat the situation as an adventure, taking a car, filling two SUVs with goods from abandoned stores and photographing Jenai against the empty scenery, but Jenai sinks into depression and longs for her old life. Tensions grow over Riley's reckless stunts and over how to ration their dwindling supplies. On a camping trip they meet Nils, an elderly survivor who had retreated to his cabin; his fatalistic view that it is useless to fight against a God indifferent to humanity disturbs Jenai, and when he dies the next morning she wonders why they should bother burying him, while Riley insists on doing so because it is what people do. Back in the city Jenai becomes obsessed with searching for other survivors, while Riley urges her to stop looking for answers and make the best of their new life, a divide that leads to tragedy.

Bokeh premiered at the Santa Barbara International Film Festival on February 3, 2017, and was released in the United States by Screen Media Films on March 24, 2017, with a DVD release from Cinedigm in April. Reviews were mixed: Rotten Tomatoes reports that 43% of 21 critics gave it a positive review, and it holds a Metacritic score of 56.

title: TEKKEN: A Man Called X
tagline: Survival Is No Game
overview: A young man, Kazuya Mishima, wakes up alone in an unfamiliar hotel room without any recollection of who he is or how he got there. He is tormented by flashes of his past and by the face of an ominous stranger. The next thing he knows, Kazuya is ambushed and kidnapped by an underground crime organization and, soon after, turned into a ruthless assassin.  During a mission to assassinate a man named Brian Fury, Kazuya finds that his target harbors clues to his true identity. With the help of Fury and a female assassin, Kazuya follows the clues, leading him to the lab of his reoccurring flashbacks. Here, he will finally confront his past and the ominous man of his nightmares - Heihachi Mishima, face the ultimate betrayal, and Ieam the truth about who, and what, he really is.  TEKKEN 2: KAZUYA’S REVENGE is non-stop action from the first scene to the last.
plot:
Tekken 2: Kazuya's Revenge, also released as Tekken: A Man Called X, is a 2014 American martial arts film directed by Wych Kaos and written by Nicole Jones and Steven Paul. It is based on Bandai Namco's Tekken fighting game series and serves as a prequel to the first live-action Tekken film. SP Distribution released it direct to video in the United States on August 12, 2014.

A young Japanese man with no memory of his past wakes in an apartment outside Tekken City, is chased by armed men and captured by the assassin Rhona Anders. She brings him to a guerrilla leader called the Minister, who gives him the code name "K" and has an explosive implanted in his chest to punish failure or desertion. Despite his amnesia, K is an expert fighter and marksman. He befriends a crippled janitor whose son attacked him and disappeared years earlier, and he refuses the Minister's order to kill either the janitor or a defeated sparring partner, whom a henchman then kills. While carrying out assassinations, K also befriends Laura, a nurse in his building, after saving her from muggers, and she later removes the bomb from his chest. Back at the apartment where he woke up, he learns he had signed in only as "K. M."

One of K's targets, Bryan Fury, beats him and warns him to quit. Fury, a former associate of the Minister, later tells K and Rhona that they are all pawns and that the Minister now wants K dead. Rhona turns on the Minister and stabs him, but Laura is kidnapped and taken to the Gentek factory. Inside, K meets Heihachi Mishima, who reveals that K is his son, Kazuya, brainwashed and set loose to test his ability to survive, much like the Spartan custom of leaving boys in the wild. Heihachi has also brainwashed Laura, changing her personality, and he kills her just after she and Kazuya share a kiss. Kazuya defeats the fighters Rip and Thorn, accepts his heritage and sets off with Rhona to find Heihachi.

Kane Kosugi plays Kazuya, with Kelly Wenham as Rhona, Rade Šerbedžija as the Minister and Paige Lindquist as Laura. Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa and Gary Daniels return from the earlier film as Heihachi and Bryan Fury, and Sahajak Boonthanakit plays the janitor. Manly Movie scored it 3 out of 10, arguing that the filmmakers had little understanding of or interest in the game's characters and had simply cast whichever actors were available for cameos.

title: Two Night Stand
tagline: Before love. After sex.
overview: After an extremely regrettable one night stand, two strangers wake up to find themselves snowed in after sleeping through a blizzard that put all of Manhattan on ice. They're now trapped together in a tiny apartment, forced to get to know each other way more than any one night stand should.
plot:
Megan is unemployed and single, and one day she joins a dating website. Her roommates, who just want her to move out, invite her to a party at a club. After a bouncer refuses to let her into the club on the grounds that she looks too young and she did not have her ID, she runs into her ex-fiancé, Chris, and later decides to have a one-night stand with one of the men she found on the website, Alec.
The next morning, they are less than cordial to each other, but Megan is unable to leave because of a blizzard. Forced to spend more time together, the two end up telling each other what they did wrong the previous night, convinced that they will never see each other again, and Megan suggests that they "try again". The two have sex again, with far better results.
Afterwards, Megan discovers a closet full of women's clothes, and pictures of Alec with a girl. She learns that Alec's girlfriend, Daisy, had written a note to him, saying that she wanted to break up, but had not given it to him, but he had found it accidentally. Alec wanted to have something to rub in her face when she broke up with him, and so he had joined the dating website. Angry, Megan leaves.
When Daisy returns, she finds a note that Megan had scribbled, and she and Alec exchange the notes that they had found, and they break up. At a New Year's Eve party, Megan is arrested because the same note was found in Alec's neighbor's apartment, which the two had broken into earlier. Alec arrives at the jail with flowers and balloons. He pays her bail, but Megan refuses to see him or even leave the holding cell.
Later, when her roommates come to pay bail, Alec apologizes, saying that he did not know her last name and that this was the only way he thought he could see her again. He says that it might be something that the two of them would laugh about years later, but Megan is still angry because she had to spend time in jail. She makes him a deal, asking for his number and promising to call him the moment she laughed about it. She takes a closer look at the presents he gave her. Minutes later, she starts laughing upon seeing the balloon that reads "I'm sorry, I'm an asshole" and calls Alec. He meets her outside the police station and they kiss in the middle of the road, when it starts snowing again.

title: Max Steel
tagline: Unleash your power.
overview: The adventures of teenager Max McGrath and alien companion Steel, who must harness and combine their tremendous new powers to evolve into the turbo-charged superhero Max Steel.
plot:
Max Steel is a 2016 American superhero film based on Mattel's action-figure line of the same name, directed by Stewart Hendler and written by Christopher Yost. It stars Ben Winchell as the teenager Max McGrath and Josh Brener as the voice of his alien companion Steel, with Ana Villafañe, Andy García and Maria Bello in supporting roles. It was co-produced by Mattel's Playground Productions with Dolphin Films and Ingenious Media and released by Open Road Films on October 14, 2016.

After years of moving from place to place, Max and his mother, Molly, return to Copper Canyon, the town where he was born and where his father, Jim, died in what was described as a storm. Max discovers that everyone seems to know more about his father than he does, since Molly refuses to discuss him. Jim's old friend Miles Edwards tells Max that his father worked at N-Tek, a research company that Miles now runs. Meanwhile, Max begins to emit a powerful, uncontrollable form of energy that overloads electrical devices. During a date with his classmate Sofia, he feels an overload coming and encounters Steel, a small, wisecracking alien who bonds with him and absorbs the excess energy.

Pursued by mysterious armed men, the two learn to work together, and Max discovers that by merging with Steel he can form an armored suit and control his powers. Glimpses of his father's past, shared through Steel's memories, reveal attacks by hostile aliens called Ultralinks. After Max and Steel defeat one of these beings, which looks like Steel, a memory suggests that Steel was responsible for Jim's death, and Max angrily turns on him.

When Molly is kidnapped, Max learns that Miles is behind everything. At the abandoned N-Tek facility where Jim died, a fuller memory reveals the truth: Jim was himself an alien who naturally produced the energy, Steel was his partner, and Miles, addicted to the power, conspired with the Ultralinks to steal it. Jim sacrificed himself to stop him, asking Steel to protect his son. Wearing an energy-draining suit, Miles attacks, but Max and Steel, now fully united as Max Steel, generate more energy than he can absorb, and he is destroyed in the resulting explosion.

Filmed in Wilmington, North Carolina, in 2014, Max Steel was released without advance press screenings and panned by critics as generic and forgettable, and it grossed only about $6 million worldwide against a $10 million budget.

title: A Good Man
overview: After an illustrious special ops career ends in disaster, Alexander goes off the grid and attempts to lead a quiet life as a handyman at an apartment complex. But when one of his tenants and her family fall under the thumb of a Russian gangster, Alexander is dragged into an all-out war between rival Chinese and Russian gangs; forcing him to not only defend the family, but bringing him face to face with an old foe, and giving him one more chance to reconcile his past.
plot:
A Good Man is a 2014 American action film directed by Keoni Waxman, starring Steven Seagal as John Alexander, with Victor Webster as Sasha, Tzi Ma as Mr. Chen, Iulia Verdes as Lena, Claudiu Bleont as Vladimir and Sofia Nicolaescu as Mya. The fifth collaboration between Seagal and Waxman, it serves as a prequel to Force of Execution and was followed by a sequel, Absolution, in 2015. It was shot in Romania over three weeks.

Alexander leads a covert operation on the border of Dagestan targeting an Islamic terrorist and Mr. Chen, an arms dealer financing terrorism. The mission goes disastrously wrong: Alexander's whole team is killed and Chen escapes. Years later, Alexander lives quietly in Romania, where he befriends his neighbor Lena and her younger sister Mya. Their brother Sasha collects protection money for the local mafia to pay off their father's debt and keep his sisters safe.

Lena works in a club owned by the mafia boss Vladimir, who warns Alexander to keep away from her. When Alexander refuses, a fight breaks out in which he kills three of Vladimir's men and leaves with a bag containing 300,000 dollars. The money, it turns out, belongs to Mr. Chen, who has been using the club to launder funds for one of his buyers. Chen gives Vladimir 24 hours to return the cash or hand Lena over as compensation. Vladimir blames Sasha and sends hitmen after him, then decides to take young Mya instead of Lena for Chen's buyer. Sasha, who survives the attempt on his life, is given a short deadline to repay the debt, while Alexander kidnaps Vladimir and forces him to reveal where Mya is being held. The search leads Alexander back to the man he failed to stop years earlier, setting up a final confrontation in which he must rescue Mya and settle his old score with Chen.

The film combines Seagal's close-quarters fights and a climactic sword duel with a vigilante story about protecting the innocent, set against an Eastern European criminal underworld.

A Good Man was released by Lionsgate Entertainment on August 19, 2014. It received mixed to negative reviews, with one critic describing it as not a good movie with only a basic story of vigilantism.

title: Northmen: A Viking Saga
tagline: There's No Time To Bleed
overview: A band of Vikings cross enemy lines and a panicked race begins. The losers will pay with their lives.
plot:
A group of exiled Vikings, under the leadership of Asbjörn, are stranded on the coast of Scotland after their ship sinks in a storm. There, they are attacked by soldiers who are escorting the princess Inghean, who is on her way to be married. The Vikings defeat the soldiers and take Inghean with them as a hostage with the intent of ransoming her for money to buy entry into a friendly land. Along the way, they meet a Christian monk who grants them aid and shelter. Meanwhile, Inghean's father, King Dunchaid, tasks a mercenary force to pursue the Vikings; knowing of Inghean's distaste for their group, the mercenary leaders plan to kill both her and the Vikings, an order not out of character for the tyrant king. The group, including the princess, learn of their plan from a captured soldier.
As the mercenaries attack the tower where the monk and the Vikings are sheltered, the group manages to escape and stay ahead of their pursuers. The monk offers to show the Vikings the way to the Viking settlements of the Danelaw, where they would be safe. Along the way, they are repeatedly attacked by the mercenaries, but the Vikings eventually defeat them, suffering some casualties. After reaching a cliffside with transport to Danelaw, the survivors find themselves trapped by King Dunchaid and his troops. Asbjörn jumps into the water, seemingly to his death, but manages to retrieve a boat from an underwater cave. The surviving Vikings jump after him, joined by the monk and Inghean, who elects to stay with the group. Together, the group rows towards the Danelaw.

tagline: Never underestimate two girls with a plan.
overview: Mae and Gabby are two friends who go everywhere together but they are not very popular in their school. plot:
How to Build a Better Boy is a 2014 American science fiction teen romantic comedy made as a Disney Channel Original Movie, directed by Paul Hoen and written by Jason Mayland. Kelli Berglund plays Mae Hartley and China Anne McClain her best friend, Gabby Harrison, with Marshall Williams as Albert, Matt Shively as Bart Hartley, Ashley Argota as Nevaeh, Noah Centineo as Jaden and Roger Bart as Mae's father.

Mae and Gabby are bright tenth graders. Mae has a crush on Jaden, a jock she tutors, and hopes he will invite her to the homecoming dance, but she is publicly humiliated by Jaden's girlfriend, the mean cheerleader Nevaeh, and blurts out that she already has a boyfriend. To cover the lie, Gabby uses software called X-17, which they think Mae's father, Dr. James Hartley, uses to design video game characters, to program a virtual boyfriend to Mae's specifications. Mae names him Albert. When the program crashes the computer, Mae's brother, Bart, fixes it in exchange for Gabby's going to homecoming with him.

The next morning Albert turns up at school, where his superhuman speed and strength make him instantly popular. Bart and Gabby discover that she has hacked into the Pentagon and activated a prototype robot soldier, and that James actually works for the Pentagon, while General McFee learns that the X-17 is missing. Albert asks Mae to homecoming, and despite misgivings and a quarrel with Gabby, she accepts. Agents of the arms-dealing group Black Sigma hunt for the robot. At a football game, Albert leads a comeback before Black Sigma knocks out the power with an electromagnetic pulse that damages his circuits. The Army captures the criminals, and Albert leaves on a global mission. Told to forget him, Mae still believes he will come to the dance, and he does. McFee agrees to let Albert complete his mission of kissing Mae, and the Army rigs the vote to make them homecoming king and queen. Nevaeh is dumped by Jaden, who admits he was too shy to ask Mae out. When Albert leans in, Mae pulls back, realizing she wants a real relationship rather than a perfect one. Impressed, Albert asks her to trigger his self-destruct, and he bursts through the roof and explodes. Jaden asks Mae out, the friends reconcile, and Gabby reveals that she is now dating Bart.

The film was shot in Toronto, mainly at North Toronto Collegiate Institute, in the summer of 2013. Its Disney Channel premiere on August 15, 2014, drew 4.6 million viewers.

title: The Town that Dreaded Sundown
tagline: In 1946, a mysterious hooded killer terrorised Texarkana. In 1976, he was immortalised in the silver screen. Now, the maniac is back…
overview: A masked maniac terrorizes the same small community where a murderer known as the Phantom Killer struck decades earlier.
plot:
The Town That Dreaded Sundown is a 2014 American slasher film directed by Alfonso Gomez-Rejon and written by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa. First planned as a remake of the 1976 film of the same name, it was reworked into a metafictional sequel that references the original and the real Phantom Killer murders of 1946. It was among the last films of Ed Lauter and Edward Herrmann. After screenings at Fantastic Fest, Beyond Fest and the BFI London Film Festival, Orion Pictures released it in select US theaters on October 16, 2014, alongside a video-on-demand release through Blumhouse's BH Tilt label.

In present-day Texarkana, a drive-in holds its annual Halloween screening of the 1976 film. Afterward, a masked killer dressed as the Phantom murders Corey Holland and spares his girlfriend, Jami Lerner, telling her, "This is for Mary. Make them remember." As more couples are slaughtered, Texas Ranger Lone Wolf Morales takes over the case, while Jami, guarded by Deputy Foster, investigates the history of the killings with former classmate Nick Strain. A teenager in a Phantom costume is killed at a vigil, briefly convincing the town the murderer is dead, but the killings continue, claiming Deputy Tillman among others. Reverend Cartwright turns out to have sent Jami an email posing as the killer, though police do not believe he is the Phantom.

Jami and Nick track down Charles B. Pierce Jr., who tells them about Hank McCreedy, a forgotten sixth victim of the 1946 Phantom whose wife was named Mary, and suggests the new killer is McCreedy's vengeful grandson. Jami and Nick sleep together before she plans to leave for college in California, but Nick is murdered, and her grandmother, Lillian, is shot dead at a gas station as they flee town. In the old Union train station, Jami is wounded and confronted by two Phantoms: Deputy Foster, McCreedy's grandson, and Corey, who faked his death because he felt trapped by his life and craved notoriety. Foster kills Corey, planning to frame him and Jami, but Jami shoots Foster, whose body is never found. She starts a new life elsewhere, still shadowed by the Phantom.

Addison Timlin plays Jami, with Travis Tope as Nick, Spencer Treat Clark as Corey, Veronica Cartwright as Lillian, Gary Cole as Tillman, Anthony Anderson as Morales, Denis O'Hare as Pierce Jr. and Joshua Leonard as Foster. Reviews were moderately positive, with 66% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Tom and Jerry: The Lost Dragon
original_title: Tom and Jerry: The Lost Dragon
overview: Tom and Jerry find a dragon egg, and help the baby dragon find its mother.
plot:
Tom and Jerry: The Lost Dragon is a 2014 American animated fantasy comedy film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and directed and produced by Spike Brandt and Tony Cervone. It premiered at San Diego Comic-Con on July 27, 2014, before its digital release on August 19 and its DVD release on September 2, 2014. It was the first direct-to-video Tom and Jerry film to be distributed in Japan by Warner Bros. Home Entertainment. The voice cast includes Kelly Stables, Vicki Lewis, Jim Cummings, Laraine Newman and Greg Ellis.

In a magical land, the wizard Kaldorf banishes the wicked witch Drizelda from an elf village for her many crimes. He allows her mistreated young niece, Athena, to remain, but the villagers remain suspicious of the girl, fearing she will grow up to be like her aunt, especially because she keeps company with creatures they dislike: a mouse, Jerry, and a cat, Tom. In this version of the story, Tom and Jerry are introduced as babies who become rivals with each other while both being devoted to Athena.

Years later, the cat and mouse are still chasing one another as usual, while the teenage Athena looks after injured animals. One day the three of them stumble upon a mysterious glowing egg. None of them realises that it was stolen from an enormous fire-breathing dragon. The egg soon hatches into a baby dragon named Puffy, who immediately decides that Tom is his mother, and the trio set about caring for him, with the usual comic chaos that follows from raising a baby dragon.

Meanwhile, Puffy's real mother is furious at the loss of her baby and is determined to get him back, threatening the village. Before Tom, Jerry and Athena can reunite the two, Drizelda returns and kidnaps Puffy. Her plan is to drain the little dragon's fiery power so that she can turn herself into a super-dragon and take revenge on the village that cast her out.

With the help of powerful allies and their animal friends, Tom, Jerry and Athena join forces to defeat the witch and rescue Puffy. In the end Drizelda is turned to stone, Puffy is returned safely to his mother, and the villagers, Kaldorf, Athena and Jerry celebrate with a song, while Tom finds himself chased by Athena's pet crocodile. A post-credits scene hints that Drizelda is still alive inside the statue. Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, finding its story more emotionally engaging than most entries in the series.

title: 7 Days in Hell
tagline: The epic battle for epicness
overview: A fictional documentary-style expose on the rivalry between two tennis stars who battled it out in a 1999 match that lasted seven days.
plot:
7 Days in Hell is a 2015 sports mockumentary directed by Jake Szymanski and written by Murray Miller, inspired by the marathon match between John Isner and Nicolas Mahut at the 2010 Wimbledon Championships. Andy Samberg plays Aaron Williams and Kit Harington Charles Poole, with Fred Armisen, Lena Dunham, Will Forte, Karen Gillan, Howie Mandel, Michael Sheen, Mary Steenburgen and June Squibb as Queen Elizabeth II, and Jon Hamm as the narrator.

Framed as an HBO Sports documentary built around BBC footage, the film charts the rivalry between two players who meet in the longest match in tennis history. Williams, "the bad boy of tennis", is an American orphan found on the streets and adopted by Richard Williams, who raised him alongside Venus and Serena. In the 1996 Wimbledon final, his serve strikes a line judge, who dies of a heart attack; Williams loses, shoves Prince Edward during the ceremony and vanishes. Poole is a British prodigy pushed into the sport by a domineering mother who threatens to disown him if he loses, and at fifteen he tells a television host that he idolises Williams. Williams resurfaces in Sweden, where his underwear line is withdrawn for causing infertility, he sinks into pornography and drug addiction, and he ends up in prison.

Before Wimbledon in 2001, Poole tells a reporter that he is better than Williams. Hearing this, Williams breaks out of prison, which under Swedish law makes him a free man, and committee member Edward Pudding persuades the All England Club to let the 128th seed face Poole, the second seed, to boost interest. Poole wins the first set, but the match drags on for days, interrupted by rain, darkness, streakers with whom Williams has prolonged sex on court, a press conference at which Williams claims Engelbert Humperdinck as his father, and a drunken Queen who bribes, berates and finally assaults Poole. Williams is struck by a truck apparently driven by Poole and plays on with one arm, while Poole squanders triple match point when the illusionist David Copperfield appears on his shoulders. On the seventh day, after Williams leaks a sex tape of himself with Poole's ex-girlfriend Lily, the Queen allows the two to fight, and they kill each other with simultaneous blows of their rackets. They are buried in the same coffin.

It premiered on HBO on July 11, 2015, and was well received, earning 87% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 67, and features cameos by John McEnroe, Chris Evert and Serena Williams.

title: Krampus
tagline: You don't want to be on his list.
overview: When his dysfunctional family clashes over the holidays, young Max is disillusioned and turns his back on Christmas.  Little does he know, this lack of festive spirit has unleashed the wrath of Krampus: a demonic force of ancient evil intent on punishing non-believers.
plot:
Krampus is a 2015 American Christmas horror-comedy film directed by Michael Dougherty and written by Dougherty and Todd Farmer. The movie stars Adam Scott, Toni Collette, David Koechner, and Krista Stadler.

The story begins with a family, the Smiths, who are struggling to cope with the recent death of their son, Max, in a car accident. The family is still grieving, and tensions are running high between the parents, Howard (Scott) and Mary (Collette), as well as their daughter, Blair (Stadler). To make matters worse, they receive an eviction notice from their landlord, which forces them to spend Christmas with their eccentric and reclusive aunt, Eliza (Stadler).

As Christmas Eve approaches, the family is visited by a mysterious figure in a red suit, who claims to be Krampus, the half-goat, half-demon creature from Alpine folklore. According to legend, Krampus punishes naughty children during the holiday season, while his companion, Saint Nicholas, rewards the well-behaved ones.

As the night progresses, strange and terrifying events begin to occur around the Smiths' house. Blair starts acting out in increasingly disturbing ways, and her parents are forced to confront their own dark past and the true nature of Krampus. Meanwhile, a series of gruesome and supernatural events unfold, including the appearance of a demonic creature that seems to be connected to Krampus.

As the night wears on, the family is forced to face the consequences of their own actions and the true meaning of Christmas. In the end, they must make a choice between embracing the darkness and chaos brought by Krampus or finding redemption and forgiveness through love and sacrifice.

Throughout the movie, Dougherty expertly weaves together elements of horror, comedy, and family drama, creating a unique and unsettling viewing experience. The film's use of atmospheric tension, clever plot twists, and memorable performances make it a standout in the holiday horror genre.

Overall, Krampus is a dark and twisted take on traditional Christmas folklore, offering a fresh and frightening perspective on the holiday season. With its blend of humor, horror, and heart, this movie is sure to leave audiences feeling uneasy and entertained until the very end.

title: Shazam!
tagline: Just say the word.
overview: A boy is given the ability to become an adult superhero in times of need with a single magic word.
plot:
Shazam! is a 2019 American superhero film directed by David F. Sandberg and produced by New Line Cinema. The movie is based on the DC Comics character Captain Marvel, also known as Shazam.

The story follows Billy Batson (played by Asher Angel), an orphan boy who lives in foster care with his aunt and uncle. On his 14th birthday, Billy meets the enigmatic and powerful wizard Shazam (played by Zachary Levi), who reveals that he is the chosen one destined to wield incredible powers.

Shazam explains that Billy has been chosen to become a superhero when he says "I am Shazam!" three times in front of a magical mirror. The magic transforms Billy into an adult with superhuman strength, speed, agility, and endurance. However, this transformation also comes with great responsibility and the need to balance his new life as a superhero with his relationships and daily life.

As Billy navigates his new identity, he must confront the dark past of Shazam, who was once a powerful sorcerer named Thaddeus Sivana (played by Mark Strong). Sivana seeks revenge against those who wronged him in the past, including the wizard who imprisoned him and the people who destroyed his magical world.

As Billy struggles to balance his life as a superhero with his relationships and daily life, he must also confront the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana, who has returned from the dead to wreak havoc on the city of Rockville. With the help of his foster siblings, Mary (Faithe Herman) and Darin (Ian Chen), Billy must learn to harness his powers and work together with Shazam to stop Sivana's evil plans.

Throughout the movie, Billy learns valuable lessons about responsibility, friendship, and the importance of family. He also discovers that being a superhero is not just about having powers, but about using them for good and making sacrifices when necessary.

The movie features a mix of action, adventure, humor, and heart, with a strong focus on character development and relationships. The visual effects are impressive, bringing the magical world of Shazam to life in a way that is both fantastical and grounded.

Overall, Shazam! is a fun and entertaining superhero movie that explores themes of identity, responsibility, and the power of friendship. With its lighthearted tone and humor, it's a great choice for families and fans of the genre.

title: The Transporter Refueled
tagline: He Delivers.
overview: The fast-paced action movie is again set in the criminal underworld in France, where Frank Martin is known as The Transporter, because he is the best driver and mercenary money can buy. In this installment, he meets Anna and they attempt to take down a group of ruthless Russian human traffickers who also have kidnapped Frank’s father.
plot:
The Transporter Refueled (French: Le Transporteur: Héritage) is a 2015 action thriller directed by Camille Delamarre and written by Bill Collage, Adam Cooper and Luc Besson. The fourth Transporter film and a reboot of the series, it came about after EuropaCorp's talks with original star Jason Statham over a three-film deal broke down; Ed Skrein took over as Frank Martin, and no actors returned from the earlier films. Originally titled The Transporter Legacy, it was shot in Paris from August 2014. EuropaCorp released it in the United States on 4 September 2015 and in France five days later.

In 1995, Russian gangster Arkady Karasov and his partners Leo Imasov and Yuri seize control of prostitution on the French Riviera, among them a young Anna. Fifteen years later, Anna sets out to bring Karasov down. Frank Martin Jr., an ex-special forces operative who now works as a professional driver in his Audi S8, is with his father, Frank Sr., a retired secret agent, when Anna hires him for a job. Picking her up at a Monte Carlo bank, he finds three more women, Gina, Qiao and Maria, who show him live video of his father held at gunpoint and claim that Frank Sr. has been poisoned and will die without their antidote. Frank learns that all four were once Karasov's prostitutes, and that he himself shares a past with the gangster.

Forced to cooperate, Frank helps the women gas Imasov's rave club and take his fingerprints to empty his bank account into theirs, while Frank Sr. and Maria do the same to Yuri aboard his plane, where Maria is shot. Anna then admits the poison was a bluff. When Karasov kidnaps Frank Sr. and demands the women, Frank delivers them to his yacht, where Anna convinces Imasov and Yuri that Karasov stole their money. Gina, who had slipped away, secretly diverts the funds, and in the ensuing shootout Qiao and Maria are killed and Gina dies after killing Karasov's associate Maïssa. On a clifftop, Anna shoots Karasov, then cannot bring herself to shoot Frank, who realizes she arranged his father's kidnapping and persuades her to abandon revenge. A month later she shares the money among her friends' families and the Martins.

Skrein plays Frank, with Ray Stevenson as Frank Sr., Loan Chabanol as Anna, Gabriella Wright as Gina, Tatjana Pajković as Maria, Yu Wenxia as Qiao and Radivoje Bukvić as Karasov. Reviews were negative, with 15% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, though IGN felt Skrein made the role his own. It grossed $72.6 million, led by China.

title: Sleeping with Other People
tagline: A romantic comedy with commitment issues.
overview: Can two serial cheaters get a second chance at love? After a one-night stand in college, New Yorkers Lainey and Jake meet by chance twelve years later and discover they each have the same problem: because of their monogamy-challenged ways, neither can maintain a relationship. Determined to stay friends despite their mutual attraction, they make a pact to keep it platonic, a deal that proves easier said than done.
plot:
In 2002, Lainey causes a scene in a dorm at Columbia University. Taking pity on her as she is about to be kicked out by security, Jake claims her as his guest. He learns Lainey was there to lose her virginity to her teaching assistant Matthew, who Jake thinks is the most boring guy in the world. Lainey eventually realizes Jake is also a virgin, so they lose their virginity to each other.
Years later, Lainey breaks up with her long-term boyfriend Sam after telling him she has been cheating on him with Matthew. On the advice of her therapist she attends a sex addicts meeting where she runs into Jake, who is there because of his inability to commit. Lainey schedules an appointment with Matthew to end their affair; he agrees and tells her that he is engaged, but they end up having sex.
On the advice of a friend Lainey contacts Jake, and they go on one date where they confess their sexual problems to one another. At the end of the date Jake confesses that he wants to sleep with her. Lainey insists that they should just be friends and he agrees with the safe word "mousetrap" to be used to deflate sexual tension between them.
They hang out more and eventually become best friends, confiding in each other about their dating lives as they try to move past their commitment issues. Strangers mistake them for a couple and their friends begin to think they are in a relationship as well. Jake learns that Lainey is going to re-enroll in medical school and possibly move to Michigan. He brings her to the birthday party of his friend's child, where she meets Chris and begins seeing him to Jake's chagrin. Deciding to move on, he asks his boss Paula on a date.
A date with Chris leads Lainey to run into Matthew and his now-pregnant wife. At the same time, Jake has sex with Paula and calls her Lainey. After their nights out, Jake and Lainey spend the night together where they realize that they are in love with each other. They do nothing about it, afraid to mess up their relationship.
Lainey moves to Michigan and Jake devotes himself to Paula. Two months after Lainey has left, during brunch with Paula, Jake sees Matthew and punches him in the face in front of his wife. Paula breaks up with Jake after he refers to Lainey as "my girl" and he is arrested. He calls Lainey from the police station and confesses he is still in love with her, and wants to pursue a relationship even if it fails. She tells him she feels the same way.
Some time later, Matthew is suing Jake for emotional distress and refuses every settlement he offers. Lainey goes to see him and tells him she will tell his wife about their relationship if he does not drop the case and accept the offered settlement. After leaving his office, Lainey meets with Jake and they rush off to be married.

title: The Woman in Black 2: Angel of Death
original_title: The Woman in Black 2: Angel of Death
tagline: She Never Left
overview: 40 years after the first haunting at Eel Marsh House, a group of children evacuated from WWII London arrive, awakening the house's darkest inhabitant.
plot:
The Woman in Black: Angel of Death is a 2014 British supernatural horror film directed by Tom Harper and written by Jon Croker from a story by Susan Hill, author of the original novel. A sequel to The Woman in Black (2012), produced by Hammer Film Productions and Entertainment One, it stars Phoebe Fox as Eve Parkins, Jeremy Irvine as an RAF pilot, Helen McCrory as headmistress Jean Hogg, Adrian Rawlins, Leanne Best and Ned Dennehy. It was released in December 2014 in the United Kingdom and in January 2015 in the United States.

Some three decades after the events of the first film, during the London Blitz, the young schoolteacher Eve Parkins and the stern headmistress Jean Hogg evacuate a group of children to the remote village of Crythin Gifford. On the train, Eve meets Harry Burnstow, a charming RAF pilot stationed at a nearby airfield. The village is almost deserted, and Eve is frightened by a raving local man, Jacob. The group is billeted at Eel Marsh House, a decaying mansion on an island in the marshes cut off by the tides, which Eve and Jean consider unsuitable, but there is nowhere else to go.

That night Eve dreams of the baby she was forced to give up as a young woman, and she hears a rocking chair in the cellar, where she finds a message reproaching her and glimpses a woman dressed in black. Edward, a boy who has been mute since his parents were killed in the bombing, is bullied by other children and also sees the figure. When one of his tormentors, Tom, is lured out of the house and found dead on the beach, Eve becomes convinced that the vengeful ghost of Jennet Humfrye, the Woman in Black, is targeting the children, as she did decades earlier. With Harry's help, Eve investigates the history of the house and the curse that compels the spirit to kill children, while Jean refuses to believe her. As more children are drawn into danger and Edward seems increasingly under the ghost's influence, Eve must confront her own guilt and find a way to save him before the Woman in Black claims him.

The film received negative reviews. It holds a 24 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus called it atmospheric and visually sharp but short on tension and scares, and a Metacritic score of 42; audiences polled by CinemaScore gave it a "C." It grossed around $48 million worldwide, considerably less than its predecessor.

title: Lady Bloodfight
tagline: Fight for your life
overview: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking through Japan, when her raw street fighting skills draw the attention of Oshima, Japanese karate champion, who recruits and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as "The Kumite". After months of rigorous preparation, Jane is ready to face off against the deadliest female fighters in the world, including Ling, the Chinese apprentice of Oshima's nemesis. But other nefarious forces lie in the shadows, and Jane and Ling will have to unite on a journey that will take them from the gritty underworld of Hong Kong to the glitz of Macao, before deciding who really is the best female fighter on the planet.
plot:
Lady Bloodfight is a 2016 martial arts action film directed by Chris Nahon, best known for Kiss of the Dragon, from a screenplay by Bey Logan and Judd Bloch. An all-female reworking of Jean-Claude Van Damme's 1988 cult film Bloodsport and a standalone entry in that series, it stars the stuntwoman Amy Johnston as Jane Jones, with Muriel Hofmann as her teacher Shu, Kathy Wu as Shu's rival Wai, Jenny Wu as Wai's pupil Ling, Jet Tranter as the Australian fighter Cassidy, Mayling Ng as the Russian Svietta Chekhov and Kirt Kishita as the gambler Mr. Sang. Voltage Productions produced it.

Jane, a tough but troubled young American, shows her temper early when she deals with a rude customer at the diner where she works. Hoping to help her mother, who has sunk into heavy drinking, she leaves her small-town life and goes backpacking in Hong Kong, where her father vanished years earlier after taking part in a fighting tournament there. When three thugs try to mug her on the street, she fights them off with a ferocity that impresses Shu, a wise expert in the Wudang martial arts, who takes her on as a student and trains her for the Kumite, a brutal underground tournament for women fighters that carries a large cash prize.

Shu has reasons of her own: she needs a champion to face the pupil of her friend turned enemy, Wai, who teaches Shaolin with a far more lethal outlook and has recruited Ling, a scrappy street thief. After months of training, Jane and Ling must survive round after round against some of the deadliest fighters in the world before they can settle their teachers' feud. Fighters sometimes die in the Kumite, and disturbing events lead Jane to doubt her physical and emotional strength, while she keeps searching for the truth about her father. Mr. Sang, who watches the contest with great interest, eventually proves even more villainous than he first appears.

Vertical Entertainment released the film in the United States on 5 May 2017. Critics enjoyed its fight scenes but little else. The Hollywood Reporter found the action fast and suitably bloody and praised Johnston's physicality, while calling the script overcomplicated and noting how often the camera dwells on scantily clad women. Film Inquiry thought the dialogue clichéd and the father subplot sentimental but enjoyed the brutal fights as B-movie fun, and the Los Angeles Times advised skipping the plot and enjoying the action.

title: Grace
tagline: Innocence ends in blood
overview: A unique horror film told from the first-person perspective of Grace - a naive, virginal college freshman trying to deal with campus culture and her outgoing roommate as an evil entity takes over her body and unleashes chaos.
plot:
Grace, released on home video as Grace: The Possession, is a 2014 Canadian-American supernatural horror film and the feature debut of director Jeff Chan. Produced by Automatik Entertainment and Colony Pictures and distributed on DVD by Sony Pictures, it stands out for its point of view: roughly ninety percent of the film is seen through the eyes of its title character, or of the evil force that has taken hold of her, without the found-footage device. Alexia Fast stars as Grace, with Lin Shaye as her grandmother Helen, Alexis Knapp as her roommate Jessica, Brett Dier as Brad, Alan Dale as Father John and Joel David Moore as a kindly young man about to be ordained a priest; Clarke Peters, Madeleine Arthur and John Emmet Tracy also appear.

Grace, an eighteen-year-old raised in a small town, has lived a sheltered life under the suspicious eye of her devout and domineering grandmother. Helen never recovered from the fall of Grace's mother, who left the Church, became pregnant and died giving birth to her daughter, so Grace has grown up with a Bible in her hand. Going away to college is her first chance to see more of the world. She is unsure about her outgoing roommate Jessica but drawn to Brad, a handsome classmate. However, she has started seeing strange visions and feeling unwell, with symptoms resembling the psychosis her mother seemed to suffer before her death. After a party where she has a few drinks with Brad and Jessica, an episode lands her in hospital, and Helen takes her home, forcing her back into a strict Catholic routine. There Grace uncovers secrets about her mother's death while her grandmother becomes convinced that the Devil is trying to claim her. As the entity inside her grows stronger and acts through her body, the stoic Father John attempts an exorcism, leading to a violent finale.

The film was released on DVD in the United States on 28 October 2014. Reviewers generally found the story thin and derivative of The Exorcist but credited the first-person approach. DVD Talk praised how Chan conveyed Fast's performance though she is rarely seen, and Shaye's turn as the repressed grandmother, but felt the director did not push his style far enough, calling the film a rental. Flickering Myth considered it a brave attempt to refresh a limited subgenre, admiring Shaye and Dale while criticizing the cheap computer effects and the demonic voice, and found that the film gains energy once Grace returns home.

title: Outcast
tagline: To save their souls they must save a kingdom.
overview: A mysterious warrior teams up with the daughter and son of a deposed Chinese Emperor to defeat their cruel brother, who seeks their deaths.
plot:
Outcast is a 2014 action film directed by Nick Powell, making his directorial debut, from a screenplay by James Dormer, who first wrote the script in 2000. Hayden Christensen and Nicolas Cage star alongside Liu Yifei, Ji Ke Jun Yi and Andy On. In 2012 it was reported that the government of China's Yunnan province would partner with a Hollywood company on the international co-production, with backing from the national broadcasting regulator.

During the Crusades, the young commander Jacob leads an army, including Gallain, in the slaughter of an Arab city. Gallain begs him to spare the people, insisting the killing is not God's will, and leaves when Jacob grows ever more violent. Three years later, in Song dynasty China, the dying Emperor names his young son, Prince Zhao, as heir and sends him away with the imperial seal in the care of his older sister, Princess Lian. Their cruel elder brother, Prince Shing, enraged at being passed over, kills their father, takes control of the Black Guard and orders his siblings hunted down for the seal. At a tavern, Jacob, high on opium, kills the pursuing guards, and though he first refuses to escort the pair, memories of war persuade him to help them.

The group rescues a girl, Xiaolei, from a village ravaged by the Black Guard, are betrayed by their hosts in the desert city of Jingshao, who want the bounty, and fight their way out before fleeing by boat to the Silver Mountain, a refuge of the bandits Jacob had been seeking. There the wounded Jacob discovers that their leader, the White Ghost, is Gallain, and the two reconcile after Jacob explains that he never killed women and children as Gallain had believed. When Shing and the Black Guard attack the hideout, Gallain is killed. Lian is stabbed while intervening in Jacob's duel with Shing, and Jacob, enraged, kills the prince. The Black Guard swear loyalty to Zhao, who is recognized as Emperor, but Jacob, haunted by his past, leaves Lian, buries Gallain and moves on alone.

Christensen plays Jacob, Cage plays Gallain, Liu plays Lian and Andy On plays Shing. Its planned Chinese release on September 26, 2014, was abruptly cancelled hours beforehand without explanation, and the film finally opened in China in April 2015, trailing the similar Dragon Blade. Critics were hostile, with 5% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and Glenn Kenny of RogerEbert.com mocked Cage's near-British accent and called Christensen lifeless.

title: The Mountain Between Us
tagline: What if your life depended on a stranger?
overview: Stranded after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must forge a connection to survive the extreme elements of a remote snow covered mountain. When they realize help is not coming, they embark on a perilous journey across the wilderness.
plot:
The Mountain Between Us is a 2017 American romantic drama film directed by Hany Abu-Assad and written by Chris Weitz, based on the 2006 novel of the same name by Charles Martin.

The movie begins with Dr. Kate Mercer (Idris Elba), an accomplished surgeon who has lost her way in life after a tragic accident that killed his wife. He is now working at a hospital in New York City, but feels unfulfilled and disconnected from his work. Meanwhile, in Utah, a young woman named Ashley Turner (Kate Winslet) is on a solo hike to find herself.

The story takes an unexpected turn when Kate's plane crashes in the wilderness of Utah, leaving him injured and stranded. He meets Ashley, who has also survived the crash but is badly hurt. As they try to survive together, they develop a deep bond, and their initial animosity towards each other gradually turns into romance.

As they navigate the treacherous terrain, Kate and Ashley face numerous challenges, including harsh weather conditions, steep cliffs, and limited supplies. Along the way, they discover hidden strengths within themselves and learn to rely on each other for survival.

Throughout their journey, Kate opens up about his past and his feelings of guilt and regret over his wife's death. Ashley, who has been through her own share of trauma, shares her story of loss and healing. As they talk, they begin to form a connection that goes beyond physical attraction.

As the days pass, Kate and Ashley grow closer, and their relationship deepens. However, their happiness is short-lived, as they soon realize that one of them will not survive the ordeal. In a heart-wrenching twist, it becomes clear that Ashley's injuries are too severe to be saved, and she must make the ultimate sacrifice to ensure Kate's survival.

In the end, Kate is left alone, but with a newfound sense of purpose and meaning in his life. He realizes that he has been given a second chance and vows to honor Ashley's memory by continuing her work as a doctor and helping others who are struggling.

The Mountain Between Us is a poignant love story about two people who find each other in the most unexpected way, despite their differences. The film explores themes of grief, healing, and redemption, and features stunning cinematography that captures the breathtaking beauty of Utah's wilderness.

title: You're Not You
tagline: Life is measured in moments that leave you breathless.

title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
tagline: The story before Snow White
overview: As two evil sisters prepare to conquer the land, two renegades—Eric the Huntsman, who aided Snow White in defeating Ravenna in Snowwhite and the Huntsman, and his forbidden lover, Sara—set out to stop them.
plot:
The Huntsman: Winter's War is a 2016 American fantasy adventure film directed by Cedric Nicolas-Troyan, written by Evan Daugherty and Chris Morgan, and starring Chris Hemsworth, Charlize Theron, Emily Blunt, Jessica Chastain, and Tom Savage.

Beginning

The film begins with the Huntsman (Chris Hemsworth), a skilled warrior who is tasked by King Magnus (Nathan Jones) to kill his own son, Prince Eric (Tom Savage), as part of a prophecy that foretells the downfall of the kingdom. However, the Huntsman takes pity on Eric and spares his life.

Plot Development

The story then jumps forward in time, where we see Eric, now a young man, who has grown up to become a powerful sorcerer. He is being hunted by Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), an evil queen who seeks to destroy all magic in the world and rule with an iron fist.

Meanwhile, Eric meets a young woman named Sara (Emily Blunt), who becomes his love interest and helps him on his quest to defeat Ravenna. The two of them embark on a perilous journey to find the ancient magic that can defeat Ravenna's powers.

The Huntsman's Quest

As they journey through treacherous landscapes, the Huntsman is forced to confront his past and make amends for his failure to kill Eric as a child. He joins forces with Sara and Eric to stop Ravenna from obtaining the magical crystal that will give her the power to destroy all magic in the world.

The Battle

The final battle takes place at the ancient temple where the magical crystal is hidden. The Huntsman, Sara, and Eric face off against Ravenna and her army of dark creatures. In a thrilling showdown, the three heroes work together to defeat Ravenna and shatter the crystal, saving magic in the world.

Ending

In the end, Eric and Sara are able to find happiness together, while the Huntsman is finally able to make amends for his past mistakes. The film concludes with a sense of hope and renewal, as the heroes look towards a brighter future.

Overall, The Huntsman: Winter's War is an action-packed fantasy adventure that explores themes of redemption, love, and the power of magic. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the genre will enjoy the thrilling battles, stunning visuals, and memorable performances from the cast.

title: Pay the Ghost
tagline: Evil walks among us.
overview: One year after his young son disappeared during a Halloween carnival, Mike Cole is haunted by eerie images and terrifying messages he can’t explain. Together with his estranged wife, he will stop at nothing to unravel the mystery and find their son—and, in doing so, he unearths a legend that refuses to remain buried in the past.
plot:
A professor, Mike Lawford frantically searches for his son Charlie, who was abducted during a Halloween carnival. As nearly a year goes by, Mike and his wife Kristen are still looking for Charlie and are starting to hear and see him reaching out to them from the other world. Mike sees Charlie on a passing bus but upon chasing the bus down and gaining access, Charlie is not there. He disembarks and notices spray painted on a building, "pay the ghost," the phrase Charlie uttered before vanishing. He enters the building and finds homeless people living there. Unearthly screams of a woman are heard and a blind homeless man calls for the others to mask their fires, explaining to Mike that the screams are heard every year before Halloween. Mike asks about the phrase and is taken to a wall with more of the same phrases written on it. Engrossed by the wall and the homeless man, he does not notice the wall behind him shift into another world and a demonic figure briefly appears behind him, then vanishes. The homeless man explains nothing but quickly tells Mike to leave.
Kristen later sees Charlie's scooter move on its own and calls him. Later that night while pouring wine, the power in Mike and Kristen's home goes out. Mike looks out the window to see three children appear and burned at the stake, then turns and sees his apartment crowded with figures of children standing lifeless and pale. They call Jane, a psychic, to investigate. Standing in Charlie's room, Jane senses nothing but then abruptly walks to the window, looks at the approaching storm and says, "It's here... it has all the children." Jane is then thrown against the wall and strangled before collapsing, burn scars all over her hands. A later autopsy shows her internal organs were burned to ash.
Later, Mike walks upstairs to Kristen's room and she addresses him with Charlie's voice, pleading for help and saying "She's coming, Dad. I'm scared." Mike walks closer and sees Kristen cutting herself. Cleaning the wound, they find a symbol, which leads them to a Celtic Halloween celebration. A participant explains that the children are burning dolls to pay the ghost, so they will not be taken. Their friend Hannah who was helping them by doing research calls Mike and says that on Halloween night of 1679, because of her Celtic worship, young widow Annie Sawquin living in early New York was burned alive with her three children by an angry mob of settlers suspecting her to be a witch. Annie takes revenge every year on Halloween, when the border between the spiritual world and the physical world dissolves for a short time. Since then, every Halloween, Annie's ghost takes three living children from their parents and puts them in an alternate world. The borders solidify until next Halloween and the children taken are able to reach out and be rescued. But if the children cannot escape this alternate world within the first year, they are stuck in this world forever.

title: Monster High: Freaky Fusion
overview: While attempting to help Frankie Stein learn more about her freakycool scaritage, the fashionably fierce ghoulfriends travel back in time to the first day ever of Monster High! There, they meet Sparky, a skullastic teen with an obsession for creating life. But when Sparky follows the ghouls through a killer time portal to modern-day Monster High, the event results in eight of them fusing together into four creeperiffic hybrid Monsters. Now, they'll really have to work together to control their bodies in the big Bitecentennial Play and stop one of Sparky's experiments from destroying imperfectly perfect Monster High!
plot:
Monster High: Freaky Fusion is a 2014 American computer-animated fantasy film based on Mattel's Monster High fashion doll franchise. Directed by William Lau and Sylvain Blais from a screenplay by Keith Wagner, it is a 73-minute special in the franchise's 3D-animated first generation, whose films were animated by Nerd Corps Entertainment. It was released on DVD on 30 September 2014 and broadcast on Nickelodeon on 24 October, and it tied in with the Freaky Fusions and Hybrids doll lines.

As Monster High celebrates its 200th anniversary, Frankie Stein and her friends Draculaura, Clawdeen, Lagoona, Cleo and Ghoulia agree to help drama teacher Mr. Where stage a play about the school's history. Frankie fails a class project on her family heritage because her parents will not talk about her grandfather, Victor Frankenstein. Robecca Steam, whose mad scientist father, the former teacher Hexiciah Steam, vanished long ago, leads the ghouls, along with Venus, Jinafire and a meddling Toralei, to his workshop in the catacombs to find his journal. When Toralei pulls a lever, a machine sends them all back 200 years to 1814.

In the past, Frankie meets Sparky, a student obsessed with creating life, and tells him that her grandfather achieved it. Sparky secretly follows the girls through the time portal, which malfunctions: Frankie and Ghoulia return intact, but their friends arrive fused into four hybrid monsters, Dracubecca, Cleolei, Clawvenus and Lagoonafire, who struggle to control their new bodies and powers during rehearsals. A group of newcomers, the Hybrids, among them Neighthan Rot, who had seemed unfriendly, help the fused ghouls adapt. Meanwhile, Sparky steals a part of the time machine and builds Creature 4.0, which goes on a rampage, wrecks the play and captures Frankie's friends one by one. Frankie spends all her spark to save and separate them, and Sparky realises that emotion is what gives her true life. Dying, she learns that Sparky is in fact her grandfather. With Hexiciah's help, the whole school shares its sparks to revive her, the two men return to their own time, and the play resumes with a message that every monster, flaws and all, is welcome at Monster High.

The voice cast includes Kate Higgins as Frankie, Debi Derryberry as Draculaura, Salli Saffioti as Clawdeen and Cleo, Laura Bailey as Lagoona and Headmistress Bloodgood, America Young as Toralei, Haviland Stillwell as Avea, Geeg Friedman as Bonita, and Dave B. Mitchell as Hexiciah Steam.

title: Secret in Their Eyes
tagline: The truth lies in the most unexpected places.
overview: A tight-knit team of FBI investigators, along with their District Attorney supervisor, is suddenly torn apart when they discover that one of their own teenage daughters has been brutally murdered.
plot:
Secret in Their Eyes is a 2015 thriller written and directed by Billy Ray, a remake of the 2009 Argentine film of the same name; both are based on Eduardo Sacheri's novel La pregunta de sus ojos. A co-production between the United States, the United Kingdom, South Korea and Spain, it stars Chiwetel Ejiofor, Nicole Kidman and Julia Roberts, with Dean Norris, Michael Kelly, Joe Cole and Alfred Molina in supporting roles.

In 2002, soon after the September 11 attacks, FBI counterterrorism agent Ray Kasten and his friend Jess Cobb, an investigator for the Los Angeles district attorney's office, meet the new assistant district attorney, Claire Sloan. Called to a body dumped near a mosque Ray has been watching, they find that the victim is Jess's eighteen-year-old daughter, Carolyn, raped, murdered and bleached to destroy DNA evidence. Ray, who was late to meet Carolyn that day, blames himself. Studying photos from a police picnic, he spots a young man staring at Carolyn and identifies him as Anzor Marzin, an informant in the terrorism investigation. District Attorney Martin Morales is unwilling to pursue him, and Officer Reggie Siefert frames another suspect to protect Marzin. Ray and Detective Bumpy Willis arrest Marzin at Dodger Stadium, where Claire goads him into confessing and he attacks her, but after Ray beats him, Morales orders him released. Jess rejects Ray's suggestion that they kill Marzin, saying death would be too easy, and Siefert burns Marzin's van to destroy the evidence.

Fourteen years later Ray, now head of security for the New York Mets, returns to Los Angeles, where Claire is now district attorney and a withdrawn Jess is her top investigator. Ray believes Marzin is living as Clay Beckwith, but a shootout in which Siefert dies proves Beckwith is someone else. Jess then tells Ray and Claire that she killed Marzin years earlier. Following her into her barn, Ray finds Marzin alive, caged there for more than a decade. Ray leaves his gun with Jess and begins digging a grave outside; she shoots Marzin, and Claire officially closes the case.

STX moved the release from October to November 20, 2015. The film grossed $32.2 million worldwide against a $19.5 million budget. Critics praised the performances but compared it unfavorably with the original; it holds 39% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 45.
