title: Miss You Already
tagline: When life falls apart, friends keep it together
overview: The friendship between two life-long girlfriends is put to the test when one starts a family and the other falls ill.
plot:
Childhood best friends Milly and Jess do everything together. As they grow older, however, Milly settles down and marries her rocker boyfriend Kit while Jess becomes an environmentalist and marries her longtime boyfriend Jago.
Milly, busy with her career and her young family, learns that she has breast cancer after a long-delayed check-up. She finds herself unable to tell Kit and, after a week, finally confides in Jess. Once she tells Kit and their children, Scarlett and Ben, Milly tasks Jess with helping her get through chemotherapy and the two women joke around as Milly receives her treatments. During this time period, Jess, who has been unable to conceive naturally, puts off IVF treatments with Jago, feeling that she cannot keep trying to have children while Milly is sick. After Jago grows exasperated, Jess finally decides to give it a shot and the couple manage to conceive a baby shortly after.
The night Jess learns that she is pregnant, Milly learns that though she has responded to the chemotherapy, she still needs a double mastectomy. She goes to a bar and gets drunk and, when Jess retrieves her, confesses that she has a big ego and does not want to appear unattractive. Jess reassures her that she will always want her in her life. Milly goes through with the double mastectomy but Jess finds herself unable to tell Milly she is pregnant as she feels as though her good news would cause Milly grief. Meanwhile, Jess learns Jago must go away to work on an oil rig to pay for their IVF treatments.
Milly finds herself growing increasingly distant from Kit after the surgery. After he arranges a surprise birthday dinner, Milly walks out, taking Jess with her and the two go all the way to West Yorkshire ostensibly to see the moors where the Brontë sisters grew up, though, in reality, Milly is chasing down a barman, Ace, that she had sex with post-surgery. When Jess discovers the deception, she and Milly argue and Jess leaves the area as quick as possible after showing Milly her bump. She falls in her exit and then bounces around on a bus for hours. This causes complications in her pregnancy.
For a while, Milly and Jess are estranged. During this period, Jess learns that she is having a high-risk pregnancy caused by her fall at the moors while Milly learns that while her breast cancer is in remission she also has fatal malignant tumours in her brain. Milly tracks down Jess and the women reconcile, Jess shares about her pregnancy complications and what happened at the moors to cause it. She also confesses her affair to Kit and although he feels betrayed, he decides to make love to Milly knowing that her days are numbered. Milly eventually tells her children that she will die and must go into hospice care. While there, she tells Jess she is holding on for the birth of Jess's first child.
Jess goes into labour early while Jago is still on the oil rig.

title: Tracers
tagline: It's not a crime if they can't catch you.
overview: Wanted by the mafia, a New York City bike messenger escapes into the world of parkour after meeting a beautiful stranger.
plot:
Tracers is a 2015 American action film directed by Daniel Benmayor, with a screenplay by Matt Johnson from a story by Johnson, T. J. Scott and Kevin Lund. It stars Taylor Lautner as Cam, a New York bike messenger, with Marie Avgeropoulos as Nikki, Adam Rayner as Miller and Rafi Gavron as Nikki's brother Dylan, alongside Christopher Jackson, Josh Yadon and Luciano Acuna Jr. as members of the crew. The film centers on the urban sport of parkour, which its characters use to carry out robberies.

Cam is a bike courier in New York City who is struggling to make ends meet and owes 15,000 dollars to a Chinatown gang, whose enforcers threaten him for missed payments. One day his bike is wrecked when a young woman, Nikki, crashes into him while fleeing the police. After she replaces the bike, Cam becomes fascinated by her parkour skills and tries to imitate them. He begins training and eventually earns an invitation to join Nikki's crew, a tight-knit group of free runners led by the charismatic Miller.

When the gang takes his late father's car and threatens his landlady Angie and her son, Cam joins the crew in its criminal work, using parkour to carry out thefts across the city, and quickly becomes one of its most valuable members. He also grows close to Nikki, though she has hidden the truth about her relationship with Miller. After a bank robbery goes wrong, one of the crew is killed and Cam is arrested, and Miller reveals that he is actually a corrupt federal agent. In exchange for his freedom, Cam must help Miller carry out one last dangerous heist, while trying to free himself from the gang and protect Nikki.

The film features extensive parkour sequences performed through the streets and rooftops of New York, and its young cast trained in the discipline for the action scenes.

Tracers was released on March 20, 2015. Reviews were generally negative, with 25 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 45; critics found the action sequences fun to watch but regarded the plot as typical B-movie material.

title: Winx Club: The Mystery of the Abyss

overview: The archenemies of the Winx Club, the Trix witches, team up with the evil nymph Politea and find out that, to defeat the fairies once and for all and become invincible, it takes very little: a Pearl hidden in the Deep of the Infinite Ocean! As small as powerful, the Pearl of the Depth gives enormous powers to those who possess it!  For the Winx there is not a minute to waste: how will they stop the plans of their enemies before it's too late?  Get ready: the most dangerous mission of the Winx is about to begin!
plot:
The story begins with a view of the Infinite Ocean, which has become overrun with pollution. The Trix appear and head for the emperor's underwater throne. Meanwhile, the Winx are preparing to teach the freshman fairies at Alfea College. At the students' welcoming ceremony, the Winx talk about the various talents hidden in a fairy. Afterwards, Bloom leaves for her hometown of Gardenia with her pet rabbit Kiko to spend a whole day with her fiancé, Prince Sky.
In the Infinite Ocean, the Trix try to gain power by sitting on the Emperor's Throne but end up summoning the nymph Politea instead. The Trix engage in a battle with Politea and learn that they cannot gain any power from the throne because it will only listen to the true emperor, Tritannus. They make a deal with Politea to get Tritannus back from the Oblivion, which they can only do with the vital force of a young prince. Once they free him, the Trix will convince him to get the mystical Pearl of the Deep for Politea, who would become freed by the pearl and then help the Trix take the throne's power.
The Trix go to Gardenia and attack Bloom and Sky. Bloom tries to fight the Trix alone and manages to escape with Sky, but the Trix get Kiko. Bloom tries to save him and gets attacked, leaving her unconscious. The Trix capture Sky and take him to the Infinite Ocean, where they tie him to the Emperor's Throne. The Trix and Politea cast a spell and Tritannus appears in front of them. Politea leaves after telling the Trix that Tritannus knows the pearl's whereabouts and warns them not to tell Tritannus anything about her. After Tritannus gains his consciousness, Icy helps him regain his memory. He tells them about the Pearl of the Deep and who has hidden it, Omnia. Tritannus sits on the Throne, gains his powers, and seals all the gateways to enter the Infinite Ocean. He and the Trix head towards Omnia's cave.
At Alfea, Bloom's friends agree to help her journey to the Infinite Ocean to save Sky. They discover that Tritannus has sealed all of the ocean's gateways except for the Oblivion portal, which leads them through a dangerous dimension. The Winx go through the portal and Bloom wakes up in an empty room, where a dark illusion of herself appears to tell her that he has abandoned Sky. When Bloom realizes that she successfully got into the Oblivion, she quickly wakes the other Winx. They break free from the Oblivion with a convergence spell.
The Winx hurry towards the Emperor's Throne, where they fight Politea. Sky gains consciousness and tells them to go to Omnia, who tells them that the Pearl was hidden in the Coral Barrier. They get there to find the Trix and Tritannus, who grabs the Pearl and leaves the Winx in the barrier with almost no way to escape. The girls leave through an underground tunnel and hurry back to the throne, where Politea finally appears in front of Tritannus and snatches the Pearl from him.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate
tagline: Welcome to the day after judgement day
overview: Decades after Sarah Connor prevented Judgment Day, a lethal new Terminator is sent to eliminate the future leader of the resistance. In a fight to save mankind, battle-hardened Sarah Connor teams up with an unexpected ally and an enhanced super soldier to stop the deadliest Terminator yet.
plot:
Terminator: Dark Fate is a 2019 science fiction action film directed by Tim Miller and written by Charles Eglee III, David S. Goyer, and Justin Rhodes. The movie takes place 27 years after the events of Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines (2003) and ignores the plotlines of Terminator Salvation (2009) and Terminator Genisys (2015).

The film begins with a flashback to 1997, where we see Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton), now an elderly woman, being attacked by a group of assassins sent by a mysterious organization known as Rev-9. The Rev-9 is a more advanced Terminator model than the ones seen in previous films, and it's designed to hunt down Sarah.

The story then jumps forward to 2023, where we meet Dani Ramos (Natalia Reyes), a young woman living in Mexico who discovers that she's the target of the Rev-9. The Rev-9 is sent back in time by a wealthy tech mogul named Edward Hale (Jared Leto) and his company, Neuraxxis.

As the Rev-9 begins to hunt down Dani, she meets a cyborg assassin known as the Rev-9 Terminator (Gabriel Luna), who's tasked with killing her. However, Dani soon discovers that she has a connection to Sarah Connor, and together they form an alliance to take down the Rev-9 and prevent a catastrophic future.

The movie introduces a new character, Carl Hanratty (Nick Stahl), a detective who's been tracking the Rev-9 for years. He teams up with Dani and Sarah to stop Hale and his company, which is secretly working on a technology that can control human minds.

As the story unfolds, we see flashbacks of Sarah Connor's past, including her relationship with John Connor (Christian Bale), the future leader of the human resistance against Skynet. We also learn more about the Rev-9 Terminator, who's designed to be more efficient and deadly than its predecessors.

The final act of the movie features an intense showdown between Dani, Sarah, Carl, and the Rev-9 Terminator. In a surprising twist, it's revealed that Hale has been working with Skynet all along, and he plans to use the technology to control humanity's minds and create a dystopian future.

In the end, Dani and her allies manage to defeat the Rev-9 Terminator and stop Hale's plan. The movie concludes with Sarah Connor passing on her knowledge and legacy to Dani, setting the stage for a potential sequel.

Overall, Terminator: Dark Fate is an action-packed sci-fi thriller that explores themes of time travel, artificial intelligence, and human resistance. While it may not be as groundbreaking as some of its predecessors, the film delivers plenty of excitement and suspense, making it a satisfying addition to the Terminator franchise.

title: Wyrmwood: Road of the Dead
tagline: Mad Max meets Dawn Of The Dead
overview: Barry is a talented mechanic and family man whose life is torn apart on the eve of a zombie apocalypse. His sister, Brooke, is kidnapped by a sinister team of gas-mask wearing soldiers & experimented on by a psychotic doctor. While Brooke plans her escape Barry goes out on the road to find her & teams up with Benny, a fellow survivor - together they must arm themselves and prepare to battle their way through hordes of flesh-eating monsters in a harsh Australian bushland.
plot:
Wyrmwood: Road of the Dead is a 2014 Australian post-apocalyptic horror film directed by Klimax Ismayov and written by Klimax Ismayov. The movie follows a young woman named Bri, who embarks on a perilous journey to rescue her brother from a zombie-infested world.

At its core, Wyrmwood: Road of the Dead explores themes of grief, loss, and redemption in the face of unimaginable tragedy. The film's protagonist, Bri, is driven by a deep sense of guilt and responsibility for not being able to protect her family, which motivates her to risk everything to save her brother.

As Bri navigates this treacherous new world, she must confront the harsh realities of survival and the moral compromises that come with it. The film raises questions about the nature of humanity in the face of catastrophic collapse, and whether it's possible for individuals to find meaning and purpose in a world that seems determined to destroy them.

Throughout the movie, the zombie apocalypse serves as a metaphor for the breakdown of societal structures and the collapse of traditional values. The undead creatures represent a force beyond human control, highlighting the fragility of human existence and the vulnerability of our societies to catastrophic failure.

Ultimately, Wyrmwood: Road of the Dead is a powerful exploration of the human condition, one that grapples with the darkest aspects of human nature while also offering a message of hope and resilience in the face of overwhelming adversity.

title: Crystal Skulls
tagline: Every ending is a new beginning!
overview: A millionaire philanthropist collects the famous Chrystal Skulls trying to tap into their ancient powers. It is up to a team lead by a college professor whose father disappeared searching for the 13th skull to save the world when the first 12 skulls are united and reek havoc on the earth without the control of the 13th skull.
plot:
Crystal Skulls is a 2014 science fiction disaster adventure television film directed by Todor Chapkanov from a screenplay credited to Denyc and Rafael Jordan. A Bulgarian and North American co-production made by Phillip Roth's Bulgarian Unified Film Organization (BUFO) with Odyssey Media and MOD Productions, and produced by Roth, Devi Singh and Kirk Shaw, it stars Richard Burgi as archaeologist John Winston, with Wendy Glenn as Sienna Mallory, Sam Redford as Mitchell, David Rintoul as William S. Hadden, J.R. Esposito as Colonel Bailey, Matt Rippy as Terry Winston and Hugh Fraser as John Winston Sr.

Billionaire William Hadden has gathered twelve of the legendary crystal skulls, artifacts he claims are more than five thousand years old, at his headquarters in Vienna. When his associate Mitchell delivers what is believed to be the thirteenth, it turns out to be a fake, and uniting it with the others unleashes a massive electromagnetic pulse that kills two lab workers, cripples much of Europe and creates a second magnetic field that wreaks havoc on the world's weather. In Sweden, John Winston and his brother Terry are exploring ruins their father visited before his supposed death; a booby trap brings down the cave, and Terry is killed. Back in the United States, John finds his classes cancelled, and Sienna, Hadden's daughter, recruits him to find the thirteenth skull. Hadden reveals he brought the skulls together hoping they could cure his cancer and that the growing vortex will tear the Earth apart within about a day, while Colonel Bailey prepares a nuclear strike on Vienna. Pursued by a secret brotherhood determined to stop them, John, Sienna and Mitchell decipher his father's notes and trace the skull to the Visočica hill in Bosnia, where they find John's father alive among the skull's guardians. He turns on the cult and helps them escape with the skull, but is fatally shot. John places it with the others just in time, the storm vanishes, and Hadden, who dies, is entombed with the skulls.

The film was poorly received. Richard Scheib of Moria gave it one star, describing it as a cheap disaster movie crossed with Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull that delivers on neither, with its catastrophe conveyed mostly by newscasters and the skulls' origin never explained, though he found Burgi a serviceable hero. HorrorNews.net criticized its acting, effects, plot holes and pseudo-science.

title: Anomalisa
tagline: Welcome to the Kaufman surreal-neorealism tale in a dull world of sameness.
overview: An inspirational speaker becomes reinvigorated after meeting a lively woman who shakes up his mundane existence.
plot:
Anomalisa is a 2015 American adult stop-motion animated comedy-drama directed by Charlie Kaufman and Duke Johnson from a screenplay by Kaufman, based on his 2005 "sound play" written under the pseudonym Francis Fregoli. Drawing on the Fregoli delusion, a condition in which a person believes that different people are the same person, it combines psychological drama, romance and surrealism. David Thewlis voices Michael Stone, Jennifer Jason Leigh voices Lisa Hesselman, and Tom Noonan voices every other character. The film was partly financed through a Kickstarter campaign and produced by Starburns Industries.

In 2005, Michael Stone, an English-born customer-service expert and motivational author living in Los Angeles, travels to Cincinnati to speak at a convention, staying at the Fregoli Hotel. Lonely and depressed, he perceives everyone around him, including his wife and son, as having the same face and the same voice. In his room, preparing his speech, he is haunted by an angry letter from Bella, a former lover he abandoned years earlier without explanation. He meets her at the hotel bar, but she is still hurt, and when he invites her to his room she storms out. Wandering the city, he enters what he thinks is a toy store to buy his son a present and finds himself in an adult shop, where he is fascinated by an antique Japanese animatronic doll.

Back at the hotel, Michael hears a distinctive female voice and rushes to find its owner. She is Lisa, a shy, self-conscious woman from Akron attending the convention with her co-worker Emily, and to Michael she looks and sounds unlike anyone else. He invites both women for drinks and then, to Lisa's surprise, invites her to his room. Enchanted, he asks her to sing, and she performs Cyndi Lauper's "Girls Just Want to Have Fun." When she calls herself an anomaly, he gives her the nickname Anomalisa. They spend the night together, and Michael resolves to leave his family for her, but as the next day begins, his perception of her begins to change, and his breakdown at the convention exposes the depth of his alienation.

Anomalisa received widespread acclaim, holding a 92 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 88. It won the Grand Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, becoming one of the first R-rated animated films to receive that nomination.

title: The Sea of Trees
tagline: Love will bring you home.
overview: In Japan's Aokigahara Forest, a troubled teacher meets a mysterious lost stranger who takes him on a life-changing journey of love and redemption.
plot:
Arthur Brennan, an adjunct physics professor, travels to Aokigahara ("The Suicide Forest") with a sealed package. Once there, he attempts to end his life via drug overdose but encounters a Japanese man named Takumi Nakamura. Takumi entered the forest two days prior and slit his wrists because he was demoted at work, but soon realized he would miss his wife and daughter. Since then, he has tried to escape the dense sea of trees but cannot find the trail back. Arthur decides to help but the two end up disoriented and lost. To keep their minds occupied, they share details about their lives, including the names of Takumi's wife and daughter: "Kiiro" and "Fuyu".
Through flashbacks, it is revealed that Arthur lived in a crumbling marriage alongside his wife Joan, a real estate agent. Joan resented Arthur for his affair with Gabriella, his coworker, and always putting his own needs before their needs as a couple. Arthur despised Joan's alcoholism and constant need to demean him for earning less money than her. One night, Joan suffers a heavy nosebleed after a vicious argument. They go to the hospital, where she is diagnosed with a brain tumor. Joan and Arthur slowly rekindle their love for each other. After her surgery, they reminisce about trips to their lake house where Joan would spend hours walking amongst the orchids. He says he will take her there when she is fully recovered.
Joan is transported to a recovery hospital. Arthur follows behind the ambulance in his car while talking to her on the phone. He jokes about not knowing what her favorite color or season is. Before Joan can respond, a truck plows into the ambulance, killing her. At her funeral, Arthur tells the funeral director he did not really know her even after being married for years. The director replies he overheard one of Joan's sisters saying she mailed a copy of Joan's favorite book to Arthur's house.
Back in the present, Arthur and Takumi struggle to escape the forest. They survive falls, a flash flood, dehydration, and hypothermia over the course of a single night. Along the way, they encounter the bodies of others who succeeded in ending their lives. They take refuge in a tent with a corpse who brought emergency supplies with him. Sitting by a campfire, Arthur tells Takumi he is in the forest because of his guilt over how he and Joan treated each other.
The next morning, Arthur leaves an ill Takumi by the tent to try and find help. He promises Takumi he will come back for him. Arthur uses the walkie-talkie from the deceased camper and makes contact with the park rangers. He tries to help but is too weak to inform them that Takumi is still in the forest.
12 days later, Arthur is being evaluated by a hospital psychiatrist before his release. His plans are to return to the forest and find Takumi; the psychiatrist informs him that the rangers found the tent he spoke of but did not find anyone there.

title: In a Valley of Violence
tagline: A man can only take so much!
overview: The story of a drifter named Paul who arrives in a small town seeking revenge on the thugs who murdered his friend. Sisters Mary Anne and Ellen, who run the town's hotel, help Paul in his quest for vengeance.
plot:
In a Valley of Violence is a 2016 American Western written and directed by Ti West and produced by Jason Blum through Blumhouse Productions. It stars Ethan Hawke as Paul, a drifter and former soldier, John Travolta as U.S. Marshal Clyde Martin, Taissa Farmiga as the young innkeeper Mary-Anne, James Ransone as Clyde's hotheaded son, Deputy Gilly Martin, and Karen Gillan as Mary-Anne's sister Ellen, Gilly's fiancée. The film pays homage to classic revenge Westerns while adding dry, absurdist humor.

In the early 1870s, Paul and his loyal dog Abbie are crossing the desert on their way to Mexico. After fending off a bandit and disgraced clergyman who tries to steal his horse, Paul rides into Denton, a former boomtown on its last legs. In the saloon, the arrogant Gilly picks a fight with him, and Paul knocks him down with a single punch. At the local hotel, Paul meets Mary-Anne, who is delighted that someone stood up to Gilly, while Marshal Clyde Martin, a pragmatic lawman with a wooden leg, admits that his son provoked the fight but orders Paul to leave town by morning.

That night, Gilly and his fellow deputies ambush Paul and Abbie at their camp. Gilly kills the dog, and his men push Paul off a cliff, leaving him for dead. Paul survives, buries Abbie and returns to Denton seeking revenge, breaking his vow never to take another life. As the deputies are picked off one by one, Mary-Anne shelters Paul and begs him to take her away, while Clyde, realizing the full extent of what his son has done, tries to negotiate an end to the bloodshed before it consumes the entire town. Paul, haunted by atrocities he committed during the Indian Wars and by the family he abandoned, must decide how far his vengeance will go.

The film plays with the conventions of the genre, combining stylized violence, a deliberately old-fashioned score and comic exchanges between its characters.

In a Valley of Violence premiered at South by Southwest on March 12, 2016, and was released in limited theaters and on demand by Focus World on October 21. It grossed only about 62,000 dollars in theaters but was well received by critics, earning 78 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 64.

title: Assassination
tagline: The country falls. The operation begins.
overview: In Japanese-occupied Korea, three freedom fighters are assigned a mission to assassinate a genocidal military leader and his top collaborator. But the plan goes completely awry amidst double-crossings, counter-assassinations, and a shocking revelation about one of the assassins' past.
plot:
Assassination (Korean: Amsal) is a 2015 South Korean period spy action film co-written and directed by Choi Dong-hoon. Set mainly in Seoul and Shanghai in the 1930s, during the Japanese occupation of Korea, it follows Korean independence fighters plotting to kill a Japanese commander and a collaborator. Jun Ji-hyun, Lee Jung-jae and Ha Jung-woo lead the cast, with Oh Dal-su and Cho Jin-woong. Released on July 22, 2015, it drew more than 12.7 million admissions.

In 1911, a resistance fighter named Yem Sek-jin fails in an attempt to kill the Japanese governor-general and the pro-Japanese businessman Kang In-guk. When Kang discovers that his wife has been helping the resistance, he kills her, and a nurse flees with one of his newborn twin daughters. Yem, captured and tortured, secretly becomes an informant for the Japanese.

By 1933, Yem is a respected officer of the independence movement in Shanghai, and the leaders of the Provisional Government ask him to assemble a team to assassinate Kang and the Japanese general Kawaguchi Mamoru in Seoul. He recruits the sharpshooter Ahn Ok-yun and two fellow fighters, Big Gun and Duk-sam, then betrays the mission to the Japanese. He also hires a Korean contract killer, Hawaii Pistol, and his partner Buddy to eliminate the team, telling them that they are Japanese agents.

In Seoul, Hawaii Pistol wounds Big Gun, and Ahn and Duk-sam's ambush of their targets fails when the car turns out to be a decoy, costing Duk-sam his life. When Hawaii Pistol confronts Ahn, he recognises her from a chance encounter in Shanghai, spares her and decides to help her cause. Ahn then learns that she is Kang's lost daughter. Her twin sister, engaged to Kawaguchi's son, visits her and is killed by Kang's men, who mistake her for Ahn.

Taking her sister's place, Ahn attends the wedding as the bride, and with Hawaii Pistol, Buddy and the surviving Big Gun she carries out the attack. Ahn kills Kawaguchi, and Hawaii Pistol shoots Kang when she hesitates, sparing her the burden of killing her own father. Big Gun dies covering the escape, and Hawaii Pistol and Buddy are later killed by Yem, while Ahn escapes.

After Korea's liberation, Yem, now a senior police officer, is tried for collaboration in 1949 but walks free when the key witness is murdered. Ahn and a surviving comrade, Myung-woo, then confront him and carry out the long-delayed sentence. The film won Best Film at the Blue Dragon Film Awards and Baeksang Arts Awards.

title: Now You See Me 2

overview: One year after outwitting the FBI and winning the public’s adulation with their mind-bending spectacles, the Four Horsemen resurface only to find themselves face to face with a new enemy who enlists them to pull off their most dangerous heist yet.
plot:
Now You See Me 2 is a 2016 American mystery film directed by Jon M. Chu and written by Ed Solomon, Boaz Yakin, and Edward Ricourt. The movie is the sequel to the 2013 film Now You See Me.

The story begins with an FBI agent, Dylan Rhodes (Mark Ruffalo), who has been tasked with tracking down a group of magicians known as "The Four Horsemen" - a group that was thought to be long gone after their last heist in Las Vegas. The team consists of J. Daniel Atlas (Jesse Eisenberg), Henley Reeves (Lindsay Lohan), Merritt McKinney (Woody Harrelson), and Jack Wilder (Dave Franco).

The Four Horsemen are now on the run, using their magical skills to evade capture. They plan a massive heist in Macau, China, where they will steal $640 million from a casino vault. The team uses their unique abilities to infiltrate the vault and escape with the money.

As the FBI closes in on the team, Dylan Rhodes is forced to work with Interpol agent Alma Dray (Mélanie Laurent) to track down the Four Horsemen. Along the way, they uncover a conspiracy involving a wealthy businessman named Arthur Tressler (Michael Caine), who has been using his wealth and influence to cover up a massive money laundering scheme.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that The Four Horsemen are not just ordinary magicians, but rather highly skilled performers with a hidden agenda. They use their magic to manipulate people's perceptions of reality, making it difficult for Dylan and Alma to distinguish between what is real and what is an illusion.

Throughout the movie, the team uses their magical abilities to stay one step ahead of their pursuers, while also uncovering the truth behind Arthur Tressler's scheme. In the end, The Four Horsemen use their combined skills to expose Tressler's conspiracy and bring him to justice.

The movie features a mix of magic tricks, illusions, and clever plot twists, keeping the audience guessing until the very end. While some critics felt that the sequel did not live up to the original, Now You See Me 2 remains an entertaining and visually stunning film with a talented cast and impressive magical performances.

Overall, Now You See Me 2 is a thrilling mystery film that explores the world of magic and illusion, while also delving into themes of deception, loyalty, and redemption.

title: Kong: Skull Island
tagline: All hail the king
overview: Explore the mysterious and dangerous home of the king of the apes as a team of explorers ventures deep inside the treacherous, primordial island.
plot:
Kong: Skull Island is a 2017 American monster adventure film directed by Jordan Vogt-Röderman and produced by Legendary Pictures. The movie takes place in 1976, during the Vietnam War era.

The story begins with Captain Mark "Marky" Rutledge (Tom Hiddleston), an American soldier who is part of a secret mission to investigate Skull Island, a mysterious island rumored to be inhabited by giant prehistoric creatures. Alongside his team, including Lieutenant Colonel Preston Packard (Samuel L. Jackson) and Dr. Ilene Andrews (Brie Larson), they embark on a perilous journey to the island.

Upon arrival, the team discovers that the island is home to various monstrous creatures, including giant spiders, crocodiles, and other prehistoric beasts. As they venture deeper into the jungle, they stumble upon an ancient temple dedicated to King Kong, a legendary giant ape said to be the ruler of Skull Island.

The team soon realizes that Kong is not just a mindless beast but a complex creature with its own culture and motivations. They also discover that the island is home to a group of indigenous people who have been living in harmony with Kong for centuries.

As tensions rise, Packard's true intentions are revealed: he wants to capture Kong and use it as a propaganda tool to boost American morale during the war. However, Rutledge and Andrews begin to question Packard's motives and ultimately decide to help Kong escape from captivity.

The team soon finds themselves in a desperate battle against Packard's men, who have set up traps and explosives to capture Kong. In the chaos, Kong is freed, and he begins to wreak havoc on the island, destroying everything in his path.

As the team tries to survive the destruction caused by Kong, they also uncover the dark secrets of Skull Island's past, including the presence of a mysterious organization that has been experimenting with the island's creatures. The team soon realizes that they are not alone on the island and that there are forces at play that threaten their very existence.

In the end, Rutledge and Andrews manage to escape the island, but not before Kong is gravely injured by Packard's men. As the team flees the island, they leave behind a cryptic message for the world to discover the truth about Skull Island and its legendary inhabitants.

Throughout the movie, the director Jordan Vogt-Röderman pays homage to classic monster movies, incorporating nods to King Kong (1933) and other iconic films in the franchise. The film's visuals are stunning, with impressive creature designs and breathtaking action sequences that bring the prehistoric world of Skull Island to life.

Overall, Kong: Skull Island is a thrilling adventure that explores themes of colonialism, imperialism, and the ethics of scientific discovery. While it may not be as faithful to the original King Kong story as some fans might have hoped, it offers a fresh take on the classic monster movie genre and sets the stage for future adventures in the Kong franchise.

title: The 33
tagline: Hope Runs Deep
overview: Based on the true story of the collapse of a mine in San Jose, Chile—that left 33 miners isolated underground for 69 days.
plot:
The 33 (Spanish: Los 33) is a 2015 biographical survival drama directed by Patricia Riggen and written by Mikko Alanne, Craig Borten, Michael Thomas and José Rivera. Based on the 2010 Copiapó mining accident, in which 33 miners were trapped deep underground in the San José Mine in Chile for 69 days, it stars Antonio Banderas as the miner Mario Sepúlveda, with Rodrigo Santoro as Chilean mining minister Laurence Golborne, Juliette Binoche, James Brolin, Lou Diamond Phillips and Gabriel Byrne. It was released in Chile in August 2015 by 20th Century Fox and in the United States in November by Warner Bros. and Alcon Entertainment.

In August 2010, a group of miners are working in the San José gold and copper mine near Copiapó when a massive collapse seals off the only route to the surface. The disaster comes after the mine's owners ignored warnings about the instability of the mountain. Trapped more than 2,000 feet underground, the 33 men make their way to a small emergency refuge, only to find that it is badly stocked: the radio does not work, the medical supplies are missing and there is very little food.

Mario Sepúlveda, a charismatic miner, emerges as a leader, strictly rationing the meager supplies and working to keep the men united as fear, hunger and despair threaten to tear them apart, while the shift foreman Luis "Don Lucho" Urzúa, played by Phillips, struggles with guilt over having failed to prevent the disaster. On the surface, the mining company does little, and the miners' families set up a makeshift camp outside the gates, refusing to leave. Among them is María Segovia, played by Binoche, the determined sister of one of the trapped men. The Chilean government, led by Golborne, takes charge of the rescue, and engineers begin drilling in search of the refuge. After several boreholes miss, one finally breaks through, and the miners attach a note to the drill bit announcing that all 33 are alive. The film follows the long weeks that follow as rescuers work to bring every man to the surface.

The 33 received mixed reviews, with praise for its performances and its uplifting portrayal of the miners' resilience but criticism for its conventional approach. Although set in Chile, the film was shot largely in English with an international cast, a choice some critics questioned.

title: Deadpool
tagline: Witness the beginning of a happy ending.
overview: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.
plot:
Deadpool is a 2016 superhero film directed by Tim Miller, based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name. The movie follows the story of Wade Wilson, a former Special Forces operative turned mercenary, played by Ryan Reynolds.

Wade's life takes a drastic turn when he is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Desperate to find a cure, he seeks out a experimental treatment that promises to heal his cancer but also leaves him severely disfigured and mentally unstable. The treatment, known as the "Accelerated Healing Factor," makes Wade's body regenerate at an incredible rate, but it also drives him insane.

Wade becomes a mercenary for hire, using his newfound abilities to take on high-risk missions. He adopts the alter ego of Deadpool, a masked vigilante with a twisted sense of humor and a penchant for breaking the fourth wall. As he navigates the world as Deadpool, Wade struggles to maintain his sanity and find a cure for his condition.

Meanwhile, Ajax (Ed Skrein), a former Special Forces operative turned mercenary, is also seeking to exploit the Accelerated Healing Factor for his own gain. He kidnaps several women with the same genetic makeup as Wade, intending to use them as test subjects for his treatment. Deadpool sets out to rescue the women and take down Ajax.

Throughout the movie, Reynolds' performance brings a unique blend of humor, wit, and vulnerability to the character of Deadpool. The film's action sequences are fast-paced and intense, with plenty of clever references to comic book lore. The supporting cast, including Morena Baccarin as Vanessa Carlysle and T.J. Miller as Weasel, add depth and complexity to the story.

One of the standout aspects of Deadpool is its willingness to subvert traditional superhero movie tropes. The film's irreverent humor and self-awareness make it a refreshing change of pace from more conventional superhero fare. Reynolds' performance also allows for a level of emotional intimacy that is rare in comic book movies, making Deadpool feel like a character-driven story rather than just a superhero origin tale.

Overall, Deadpool is a wildly entertaining and visually stunning film that sets a new standard for the superhero genre. With its unique blend of humor, action, and heart, it's no wonder that the movie became a critical and commercial success, grossing over $782 million worldwide.

title: Kidnap
tagline: Vengeance is Mom
overview: A mother (in her Minivan) stops at nothing to recover her kidnapped son.
plot:
Kidnap is a 2017 American action thriller directed by Luis Prieto and written by Knate Lee. Halle Berry stars as Karla Dyson, a working mother who chases the people who abducted her young son, with Sage Correa as her son Frankie, Chris McGinn and Lew Temple as the kidnappers Margo and Terry Vickey, and Jason Winston George as Karla's estranged husband. Filmed in Louisiana in late 2014 on a budget of about 21 million dollars, it was delayed several times after its original distributor, Relativity Media, filed for bankruptcy in 2015, and it was eventually released by the newly founded Aviron Pictures in August 2017.

Karla is a waitress and a single mother involved in a custody dispute with her former husband. One afternoon she takes her six-year-old son Frankie to a carnival in a park. While she takes a phone call from her lawyer, Frankie vanishes, and Karla finds only his toy voice recorder. Rushing into the parking lot, she sees a woman forcing Frankie into a green Ford Mustang driven by a man.

Without her phone, which she dropped in the panic, Karla jumps into her minivan and gives chase. What follows is an almost continuous pursuit along the highways around New Orleans. The kidnappers try to shake her off by causing a multi-car pile-up and threaten to kill the boy with a knife. From Frankie's recorder, Karla learns that the woman's name is Margo. A motorcycle police officer she alerts is killed by the kidnappers, and Margo offers to return Frankie in exchange for ten thousand dollars. Karla refuses to give up, fighting off Margo in her own car, and she persists in following the kidnappers even when the police seem unable to help, eventually tracking them to their isolated home in the countryside, where she must confront them alone to rescue her son.

The film is built almost entirely around Berry's performance and the extended car chase, with little dialogue and a focus on a mother's determination to save her child at any cost.

Kidnap received mostly negative reviews, with an approval rating of about 35 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, although Berry's committed performance was frequently praised. It grossed about 34.8 million dollars worldwide, of which 31 million came from the United States and Canada.

title: The Age of Adaline
tagline: Love is timeless.
overview: After 29-year-old Adaline recovers from a nearly lethal accident, she inexplicably stops growing older. As the years stretch on and on, Adaline keeps her secret to herself  until she meets a man who changes her life.
plot:
Adaline Marie Bowman was born on New Year's Day, 1908, in San Francisco at 12:01 a.m. to Faye and Milton Bowman. In 1929, when she was twenty-one, Adaline married engineer Clarence James Prescott. Three years later, in 1932, they had a daughter named Flemming. Five years later, in 1937, Clarence and nine others were killed during the construction of the Golden Gate Bridge. Ten months after his death, Adaline crashed her car into a ravine while driving to her parents' beach cottage and died in a freezing lake in Sonoma County, but a lightning strike that struck her car revived her. From then on, Adaline stopped aging.
Sixteen years pass and, in 1953, after a traffic violation, a police officer confiscates her ID and thinks it must be fake, as she is now forty-five but still appears twenty-nine. Adaline moves back to San Francisco and takes a clerical job at a medical school, but finds no information about her condition. Two FBI agents attempt to abduct her for study. She realizes she must spend the rest of her life on the run, changing her identity every decade. She bids a tearful goodbye to now-adult Flemming, who continues to age, eventually looking older than her mother.
Six decades later, in 2015, under the alias "Jennifer Larson," Adaline meets philanthropist Ellis Jones. She knows she cannot have a normal relationship, but is still drawn to him. She goes along to his parents' 40th wedding anniversary celebration. His father William recognizes her instantly, addressing her as Adaline, but she claims Adaline was her mother, who died six years earlier. They each privately reflect on how they had met and fallen in love decades earlier, and how he had wanted to marry her, only for her to leave him before he could propose. William is shaken when he notices a scar on her hand from an injury Adaline sustained while they were hiking together. He confronts her, and she admits the truth. He begs her to stay for Ellis's sake, but Adaline instead writes Ellis a note and leaves. Finding the letter, Ellis confronts his father, who refuses to explain.
Driving home, Adaline has a change of heart. She stops and calls Flemming, now old enough to be her grandmother, to say she is tired of running. As she turns around, a flatbed truck collides with her car, pushing it into a ravine. Thrown from the car, Adaline's heart stops due to hypothermia. An ambulance crew revives her with a defibrillator and she wakes up in the hospital with Ellis at her bedside. They profess their love, and Adaline tells him of her 107 years of life and fear of being discovered.
A year later, Ellis and Adaline are leaving for a New Year's Eve party when, in the hallway mirror, she notices a grey hair. When Ellis asks if she is okay, she replies that she's "perfect." A voiceover explains that the jolt from the defibrillator restarted her aging process. Adaline smiles, realizing that she is now able to grow old with Ellis.

title: Trumbo
tagline: Are you now or have you ever been...
overview: The career of screenwriter Dalton Trumbo is halted by a witch hunt in the late 1940s when he defies the anti-communist HUAC committee and is blacklisted.
plot:
Trumbo is a 2015 biographical drama film that delves into the life of Dalton Trumbo, a Hollywood screenwriter who was blacklisted in the 1950s due to his involvement with the Communist Party. The movie masterfully weaves together themes of artistic integrity, loyalty, and the struggle for redemption.

At its core, Trumbo is a story about the power of creative expression and the importance of staying true to one's values, even in the face of adversity. Dalton Trumbo, played by Bryan Cranston, is a talented screenwriter who finds himself at odds with the House Un-American Activities Committee (HUAC) and the Hollywood Blacklist. Despite being forced into silence, Trumbo continues to write, often under pseudonyms, and his work is eventually rediscovered by a young director, Kirk Douglas.

The film explores the tension between loyalty to one's country and loyalty to one's art. Trumbo's decision to cooperate with HUAC ultimately leads to his blacklisting, but it also allows him to continue writing and contributing to the film industry in meaningful ways. This internal conflict is reflected in the character of Trumbo himself, who struggles to reconcile his commitment to communism with his love of America and its ideals.

The movie also touches on the theme of redemption, as Trumbo seeks to clear his name and restore his reputation after years of silence. Through his relationships with those around him, including his wife, Christine (Helen Mirren), and his friend, Robert Aldrich (David Strathairn), Trumbo finds a way to reclaim his artistic voice and find forgiveness.

Overall, Trumbo is a powerful exploration of the human spirit, highlighting the importance of staying true to oneself and one's values, even in the face of adversity. The film is a testament to the enduring power of art and creativity, and the impact that individuals can have on society through their work.

title: Dinosaur Island
tagline: Their world is closer than you think.
overview: The adventure begins when Lucas, a 13 year old boy, embarks on the vacation of a lifetime. When disaster strikes, Lucas finds himself stranded in a strange land littered with ghost ships and prehistoric creatures. While searching for other signs of life, Lucas hears a radio broadcast in the distance and is drawn into the jungle where he encounters a beautiful young girl who claims to have come from the 1950s. Together they set out on a quest to get home all the while uncovering secrets that will forever change the future.
plot:
Dinosaur Island, released in the United Kingdom as Journey to Dinosaur Island, is a 2014 British-Australian family adventure film written and directed by Matt Drummond, with Jason Moody and Megan Williams as co-producers. It concerns a mysterious island where a special type of crystal acts as a portal, drawing in people and objects from different eras. Darius Williams stars as the 13-year-old Lucas Winton, with Kate Rasmussen as the young Kathryn, Juliette Palmer as her adult self, and Nicole Yardley, Paul Padagas and Joe Bistaveous in supporting roles.

Visiting his grandmother's old house, now up for sale, Lucas finds a crystal in a box on a bookshelf and pockets it. On a flight, he places it on the empty seat beside him, where it begins to glow; disaster strikes the plane, and Lucas wakes up stranded in a strange land strewn with ghost ships and roamed by prehistoric creatures. Following a distant radio broadcast into the jungle, he meets Kate, a girl who says she comes from the 1950s and once owned a crystal like his. She gives him her diary as a survival guide and introduces him to Mimos, a Sinornithosaurus that can mimic any sound, like a lyrebird. Lucas learns that mists appear during earthquakes and bring empty airplanes from different times, past and future, often loaded with useful supplies.

While investigating a newly arrived plane, the two are captured by tribespeople and locked in a wooden cage. A fellow prisoner recognises Lucas's crystal as a "sing sing stone" and explains that huge formations of it between the island's twin volcanoes create the mists. Lucas deduces that the cluster is a giant piezoelectric crystal set resonating by seismic activity, and that it could carry him home. The pair escape, catch a ride on a pterosaur Kate has freed, and survive a chase by a Tyrannosaurus, which Mimos scares away by imitating its roar, then outrun a pack of dromaeosaurs. In the cave between the volcanoes, Lucas uses a singing jar of water to activate the crystals. As the portal opens, Kate stays behind to retrieve her diary, promising to follow. Lucas wakes up in hospital and meets his grandmother Kathryn, who reveals that she is Kate, and who later wins a Nobel Prize with the evidence in her diary.

The film was released in Australian cinemas by Hoyts and United Cinemas in February 2015 and sold to more than 50 countries after its rights were acquired at Cannes in 2014.

As they journey through the Scorch, a desolate wasteland filled with danger and uncertainty, Thomas begins to realize that he has a crucial role to play in the survival of humanity. He also starts to uncover clues about the true nature of the Glade and the organization known as WICKED (World In Catastrophe: Killzone Experiment Department).

The group encounters various obstacles, including rogue factions, infected humans, and treacherous terrain. Along the way, Thomas forms a bond with Teresa (Riley Keough), a young woman who has been infected by the Flare.

As they near their destination, the group discovers that WICKED is behind the creation of the Maze and the Glade. The organization's true intentions are revealed to be sinister, and Thomas must confront the harsh reality of his existence.

The movie culminates in a thrilling showdown between Thomas and the leader of WICKED, Ava Paige (Patricia Clarkson). In a surprising twist, it is revealed that Ava is actually a clone of Teresa, created by WICKED as part of their experiment to create a super-soldier.

In the end, Thomas and his friends successfully escape from WICKED's facility, but not without sacrifices. The movie concludes with Thomas reflecting on the true nature of humanity and the importance of friendship in the face of adversity.

Overall, Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials is an action-packed and suspenseful film that explores themes of survival, loyalty, and the human condition.

title: All the Old Knives
tagline: Secrets kill.
overview: When the CIA discovers one of its agents leaked information that cost more than 100 people their lives, veteran operative Henry Pelham is assigned to root out the mole with his former lover and colleague Celia Harrison.
plot:
All the Old Knives is a 2022 American spy thriller directed by Janus Metz Pedersen and written by Olen Steinhauer, adapting his own 2015 novel. Chris Pine and Thandiwe Newton star as former CIA colleagues and lovers, with Laurence Fishburne, Jonathan Pryce, David Dawson and Corey Johnson. Amazon Studios released it in limited cinemas and on Prime Video on April 8, 2022.

In early 2020, CIA officer Henry Pelham is told by his chief at the Vienna station, Vick Wallinger, that the agency has reopened the case of Turkish Alliance Flight 127, a 2012 hijacking in Vienna that ended in disaster, because a mole in the station is suspected. Henry is sent to California to interview his former lover and colleague Celia Harrison, who abruptly left him and the agency after the hijacking and now lives with her husband and children in Carmel-by-the-Sea. They meet for dinner at an almost empty seaside restaurant.

In flashbacks, Islamist militants seize the plane on the runway and demand the release of prisoners. The station learns that a Chechen extremist, Ilyas Shishani, a former source whom Henry had once been forced to betray, may be involved. Ahmed, a CIA courier on board, sends messages suggesting an assault through the undercarriage, but Celia notices that their wording has changed and suspects he has been exposed, and finds a call to Iran from the office of her mentor, Bill Compton. Ahmed is murdered, and the hijackers eventually release sarin gas, killing everyone on board.

As the evening goes on, the conversation becomes a contest of wits. Celia reveals that she left because she saw the same Iranian number on Henry's phone and realised he was the leak, and that she has arranged this meeting to kill him: the diners and staff are fakes, and his wine has been poisoned, with the help of an Austrian intelligence officer, Karl Stein, and Vick. Dying, Henry confesses that Ilyas had threatened Celia's life, and that to save her he revealed the planned assault and Ahmed's presence. Celia tells him that the captured Ilyas had already named him. Henry accepts his fate, Celia returns to her family, and Vick is seen overseeing the clearing of Henry's apartment.

Critics were moderately positive, giving it 63% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and praising the chemistry between Pine and Newton.

title: Rise of the Legend
overview: In 1868 during the late Qing Dynasty, rampant corruption on the Imperial Court inflicts much suffering in people's lives. For years, the Black Tiger’s fearsome boss Lei Gong has been trying to get rid of the leader of the Northern Sea. One of his latest recruits is Fei, a fearless fighter who takes the Northern Sea leader’s head after a fierce fight. Just as Lei Gong believes he has total control of the port, a new gang called the Orphans rises in power. Led by Fei’s childhood friend Huo, the Orphans are out to eliminate all the criminal power from the port…
plot:
Rise of the Legend is a 2014 Hong Kong-Chinese kung fu action film directed by Roy Chow from a screenplay by Christine To, offering an origin story for the folk hero Wong Fei-hung. Eddie Peng plays the young Wong, leading an ensemble that includes Sammo Hung, Wang Luodan, Jing Boran, Max Zhang, Wong Cho-lam, Angelababy and Tony Leung Ka-fai. It opened in China in November 2014.

The story is set in Guangzhou in 1868, during the late Qing dynasty, where control of the Huangpu port is split between two criminal organisations, the Black Tiger gang and the Northern Sea gang. Master Lui, the ruthless head of the Black Tiger, has long wanted the rival boss eliminated. That task falls to a new recruit, the 21-year-old Wong Fei-hung, who defeats and beheads the Northern Sea leader in a ferocious duel. Impressed, Lui adopts Wong as his godson and elevates him to the Four Tigers, the inner circle of the gang's most trusted enforcers.

Wong, however, is not what he seems. He has infiltrated the Black Tiger to destroy it from within, working with childhood friends on the outside: Fiery, who secretly adores their friend Chun; Chun herself, Wong's sweetheart; the ally Foon; and Big Tooth, a former gang member who joins the mission. Inside the gang, Wong and Chun kill Black Crow, another of the Four Tigers, to obtain his key to the gang's bank vault. Wong also learns that the courtesan Xiao Hua is a childhood friend he had long lost track of. Wu Long, the son of the slain Northern Sea leader, seeks revenge against the Black Tiger, and Lui kills him even as Wong tries to spare his life. The mission exacts a heavy toll: Fiery sacrifices himself to keep Wong's role as a mole from being exposed, and Xiao Hua dies near the end while helping him in her own way. Tony Leung Ka-fai appears as Wong's father, Wong Kei-ying, a martial artist and physician who died in a fire started by a villain while saving his disciples. As the truth about the young man's past comes out, the conflict heads toward a final confrontation with Lui.

The project was announced in August 2013 by Edko Films, Irresistible Delta and BDI Films, with William Kong, Liu Erdong and Ivy Ho producing. Principal photography started in China on 20 August 2013 and wrapped in mid-December. In June 2014 Universal Pictures International acquired the international rights, including North America, while Edko handled distribution in Asia.

title: Patient Zero
overview: After an unprecedented global pandemic has turned the majority of humankind into violent infected beings, Morgan, a man gifted with the ability to speak the infected's new language, leads the last survivors on a hunt for patient zero and a cure.
plot:
After an outbreak of a mutated form of rabies that spreads from animals to humans, over 7 billion humans are dead or infected. People who are bitten turn rabid in 90 seconds. Morgan was riding in a car with his wife Janet when they were attacked. Both were infected, but he remained human with the ability to communicate with the infected.
Now with a large group of civilians, CDC scientists, and U.S. military in an underground nuclear base, Morgan and virologist Dr. Gina Rose bring in the infected and interrogate them, hoping to find the Patient Zero and devise a cure. Gina struggles with tensions between herself, Morgan, and Colonel Knox, compounded by Knox being attracted to Gina while she is currently intimate with Morgan. Morgan visits with Janet, who is held captive amongst others in the underground base. She's being treated with an experimental treatment derived from Morgan's blood.
Gina is shown with a positive pregnancy test. Bodies of fallen soldiers are being cremated when one opens his eyes and attacks the workers and soldiers. After a one-on-one fight with Knox, he is subdued and asks to speak with Morgan specifically, who is surprised that the patient is unaffected by the music that has driven the other infected into a rage. He even lights and starts smoking a cigarette from his pocket. The team assumes he's closely linked to Patient Zero. The patient reveals that he was a college professor and his school was attacked by the infected during one of his lectures. He was bitten but still maintains most of his human abilities. The Professor tells Morgan that the infected are evolved humans, a more advanced species that are at the top of the food chain. Their debate raises Morgan's suspicions, and soon Morgan finds that another of their previous patients, nicknamed Pete Townshend, has a transmitter sewn inside his chest, revealing that the infected laid a trap to learn where the base is located.
The infected swarm inside, killing or infecting all the humans, including civilians. Now overrun Knox shoots his commander so the infected are slowed down long enough for him and Gina to make it to the elevator. Horrified by his actions, Gina grabs his gun. He tries to tell her he wanted to save her life. They begin to scuffle and the gun goes off, killing Knox. Gina goes to the cells where the infected are kept and finds Morgan releasing Janet. Gina pleads with him to leave Janet since the treatments work but only temporarily, but he refuses. They sneak to Gina's lab, retrieve her samples, and crawl through the vents. They encounter an infected lab rat, which Janet kills before it can get to Gina. They make it to the parking lot just below ground level.
The Professor confronts them and explains that he came to the base to kill Morgan. Morgan is their "Patient Zero" and is a threat to their survival. They fight and the Professor starts calling other infected, until Morgan impales him on a pipe.

title: Monkey Kingdom
tagline: Adventure is in Full Swing.
overview: A newborn monkey and its mother struggle to survive within the competitive social hierarchy of the Temple Troop, a dynamic group of monkeys who live in ancient ruins found deep in the storied jungles of South Asia.
plot:
In the ruins of an ancient city in the jungles of Polonnaruwa in Sri Lanka, Maya is a toque macaque who was born at the bottom of the social order tree in her family. Even though she is a lowborn, the troop's alpha male, Raja, keeps a close eye on her, and considers Maya to be his property. One day, during the courtship season, a handsome male monkey named Kumar arrives & catches Maya's gaze from just outside of the troupe's territory. As Maya is in estrus, she and Kumar discreetly mate, but are caught by Raja, who knows that he has been duped. Kumar is chased away by Raja and his sub-alpha male guards.
6 months later, Maya gives birth to Kumar's son, Kip. With Kumar gone, Maya is left to raise, feed and care for their new son alone. As monsoon season arrives, Maya takes advantage of the feast that it brings. Later, during a time of food scarcity after the monsoon season ends, Maya takes Kip and leads the other Lowborn to a lily pond, where they forage and even dive to procure the nutritious seed pods of the lotus lily, knowing that the Highborn would not even recognize the lotus lily pond as a possible food source. As Maya and her fellow Lowborn submerge and emerge with seed pods, they are unknowingly being stalked by a monitor lizard. Maya, Kip and the Lowborn watch in horror as one of their own is captured and eaten by the monitor lizard.
The next day, Maya, with Kip clinging to her, then finds a caterpillar patch and begins gorging on the highly nutritious caterpillars. When the queens of the family, known as the Sisterhood, discover that Maya has not given them priority over this high protein, high value food source, Maya is beaten mercilessly by the trio, who then kidnap her son, Kip, and take him far from Maya. After some time, the Sisterhood lose interest in Kip and abandon him, leaving him alone in the woods. Maya searches for hours for her lost child, frequently calling out to him vocally, until finally, the two are reunited.
The next day, Maya leads the Lowborn far from their home into a neighboring city, where they find copious food. They raid a home full of food intended for a birthday party that's to occur later that afternoon. With the humans away and oblivious to the macaque's break-in, Maya and her cohorts gorge on birthday cake, bread, fruit and all other manner of food. During the actual raid, Kip remains safe with another lowborn, just outside of the home that his mother has raided. The lowborn return to the troop's home in the forest, a granite outcrop called Castle Rock, and they fall asleep with full stomachs.
As the sun rises the next day, Maya awakens to see Kip's father, Kumar, lurking just outside of the troupe's territory boundary. Having met with such a hasty exit with his last visit, Kumar is much wiser and more careful this time. He pays his dues, so to speak, gently and gradually introducing himself into the troop. He first befriends the young macaques, playing and wrestling with them.

title: The Boss Baby
tagline: Born leader
overview: A story about how a new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative 7 year old named Tim.
plot:
Tim Templeton, an imaginative 7-year-old boy, is taken aback when his new baby brother, known as "the Boss Baby", arrives. Baby wears a suit and tie and acts like a normal baby around parents, but acts like an adult when parents are absent. Tim catches him one night and Baby tells him that he needs to make way for the next generation and stay out of his way. The next day, Baby holds a staff meeting with five other infants, under the guise of a neighborhood play date. Tim attempts to record them on a tape before Baby and his cronies spot and chase him, resulting in it being destroyed. With no evidence to support him, Tim is grounded for trying to get rid of Baby and is ordered to stay in the house with him until he learns to get along, much to both of their dismay.
Later, Baby reveals the truth as to why he is in his house and where he comes from. He and Tim suck a special pacifier that allows them to see Baby Corp, where babies come from. Most babies go to families, but those unresponsive to tickling are sent to management, where they are given a special baby formula that allows them to think and behave like adults while remaining young forever. Baby explains he is on a special mission to investigate the declining love for babies due to puppies, which is why he came to the Templetons as Tim's parents work for Puppy Co, and he will leave once his mission is done. Once he does, he will get a promotion to CEO. However, the boys hear Baby's boss threatening to fire him if he fails, which would mean Baby would have to stay, have his formula taken away, slowly turn into a normal baby, and grow up with the Templeton family. Tim and Baby team up to prevent this.
On Take Your Kids to Work Day, the parents lift the grounding when the boys pretend to love each other and take Tim and Baby with them to Puppy Co. While investigating, they are caught by Puppy Co.'s CEO, Francis E. Francis, who is then revealed to be Baby's longtime idol: Super Colossal Big Fat Boss Baby, a former CEO of Baby Corp. Francis revealed that he was fired from Baby Corp because his lactose intolerance rendered the formula useless to him. He takes away Baby's formula to create a "Forever Puppy", a puppy incapable of aging, which will take all the love from babies and get him his revenge on Baby Corp.
Francis takes Tim's parents to a conference in Las Vegas and leaves his older brother, Eugene, to watch the boys under the guise of a female nanny. The boys attack Eugene with fake vomit and escape him with the help of the neighborhood babies. After traveling to Las Vegas in a plane full of Elvis impersonators, they find Francis ready to launch a rocket of Forever Puppies out into the world. Tim's parents are trapped below the rocket to be burned. Tim and Baby fight Francis on a catwalk, making him fall into a vat of formula that turns him back into a baby; Eugene takes Francis away to "raise him right".

title: Attack on Titan
original_title: 進撃の巨人 ATTACK ON TITAN
tagline: The face of humanity's extinction.
overview: 100 years ago, titans suddenly appeared on Earth. Soon, human civilization veered on collapse due to the titans. Humans then built a giant wall to defend themselves. Within the giant walls, humans lived in peace, but, 100 years later, the giant wall is broken.
plot:
Attack on Titan is a 2015 Japanese post-apocalyptic action film directed by Shinji Higuchi and written by Yūsuke Watanabe and Tomohiro Machiyama, the first of two live-action films based on Hajime Isayama's manga. At Isayama's suggestion, the story moves its setting to an analogue of Japan and adds new characters. Haruma Miura stars as Eren, with Kiko Mizuhara as Mikasa, Kanata Hongō as Armin, Hiroki Hasegawa as Captain Shikishima, Pierre Taki as Souda, Jun Kunimura as Kubal, Satomi Ishihara as Hange and Nanami Sakuraba as Sasha.

A century ago, giant humanoid Titans appeared and wiped out most of humanity, and the survivors walled themselves in to live in peace. In the village of Monzen, Eren tells his friends Armin and Mikasa that he longs to see the world beyond the Outer Wall, and after a failed attempt to approach it, the Garrison captain Souda tells them that the military is forming a scouting regiment to explore outside. Suddenly the Colossal Titan breaches the wall, and Titans pour into the village, devouring people and regenerating whenever they are wounded. While trying to save a baby, Mikasa is separated from Eren and presumed dead. Two years later, Eren and Armin join the Scout Regiment along with Sasha, Jean and others, led by Kubal, they set out for a town inside the Outer Wall. Attacked by Titans, they are rescued by Captain Shikishima and by Mikasa, who survived and has joined the Scouts but now treats Eren like a stranger. She tells him that the disaster taught her how cruel the world is, and Eren is crushed to realize that she is probably with Shikishima. When more Titans strike, Kubal retreats and leaves the Scouts to fend for themselves. Lil, who has just lost her lover, sacrifices herself, and Eren, refusing Jean's pleas to flee, loses an arm and is swallowed while saving Armin. A grief-stricken Mikasa fights on until her gear runs low on fuel and she faces the Titan that ate Eren, when a new Titan bursts out of it and begins battling the others. Souda and Mikasa realize that it is Eren, and as it collapses, Mikasa pulls him free from the Titan's body.

After a world premiere at the Egyptian Theatre in Los Angeles on 14 July 2015, the film opened in Japan on 1 August, followed by the second part, End of the World, in September. It topped the Japanese box office on its opening weekend and grossed ¥3.25 billion. Critics were mixed, praising the Titan designs and B-movie style while faulting the script and departures from the manga.

title: Burnt
tagline: Never underestimate a man with everything to lose.
overview: Adam Jones is a Chef who destroyed his career with drugs and diva behavior. He cleans up and returns to London, determined to redeem himself by spearheading a top restaurant that can gain three Michelin stars.
plot:
Burnt is a 2015 comedy-drama directed by John Wells and written by Steven Knight from a story by Michael Kalesniko. Bradley Cooper stars as Adam Jones, with Sienna Miller as Helene, Daniel Brühl as Tony, Omar Sy as Michel, Matthew Rhys as Reece, Alicia Vikander as Anne Marie, Uma Thurman as the critic Simone and Emma Thompson as Dr. Rosshilde.

Adam was once a two-Michelin-star chef in Paris, but drugs and his temper destroyed his career and his mentor Jean-Luc's restaurant. He sobers up in New Orleans by shucking a million oysters and then arrives in London determined to win a third star. He finds Tony Balerdi, Jean-Luc's former maître d', now managing a London hotel. He also tracks down old colleagues, including Michel, whose restaurant he once sabotaged, and Max, who is just out of prison. Adam arranges for the influential critic Simone to dine at the hotel, and her positive review persuades Tony to rebuild the kitchen and hire Adam on the condition that he submits to weekly drug tests with Dr. Rosshilde. Adam recruits the talented sous-chef Helene by tripling her pay.

Adam bullies his staff without mercy, and a disastrous opening night ends with him humiliating Helene, who quits. Tony persuades her to come back. The relaunch earns good reviews and annoys Adam's rival, Montgomery Reece, and Adam gradually softens, even baking a birthday cake for Helene's daughter, Lily. Then his past catches up with him. He meets his former girlfriend Anne Marie, Jean-Luc's daughter, whom he had abandoned, and enforcers for his old dealer beat him up over an unpaid debt. When two diners he believes are Michelin inspectors arrive, Michel ruins their dishes with cayenne pepper in revenge and leaves. Adam gets drunk and goes to Reece, who comforts him. He then learns that Anne Marie has paid his debt and that the diners were not inspectors after all. Opening up to Helene and finally trusting his team, Adam leads the kitchen through the real inspection, and the restaurant earns its third star.

The Weinstein Company released Burnt on October 30, 2015. Jamie Dornan's scenes were cut during editing. It opened with only $5 million and grossed $36.6 million worldwide against a $20 million budget. Critics praised Cooper but criticized the script. Rotten Tomatoes' consensus described a few spoonfuls of compelling culinary drama lost in a watery goulash of cliché and an unsavory lead.

title: Me Before You
tagline: Live boldly.
overview: A small town girl is caught between dead-end jobs. A high-profile, successful man becomes wheelchair bound following an accident. The man decides his life is not worth living until the girl is hired for six months to be his new caretaker. Worlds apart and trapped together by circumstance, the two get off to a rocky start. But the girl becomes determined to prove to the man that life is worth living and as they embark on a series of adventures together, each finds their world changing in ways neither of them could begin to imagine.
plot:
Me Before You is a 2016 romantic drama directed by Thea Sharrock in her feature directorial debut and adapted by Jojo Moyes from her own 2012 novel. It stars Emilia Clarke as Louisa "Lou" Clark and Sam Claflin as Will Traynor, with Janet McTeer and Charles Dance as Will's parents, Brendan Coyle as Lou's father and Matthew Lewis as her boyfriend Patrick. It was filmed at historic locations across the United Kingdom, including Pembroke Castle in Wales and Chenies Manor House in Buckinghamshire.

In the small English town of Stokebridge, Lou Clark, a cheerful and quirky young woman who needs money to support her family, accepts a six-month position as a caregiver for Will Traynor. Will is a wealthy former banker and adventurous sportsman who became quadriplegic after being hit by a motorcycle two years earlier. Embittered and depressed, he treats Lou coldly at first, and his ex-girlfriend's announcement that she is marrying his former best friend only deepens his despair.

Lou perseveres, and the two gradually grow close as Will introduces her to films, music and ideas beyond the confines of her small-town life, encouraging her to be more ambitious. By chance, Lou learns that Will has agreed to give his parents six months before travelling to Switzerland to end his life through assisted suicide. Determined to change his mind, she plans a series of outings and adventures to show him that life is still worth living. As her relationship with her boyfriend Patrick falls apart, Lou and Will fall in love, culminating in a trip to Mauritius. But Will's decision remains firm, forcing Lou to confront the limits of love and the meaning of respecting another person's choices.

The film's portrayal of disability and assisted suicide drew criticism from many disability rights activists, who argued that it implied that the lives of disabled people are not worth living, and protests were held at several screenings.

Me Before You was released on 3 June 2016 and was a commercial success, grossing about 208.4 million dollars worldwide against a 20 million dollar budget. Reviews were mixed, with 55 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 51, although the performances of Clarke and Claflin were praised.

title: Bridge of Spies
tagline: In the shadow of war, one man showed the world what we stood for.
overview: During the Cold War, the Soviet Union captures U.S. pilot Francis Gary Powers after shooting down his U-2 spy plane. Sentenced to 10 years in prison, Powers' only hope is New York lawyer James Donovan, recruited by a CIA operative to negotiate his release. Donovan boards a plane to Berlin, hoping to win the young man's freedom through a prisoner exchange. If all goes well, the Russians would get Rudolf Abel, the convicted spy who Donovan defended in court.
plot:
Bridge of Spies is a 2015 historical drama film directed and co-produced by Steven Spielberg from a screenplay by Matt Charman and the Coen brothers. Tom Hanks stars as the American lawyer James B. Donovan, with Mark Rylance, Amy Ryan and Alan Alda. Set during the Cold War, it dramatizes how Donovan, after defending a Soviet spy in court, was entrusted with negotiating the exchange of that spy for the American pilot Francis Gary Powers. The title refers to the Glienicke Bridge between Potsdam and Berlin, where the exchange took place.

In New York in 1957, Rudolf Abel is arrested and charged with spying for the Soviet Union. Donovan, a former general counsel of the Office of Strategic Services now working in insurance law, is appointed to defend him. Believing that every accused person deserves a real defense, he takes the job seriously, refuses the CIA's attempts to get him to breach his client's confidentiality and gradually builds a mutual respect with Abel. Although Abel is convicted, Donovan persuades the judge to spare his life, arguing that the spy may one day prove valuable in a prisoner exchange, and he takes an appeal all the way to the Supreme Court, which narrowly upholds the conviction. His principled stand makes him deeply unpopular, and his family is harassed, including shots fired into their home. In 1960 Powers, a pilot in the CIA's secret U-2 program, is shot down over the Soviet Union and imprisoned. When a letter purportedly from Abel's wife arrives, the CIA reads it as a signal that Moscow is ready to trade, and Donovan is sent, unofficially, to Berlin just as the Wall is going up. In East Berlin he must negotiate with a KGB officer and with Vogel, a lawyer representing the East German government, which holds an American graduate student, Frederic Pryor, and wants to use him to win recognition from the United States. Against the CIA's wishes, Donovan insists on bringing home both Powers and Pryor in exchange for Abel, staking the entire deal on a bluff.

Bridge of Spies received critical acclaim for its screenplay, Spielberg's direction, the performances of Hanks and Rylance, Thomas Newman's score and its production values. It grossed $165 million worldwide on a $40 million budget and received six Academy Award nominations, including Best Picture, with Rylance winning Best Supporting Actor.
