title: Vacation
tagline: What could go wrong?
overview: Hoping to bring his family closer together and to recreate his childhood vacation for his own kids, a grown up Rusty Griswold takes his wife and their two sons on a cross-country road trip to the coolest theme park in America, Walley World. Needless to say, things don't go quite as planned.
plot:
Vacation (2015) is a comedy film directed by Jon Favreau, starring Ed Helms as Rusty Griswold, the son of Clark Griswold from the original National Lampoon's Vacation trilogy. The movie follows Rusty, who has been estranged from his family for years due to his own personal issues and lack of interest in following in his father's footsteps.

The story begins with Rusty (Ed Helms) receiving an invitation from his father, Clark Griswold (Chevy Chase), to join him on a road trip to the Walley World theme park in California. Rusty is initially hesitant but eventually agrees to go along with the trip, hoping it will be a chance for him and his family to reconnect.

Upon arrival at the park, Rusty discovers that Clark has been planning this trip for years and has made numerous changes to the original itinerary, including booking them into a budget-friendly motel instead of their usual luxury accommodations. The Griswold family also meets a new character, Jules (Wendy Schaal), who is Clark's girlfriend.

As they embark on their journey, Rusty struggles to connect with his family and find common ground with his father, who seems more interested in reliving old memories than making new ones. Meanwhile, Rusty tries to navigate the challenges of modern technology and social media, which often leads to comedic misunderstandings.

Throughout the trip, Clark's antics and eccentricities continue to drive Rusty crazy, but he also starts to see his father in a different light. The family faces various obstacles, including a disastrous visit to a roadside attraction, a run-in with a group of aggressive bikers, and a chaotic encounter with a group of rowdy teenagers.

As the trip progresses, Rusty begins to understand the significance of Clark's nostalgia for the past and the importance of holding onto memories. He also starts to reconnect with his family, particularly his son Owen (Skyler Gisondo), who shares some of his own struggles with technology and social media.

The movie culminates in a heartwarming finale where Rusty finally understands the true meaning of family and the importance of creating new memories together. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Rusty embracing his father's quirks and finding a way to balance his own individuality with his love for his family.

Overall, Vacation (2015) is a lighthearted comedy that explores themes of family, nostalgia, and the importance of human connection in a world dominated by technology.

title: The Night Before
tagline: Their past, present and future. All in one night.
overview: In New York City for their annual tradition of Christmas Eve debauchery, three lifelong best friends set out to find the Holy Grail of Christmas parties since their yearly reunion might be coming to an end.
plot:
In December 2001, Ethan loses his parents in a car accident. His best friends Isaac and Chris resolve to spend every Christmas Eve with him so that he will not be alone.
The trio continue their holiday tradition every year until 2015, when they finally decide to end it, as Chris has become a famous football player while Isaac is married with a baby on the way. Both worry that Ethan, a struggling musician working dead-end jobs, is not ready for the tradition to end.
At work, Ethan finds and steals tickets to the exclusive Nutcracker Ball party within New York City. Before embarking on their last Christmas Eve together, Isaac's pregnant wife Betsy gives him recreational drugs, including magic mushrooms and cocaine.
To please his teammates, Chris purchases marijuana from their former high school dealer Mr. Green. At the karaoke bar, the trio runs into Diana, who broke up with Ethan three months ago due to his failure to commit and refusal to meet her parents, and her friend Sarah, both of whom are also attending the Nutcracker Ball. Isaac, affected by the drugs, records a video message confessing that he is terrified of having a child. Chris hooks up with a supposed fan who steals his marijuana.
The friends contact Mr. Green for more marijuana. Isaac realizes he accidentally switched phones with Sarah when he begins to receive sexts. The thief steals Chris' marijuana again, and the friends split up, as Chris wants his marijuana back and Isaac wants his phone, leaving an upset Ethan behind. Chris fails to recover the marijuana; Isaac, hallucinating from drugs, runs into Betsy and her family at church and vomits on the church floor during Midnight Mass. Ethan is beaten by two drunk pub crawling men dressed as Santa Claus after a confrontation.
Meeting back at the subway station, the tension between the friends explodes as Ethan reveals that they know Chris' sudden success is due to steroids, and Chris reveals that he and Isaac think Ethan is lost and not doing anything with his life. Nevertheless, the friends go to the Nutcracker Ball. Chris learns that his teammates did not need the marijuana he struggled to obtain, and mock him. Ethan meets Miley Cyrus, under whose encouragement he spontaneously proposes to Diana in front of the entire party. While she accepts publicly, Diana angrily declines in private, saying that he only proposed out of fear of being alone.
Ashamed and hurt, Ethan goes to the roof where he finds Mr. Green, who reveals that he is the creator of the Nutcracker Ball. Ethan believes his friends no longer need him but Mr. Green makes him experience the memory of his friends creating their yearly ritual that first Christmas after Ethan lost his parents. Ethan then finds Chris and Isaac calling for him after being thrown out due to an altercation with Chris' teammates.
As morning dawns, the friends reconcile. Mr. Green is revealed to be an angel, helping the friends in order to earn his wings.

title: Love & Friendship
tagline: A lady never reveals her tactics.
overview: From Jane Austen’s novella, the beautiful and cunning Lady Susan Vernon visits the estate of her in-laws to wait out colorful rumors of her dalliances and to find husbands for herself and her daughter. Two young men, handsome Reginald DeCourcy and wealthy Sir James Martin, severely complicate her plans.
plot:
In the 1790s, the recently widowed and relatively young Lady Susan Vernon seeks a wealthy match for her only daughter, Frederica, and a wealthy husband for herself, to renew her fortunes. After being turned out of the Manwaring estate due to her dalliance with the married Lord Manwaring, she and her unpaid companion Mrs Cross head to Churchill, the country home of her brother-in-law (her late husband's brother), Charles Vernon, and his wife Catherine Vernon (née DeCourcy). Lady Susan frankly discusses her plans during visits to her trusted friend, the American Mrs Johnson.
Catherine and her younger brother, Reginald DeCourcy, are aware of Lady Susan's reputation as a determined and accomplished flirt. Under the influence of the amiable but dull Charles, Reginald agrees to keep an open mind, and soon finds himself enchanted with Lady Susan. When Reginald's father, Sir Reginald DeCourcy, learns of this, he warns Reginald against marrying Lady Susan lest the family name be sullied. Reginald says their relationship is not romantic; however, he and Lady Susan soon reach a romantic understanding.
Lady Susan's daughter, Frederica, who has been attending a boarding school which her mother cannot afford, runs away and is expelled. Frederica arrives at Churchill followed by Sir James Martin, who is both very wealthy and foolish. For example, upon arrival at Churchill, he explains that he struggled to find the estate as he had been looking for "church hill", a church and/or a hill.
Frederica confides in Reginald that she does not want to marry Sir James because he is "silly", but she fears her mother's determination to marry her off. Surprised, he decides to take up Frederica's case with Lady Susan and, after their confrontation, he decides to leave. However, Lady Susan smooths things over with him, then plots to punish him for his disloyalty.
When both Lady Susan and Reginald are in London, she seeks to delay their marriage, saying society does not yet approve of them (presumably because she is much older). Then, Lady Susan's relationship with Lord Manwaring is exposed when Lady Manwaring discovers the lovers are meeting in private, facilitated by Lady Susan's friend Mrs Johnson. Lady Manwaring appeals to her guardian, Mr Johnson, to confront them.
Reginald arrives with a letter from Lady Susan to Mrs Johnson and overhears Lady Manwaring crying. She emerges with Mr Johnson, who says he cannot help her, and in desperation she snatches the letter Mrs Johnson holds, recognising the handwriting. She insists her husband is with Lady Susan, but Reginald claims he has just left her, and she is "completely alone" for even the servants have been dismissed. Lady Manwaring is suspicious and demands a footman tell her what he saw at the house. He says, after Reginald and the servants left, he saw Lord Manwaring arrive and enter the house.

title: Deepwater Horizon
tagline: When faced with our darkest hour, hope is not a tactic
overview: A story set on the offshore drilling rig Deepwater Horizon, which exploded during April 2010 and created the worst oil spill in U.S. history.
plot:
Deepwater Horizon is a 2016 American biographical disaster film directed by Peter Berg and written by Matthew Michael Carnahan, Matthew Robbins, and Billy Ray. The film is based on the true story of the Deepwater Horizon oil spill, which occurred on April 20, 2010.

The movie begins with Mike Williams (played by Mark Wahlberg), a young and ambitious oil rig worker who has just been hired to work on the Deepwater Horizon, an offshore drilling platform located in the Gulf of Mexico. The film then cuts to the present day, where we see Mike as a single father living in Houston, Texas.

Mike is struggling to make ends meet after his daughter's death in a car accident, and he sees this new job as an opportunity to provide for her. He reunites with his old flame, Andrea Fleytas (played by Kate Hudson), who has become a nurse at the hospital where Mike works.

As Mike begins working on the Deepwater Horizon, we see him quickly rise through the ranks due to his exceptional skills and work ethic. However, tensions begin to rise among the crew as they face numerous challenges, including equipment failures and disagreements with their superiors.

On April 20, 2010, a catastrophic explosion occurs on the rig, killing 11 workers and injuring many more. The film then cuts to the aftermath of the disaster, where we see Mike's efforts to help rescue his fellow crew members and find out what caused the explosion.

As the investigation into the disaster unfolds, it becomes clear that the rig was not properly maintained, and that BP (British Petroleum) had been aware of the risks associated with drilling in the Gulf. The film then cuts to a series of courtroom scenes, where we see Mike testifying against BP, along with other crew members.

Throughout the film, we see flashbacks of the events leading up to the explosion, as well as the aftermath and the subsequent trial. We also see the personal struggles that Mike faces as he tries to come to terms with his daughter's death and find a way to move forward.

The film ends with Mike finally finding closure, having testified against BP and helped bring about justice for the victims of the disaster. The final scene shows Mike reunited with Andrea and their daughter, who has been adopted by another family after her original parents' death.

Overall, Deepwater Horizon is a powerful and emotional film that tells an important story about the human cost of corporate greed and negligence. Mark Wahlberg delivers a strong performance as Mike Williams, bringing depth and nuance to the character. The film's attention to detail and commitment to accuracy make it a compelling watch for anyone interested in true stories or disaster films.

title: Finders Keepers
tagline: No soul is safe
overview: A haunted doll teaches one little girl why children shouldn't play with undead things.
plot:
Finders Keepers is a 2014 American supernatural horror television film directed by Alexander Yellen. Written by Peter Sullivan from a story by Jeffrey Schenck and Sullivan, it was produced by HFD Productions and Hybrid, with a score by Matthew Janszen, and premiered on the Syfy channel on 18 October 2014 before being distributed on home video by Lionsgate. It runs about 85 minutes and stars Jaime Pressly, Kylie Rogers, Patrick Muldoon and Tobin Bell, its premise summed up by the warning that children should not play with undead things.

The film opens with two police officers entering a house where a family has been murdered; inside, they are attacked and killed by the family's knife-wielding son, Zachary. Five years later, newly separated from her husband Jonathan (Muldoon), Alyson Simon (Pressly) moves into the large old house in the countryside with her nine-year-old daughter Claire (Rogers). The estate agent has kept the killings secret, and Alyson only learns of them after the move. Exploring the house, Claire finds a doll left behind by the previous occupants and soon develops a dangerous obsession with it.

Claire's behaviour grows increasingly disturbing, and deaths begin to pile up, starting with the apparent suicide of Jonathan's new girlfriend during one of Claire's visits. Alyson visits Zachary in a psychiatric institution in search of answers, learning nothing before he later escapes. Every attempt to get rid of the doll fails, as it keeps returning to Claire, and a voodoo-like bond forms between them, so that whatever happens to one happens to the other. Claire's therapist, Dr. Freeman (Bell), mistakes the injuries she suffers when her parents try to destroy the toy for signs of abuse, but is killed after realising she lied. Alyson's friend Elena Carranza (Justina Machado), a professor who studies the paranormal, takes the doll to her laboratory and suggests that removing its eyes will break the connection, but she too falls victim to the possessed girl. In a final struggle at the house, Jonathan gouges out the doll's eyes and breaks the curse, and the reconciled parents decide to sell the house and give their marriage another chance.

The cast also includes Marina Sirtis, Mark DeCarlo and Joey Luthman as the adult Zachary. German-language reviews found the film lacking in suspense and derivative of Sinister and Child's Play, praising the performances of Rogers and Bell but less impressed by Pressly and the dialogue.

title: XX
tagline: Four deadly tales by four killer women
overview: This all-female horror anthology features four dark tales from four fiercely talented women.
plot:
XX is a 2017 American horror anthology film made up of four segments, each written or directed by a woman: Jovanka Vuckovic, Annie Clark (the musician known as St. Vincent, in her directorial debut), Roxanne Benjamin and Karyn Kusama. Natalie Brown, Melanie Lynskey, Breeda Wool and Christina Kirk head the ensemble. The stories are tied together by stop-motion interludes created by Sofia Carrillo, in which a living dollhouse with a blinking doll's face roams about collecting objects, aided by a detached doll's hand, until it finds a small blackbird and places it inside the chest of a sleeping girl, who then wakes.

In "The Box", adapted by Vuckovic from a Jack Ketchum story, a boy named Danny peeks into a red gift box held by a stranger on a train and afterwards refuses to eat. His sister and then his father, after Danny whispers something to them, stop eating too, while his mother Susan is tormented by a dream of her family devouring her. By Christmas the three are emaciated, and Susan later reveals that they all starved to death; she now rides the trains looking for the man with the box.

In "The Birthday Party", directed by Clark from a script she wrote with Benjamin, a mother named Mary finds her husband dead in his study on the morning of her daughter Lucy's birthday party and, rather than call for help, spends the day frantically hiding the body, eventually stuffing it into a rented panda costume, with predictably disastrous results in front of the young guests.

In Benjamin's "Don't Fall", four friends camping in the desert come across an ancient rock painting of an evil spirit; that night a creature possesses one of them, Gretchen, and hunts down the others. In Kusama's "Her Only Living Son", conceived as an unofficial sequel to Rosemary's Baby, a woman calling herself Cora has raised her son Andy in hiding, and as he nears his eighteenth birthday she watches him reveal his true nature as the child of Satan.

The project was announced in 2014 with a different line-up of directors, two of whom left before production. XX premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in January 2017 and was released in select theaters and on demand by Magnet Releasing. Reviews were generally favorable: critics praised the range of female voices and the strongest segments, while some noted that the short running times left little room for character development and that the overall quality was uneven, a common problem in anthologies.

title: PK
tagline: Peeke hai kya?
overview: A stranger in the city asks questions no one has asked before. Known only by his initials, the man's innocent questions and childlike curiosity take him on a journey of love, laughter and letting go.
plot:
A humanoid alien lands in Rajasthan, India, on a research mission but is stranded when a thief steals his spaceship's remote-control amulet. Meanwhile, in Bruges, Belgium, Indian journalism student Jagat "Jaggu" Janani Sahni falls in love with Pakistani student Sarfaraz Yousuf. Her devout father, a follower of fraudulent Hindu godman Tapasvi Maharaj, opposes their interfaith relationship. After Tapasvi predicts Sarfaraz will betray her, Jaggu proposes an immediate registry marriage. At the chapel, however, she receives an unsigned letter calling off the wedding and returns to India heartbroken.
Now a television journalist in Delhi, Jaggu encounters the stranded alien, who distributes pamphlets seeking a "missing" God. After witnessing his arrest for attempting to recover money from a temple donation box as compensation for "broken promises", she secures his release. The alien explains that he survived by stealing clothes from couples, befriended Rajasthani brass bandmaster Bhairon Singh, and learned fluent Bhojpuri by absorbing memories through touch. His attempts to recover the amulet from various places of worship earned him the nickname "PK" (meaning "drunk").
PK explores Hinduism, Sikhism, Christianity, and Islam after being told only God can find his device, but none helps. He eventually discovers that Tapasvi possesses the amulet and falsely presents it as a divine relic from the Himalayas. After confirming PK's extraterrestrial nature, Jaggu agrees to help him retrieve it through her media platform.
PK concludes that religious intermediaries are effectively using a metaphorical "wrong number" to mislead humanity through fabricated dogmas and rituals. His campaign, supported by Jaggu's television network, becomes a nationwide movement exposing religious exploitation and threatening Tapasvi's influence. Meanwhile, Bhairon locates the thief, who admits selling the amulet to Tapasvi, but both are killed in a retaliatory terrorist bombing before they can testify.
Tapasvi challenges PK to a live televised debate. He cites his prediction of Sarfaraz's betrayal as proof of his foresight, but PK, having absorbed Jaggu's memories, recognises inconsistencies in the chapel incident. He deduces that the unsigned letter was delivered to the wrong pew and intended for another bride. Jaggu contacts the Pakistani Embassy in Belgium, which confirms that Sarfaraz found the same letter elsewhere and mistakenly believed Jaggu had rejected him. The broadcast exposes Tapasvi's deception, prompting Jaggu's disillusioned father to demand the remote control's return.
PK retrieves the device and prepares to leave Earth. Although he has fallen in love with Jaggu, he suppresses his feelings out of respect for her relationship with Sarfaraz, keeping recordings of her voice as a memento. Jaggu discovers his love notes but lets him leave, later publishing a bestselling book about his experiences.

plot:
Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast is a 2014 animated fantasy film produced by DisneyToon Studios. The movie serves as the fourth installment in the Tinker Bell series.

The story begins with Tinker Bell (voiced by Mae Whitman) living on Pixie Hollow Island, where she spends her days playing and helping her friends. However, Tinker Bell is feeling unfulfilled and restless, yearning for adventure beyond her island home.

One day, a mysterious creature known as the NeverBeast appears in Pixie Hollow, causing chaos and destruction throughout the island. The NeverBeast is a massive, shape-shifting creature with incredible powers that can manipulate reality itself. Tinker Bell, feeling responsible for the creature's presence, sets out on a journey to find its home and convince it to leave Pixie Hollow.

Along the way, Tinker Bell meets a new friend, Fawn (voiced by Ginnifer Goodwin), who is struggling with her own identity crisis as she prepares to take over as the leader of the fairies. Together, they embark on a quest to find the NeverBeast's home and convince it to leave Pixie Hollow.

As Tinker Bell and Fawn journey through various lands, they encounter different creatures and obstacles that test their courage and friendship. Meanwhile, the villainous Zarina (voiced by Lucy Hale) is revealed to be working with the NeverBeast, seeking to use its powers for her own gain.

Throughout the movie, Tinker Bell learns valuable lessons about responsibility, friendship, and believing in herself. She also discovers that the NeverBeast is not a monster, but rather a misunderstood creature that needs help and understanding.

In the end, Tinker Bell and Fawn successfully convince the NeverBeast to leave Pixie Hollow, and it returns to its home in a distant land. The movie concludes with Tinker Bell returning to Pixie Hollow as a hero, having grown and learned from her adventure.

Overall, Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast is a heartwarming and action-packed film that explores themes of friendship, responsibility, and self-discovery. With its stunning animation and lovable characters, it is a must-see for fans of the Tinker Bell series and DisneyToon Studios.

title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
original_title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
overview: When he is betrayed by a trusted friend, Mathayus must marshal all his strength and cunning to outwit a formidable opponent who will stop at nothing to unlock a supreme ancient power.
plot:
The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power is a 2015 direct-to-video sword-and-sorcery action adventure directed by Mike Elliott and the fourth installment in The Scorpion King series. Victor Webster returns as Mathayus, with Ellen Hollman, Will Kemp, Barry Bostwick, Lou Ferrigno, Rutger Hauer, Royce Gracie and Eve Torres in supporting roles. It was released on home media on January 6, 2015.

Mathayus and his partner Drazen infiltrate a palace to steal an artifact called the Urn of Kings for King Zakkour of Al-Moraad, but Drazen betrays him and escapes with the urn. Sent by Zakkour to the northern kingdom of Norvania to deliver a peace treaty, Mathayus discovers that Drazen is the son of its ruler, King Yannick, who shatters the urn to retrieve the Golden Key of Lord Alcaman, an ancient sorcerer who once ruled the known world. The inscription on the key holds the secret to his power. Mathayus allows himself to be arrested to get inside the castle and meets Valina Raskov, a fierce prisoner from the kingdom's original royal bloodline whom Drazen intends to execute publicly to cement his father's rule.

Yannick believes Mathayus's peace mission and releases him, but Drazen assassinates his father with scorpions and frames Mathayus. Before dying, Yannick passes the key to Mathayus, who escapes with Valina. The pair seek out her father, Sorrell, a scholar and inventor who has no wish to reclaim the throne. He deciphers the inscription, which points to a hidden palace containing Alcaman's crown, an artifact that will grant its wearer power over the world. Drazen seizes the key and leaves them to die in a burning house, but the heroes survive and follow him through a series of villages, temples and traps. In the final confrontation inside the mountain, Drazen is destroyed by the crown's power, and Mathayus uses it to save Sorrell. The heroes seal the key and crown away and declare Alcaman's power a myth. Sorrell is restored to the throne but passes the crown to Valina, who vows to build a kingdom founded on science and reason with just a little bit of magic, and Zakkour releases Mathayus to stay at her side.

The film continued the series' tradition of lighthearted fantasy adventure, mixing martial arts, humor and cameos from genre veterans. A fifth film, The Scorpion King: Book of Souls, followed in 2018 with Zach McGowan replacing Webster.

title: Justice League: Throne of Atlantis
tagline: Blood is thicker than water.
overview: After the events of Justice League: War, Ocean Master and Black Manta have declared a war against the surface in retaliation of the aftermath of Apokoliptian-tyrant Darkseid's planetary invasion. Queen Atlanna seeks out her other son, Ocean Master’s half-brother Arthur Curry, a half-human with aquatic powers with no knowledge of his Atlantean heritage, to restore balance.  Living with powers he doesn’t understand and seeing the danger around him, Curry takes steps to embrace his destiny, joining the Justice League, and with his new teammates he battles to save Earth from total destruction.
plot:
Justice League: Throne of Atlantis is a 2015 American animated superhero film directed by Ethan Spaulding and written by Heath Corson, the 22nd entry in the DC Universe Animated Original Movies line and a standalone sequel to Justice League: War. Loosely based on the Throne of Atlantis story arc from The New 52 by Geoff Johns, it features Matt Lanter as Arthur Curry, Sumalee Montano as Mera, Sam Witwer as Orm, Jason O'Mara as Batman, Jerry O'Connell as Superman, Rosario Dawson as Wonder Woman, Nathan Fillion as Green Lantern, Christopher Gorham as the Flash, Shemar Moore as Cyborg, Sean Astin as Shazam and Harry Lennix as Black Manta.

When the crew of the nuclear submarine USS California is mysteriously killed in the Atlantic and its missiles are stolen, Cyborg and the Justice League investigate and determine that the attackers came from Atlantis. In the undersea kingdom, Prince Orm argues for war against the surface world, which he blames for his father's death, while his mother, Queen Atlanna, opposes him and sends the warrior Mera to bring her other son, Arthur Curry, to Atlantis.

Arthur, a loner living on the surface who is unaware of his heritage, survives an attack by Atlantean soldiers when Mera rescues him. Meanwhile Black Manta, secretly allied with Orm, uses the stolen missiles to strike Atlantis in a vessel disguised as a Navy submarine, framing humanity. Outraged Atlanteans demand war, and as Arthur learns that he is half-Atlantean and heir to the throne, Orm's schemes grow more treacherous. Batman and Superman, who have uncovered Arthur's origin, join Arthur and Mera as the conflict escalates into an invasion of the surface. With the Justice League caught in the middle, Arthur must embrace his identity and claim the mystical trident to stop his half-brother from triggering a war between land and sea.

The film functions as an origin story for Aquaman, focusing on his discovery of his dual identity and his struggle to bridge two worlds.

It was released digitally on January 13, 2015, and on Blu-ray and DVD on January 27. Reviews were mixed, with a 57 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes; Forbes felt it retread familiar ground, while Variety argued that it showed DC consistently outclassing Marvel in animation.

title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
original_title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
tagline: Today's a marvelous day for adventures!
overview: Toby, a cynical film director finds himself trapped in the outrageous delusions of an old Spanish shoe-maker who believes himself to be Don Quixote. In the course of their comic and increasingly surreal adventures, Toby is forced to confront the tragic repercussions of a film he made in his idealistic youth.
plot:
Toby Grummett, a director, is in rural Spain, struggling with the production of a commercial featuring Don Quixote and Sancho Panza. After an unsuccessful day of shooting, Toby's superior, the Boss, introduces him to a Romani street merchant who sells him an old DVD of The Man Who Killed Don Quixote, a film he wrote and directed ten years earlier as a student. Toby watches the film while in bed with the Boss's wife, Jacqui. When the Boss returns to the hotel room, Toby barely escapes without being recognized.
A flashback shows student Toby casting elderly cobbler Javier Sanchez as Don Quixote. Javier initially falters in his characterization, but upon rushing to defend teenage waitress Angelica when a member of Toby's crew plays a prank on her, succeeds in embodying that "I am Don Quixote".
Toby realizes that his current shoot is near the shooting location of The Man Who Killed Don Quixote. Taking a motorbike to Los Sueños, he learns that Angelica has moved away from her father Raul. Toby meets Javier, now working as a tourist attraction. He discovers that Javier has become convinced that he is the real Don Quixote, and that Toby is his squire, Sancho Panza. Quixote accidentally causes a fire that spreads through the town, as Toby escapes on the motorbike.
On the set, police are investigating the "break in" of Jacqui's room. The police notice that Toby's bike was the one spotted in Los Sueños and take him in for questioning. En route, they encounter Don Quixote on his horse Rocinante, who demands that the officers release Toby. When they dismiss him, Quixote attacks, culminating in one of the officers being shot and the Romani man stealing the police car. Quixote supplies Toby with a donkey and clothes from the set, and they set off for adventures.
Quixote notices a windmill and believes it is a giant attacking a woman. Receiving a head wound after being knocked by one of the windmill's blades, Quixote and Toby are led by the woman to a decrepit ruin occupied by impoverished people. The leader, Barbero, welcomes them warmly but locks them in an attic. That night, Toby comes to suspect that they are secretly terrorists, but soon finds that the ruin has transformed into a 17th-century village and its inhabitants are Moriscos hiding their Muslim faith from the Spanish Inquisition. Toby manages to evade the inquisitors, then awakens the next morning, the night's events having seemingly been a dream, and learns that the residents are not terrorists but fearful undocumented immigrants. Quixote, having experienced Toby's "dream", is regaling them with a tale of it.
Moving on with Quixote, Toby finds a bag of old Spanish gold and attempts to hide it, but accidentally falls down a ravine into a cave. There he re-encounters Angelica, who tells him that she works as an escort. She mounts a horse and rides off, with Toby chasing her.

plot:
Suicide Squad is a 2016 superhero film directed by David Ayer and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures. The movie is based on the DC Comics anti-hero team of the same name.

The story begins with Amanda Waller (Viola Davis), a high-ranking government official, who creates a secret task force known as Task Force X, also referred to as the Suicide Squad. This team consists of supervillains who are forced to work together to complete a mission in exchange for reduced prison sentences or pardons.

The main character, Will Smith's character, Deadshot (played by Will Smith), is introduced as he escapes from prison and meets up with Rick Flag (Joel Kinnaman), the leader of Task Force X. The team also includes Harley Quinn (Margot Robbie), a former psychiatrist who was driven insane by her abusive relationship with the Joker; Captain Boomerang (Jai Courtney), an Australian mercenary; El Diablo (Jay Hernandez), a Mexican pyromaniac; and Killer Croc (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje), a humanoid crocodile.

The team is tasked with stopping a terrorist named Enchantress (Cara Delevingne) who has stolen the magical artifact known as the "Mother Box." The Enchantress plans to use the Mother Box to destroy the world. However, things don't go according to plan, and the team soon discovers that the Enchantress is not what they expected.

As the mission progresses, the team faces numerous challenges, including a confrontation with the Joker (Jared Leto), who has escaped from Arkham Asylum and is seeking revenge against Harley Quinn. The Joker's presence causes tension among the team members, particularly between Deadshot and Harley Quinn.

Throughout the movie, the characters' backstories are slowly revealed, adding depth to their personalities and motivations. For example, it is shown that Rick Flag was once a soldier who lost his wife in combat, leading him to become a mercenary. Similarly, El Diablo's pyromania is revealed to be a result of his abusive childhood.

In the climactic final battle, the team faces off against the Enchantress and her minions. The Joker also makes an appearance, causing chaos and destruction throughout the city. In the end, the team manages to defeat the Enchantress and destroy the Mother Box, saving the world from destruction.

However, the movie ends on a bittersweet note as Harley Quinn is left alone, still struggling with her mental health issues. The Joker's fate is also left uncertain, leaving room for speculation about his future appearances in the DC Extended Universe.

Overall, Suicide Squad received mixed reviews from critics but was a commercial success, grossing over $745 million worldwide. Despite its flaws, the movie introduced several new characters to the DC Extended Universe and set the stage for future films featuring the team.

title: Wonder Woman
tagline: Power. Grace. Wisdom. Wonder.
overview: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.
plot:
Wonder Woman is a 2017 superhero film directed by Patty Jenkins, produced by Charles Roven, Deborah Snyder, and Donna Simpson, and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The film begins with Diana Prince (Gal Gadot) as a young girl growing up on Themyscira, an island inhabited by the Amazons, a tribe of warrior women. Diana's mother, Queen Hippolyta (Connie Nielsen), is the ruler of the Amazons and trains her daughter in combat and wisdom.

As Diana grows older, she begins to question the traditional ways of her people and longs for adventure beyond their shores. She discovers a plane that has crashed on Themyscira, carrying Steve Trevor (Chris Pine), an American pilot who has been rescued by the Amazons.

Steve tells Hippolyta about the war between Germany and the Allies during World War I, which is ongoing in the outside world. Diana decides to accompany Steve back to the world of men, where she hopes to find a way to stop the war and bring peace to the people.

Upon arrival in No Man's Land, Diana meets Steve and together they try to escape the battlefield. However, they are soon captured by German forces led by General Erich Ludendorff (Danny Huston) and Doctor Maru (Elena Anaya), who is revealed to be a skilled Amazonian warrior.

Diana uses her combat skills to fight off the German soldiers, but she is eventually taken prisoner. Steve manages to escape and returns to Diana's cell, where he finds her being held captive by Ludendorff.

As Diana tries to escape from her captors, she discovers that Doctor Maru has been experimenting on herself using a magical artifact known as the Lasso of Truth. The Lasso forces people to tell the truth, but it also slowly drives them mad.

Diana and Steve hatch a plan to stop Ludendorff's plans for an Amazonian army to be used in the war effort. They infiltrate Ludendorff's headquarters, where Diana confronts Maru and breaks her free from the Lasso's control.

In the final battle, Diana faces off against Ludendorff and his forces. She uses her combat skills and the magic of the Lasso to defeat them, saving Steve and stopping the war.

As the war comes to an end, Diana returns to Themyscira, where she is welcomed back as a hero. However, she realizes that there is more to being a warrior than just fighting, and she begins to question her own identity and purpose.

The film ends with Diana standing on the beach, looking out at the sea, symbolizing her newfound sense of self and her commitment to using her powers for good in the world beyond Themyscira.

title: Aquaman
tagline: Home Is Calling
overview: Once home to the most advanced civilization on Earth, Atlantis is now an underwater kingdom ruled by the power-hungry King Orm. With a vast army at his disposal, Orm plans to conquer the remaining oceanic people and then the surface world. Standing in his way is Arthur Curry, Orm's half-human, half-Atlantean brother and true heir to the throne.
plot:
Aquaman is a 2018 superhero film directed by James Wan and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures. The movie follows the story of Arthur Curry, also known as Aquaman, played by Jason Momoa.

The film begins with a prologue that shows the origin story of Atlantis, an underwater kingdom ruled by King Orm (Patrick Wilson), who seeks to conquer the surface world and destroy it in order to save his own people from the pollution and destruction caused by humans. The prologue also introduces Arthur Curry, the half-human, half-Atlantean son of Queen Atlanna (Nicole Kidman) and King Conan (Willem Dafoe).

The story then shifts to the present day, where Arthur is living on land with his mother, who has been keeping his true identity a secret. However, when his half-brother Orm becomes king of Atlantis, he orders the destruction of the surface world in order to save his people.

Arthur's life is turned upside down when he discovers that he is the rightful heir to the throne of Atlantis and that he has the ability to communicate with and control marine life. He also learns that his half-brother Orm is planning to attack the surface world, which would lead to the destruction of both worlds.

As Arthur navigates his new identity as a king, he must confront his own demons and learn to accept his true heritage. Along the way, he meets Mera (Amber Heard), the princess of Xebel, who becomes his ally and love interest.

The plot thickens when Orm orders the destruction of the surface world, which leads Arthur to team up with Mera and a group of allies, including Vulko (Willem Dafoe) and Lobo (Sylvester Stallone), to stop him. Along the way, they encounter various sea creatures, including the giant octopus Black Manta (Yul Vazquez).

As the battle between Arthur and Orm reaches its climax, Arthur must confront his own identity and learn to accept his true power as a king. In the end, he emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices.

The movie ends with Arthur becoming the new king of Atlantis, with Mera by his side. The film concludes on a hopeful note, suggesting that Arthur will work to rebuild and protect both worlds.

Throughout the film, Wan explores themes of identity, power, and responsibility, as well as the consequences of playing with forces beyond one's control. The movie also features impressive action sequences, stunning visual effects, and a talented cast.

Overall, Aquaman is an exciting and visually stunning superhero film that brings a fresh perspective to the DC Extended Universe.

SpongeBob and Patrick's attempts to spread Christmas cheer are thwarted by Mr. Krabs' greed, but they eventually come up with a plan to teach him the true meaning of Christmas. In the end, Mr. Krabs learns that Christmas is about giving and sharing with others, not just making money.

The special features the voice talents of Tom Kenny as SpongeBob SquarePants, Bill Fagerbakke as Patrick Star, Clancy Brown as Mr. Krabs, and Rodger Bumpass as Squidward Tentacles. The story is a heartwarming tale about the importance of kindness, generosity, and friendship during the holiday season.

It's a SpongeBob Christmas was well-received by audiences and critics alike, and it has become a beloved holiday tradition for fans of the show.

title: Dragons: Dawn Of The Dragon Racers
original_title: Dragons: Dawn Of The Dragon Racers
overview: A hunt for a lost sheep turns into a competition between Hiccup and friends as they compete to become the first Dragon Racing champion of Berk.
plot:
Dawn of the Dragon Racers, also known as Dragons: Dawn of the Dragon Racers, is a 2014 American computer-animated short film produced by DreamWorks Animation and directed by Elaine Bogan and John Sanford. Based on the How to Train Your Dragon franchise, it features the voices of Jay Baruchel as Hiccup and America Ferrera as Astrid, alongside cast members of the television series. Set before How to Train Your Dragon 2, it explains the origin of dragon racing.

As the dragon riders of Berk prepare for the island's official Dragon Race, Snotlout boasts that he invented the sport. Hiccup and Astrid dispute this, and the friends recall how dragon racing began. Years earlier, when the riders were younger, the village was preparing for its traditional annual regatta when a flock of sheep stampeded through the streets, frightened by the voice of Silent Sven. Rounding up the animals turns into an impromptu competition among the young riders and their dragons. Before leaving to gather wood, Chief Stoick puts Hiccup in charge of the regatta preparations.

Hiccup tries to forbid the sheep-catching game, but the others ignore him, and the villagers find it far more exciting than the regatta. Under pressure from the crowd, Hiccup reluctantly allows another race. The riders form two teams: Snotlout and the twins, Ruffnut and Tuffnut, against Hiccup and Astrid. Fishlegs refuses to join, devoted to the regatta. During the race, Astrid injures her arm in a collision with Snotlout while chasing a prized black sheep. Fishlegs finally changes his mind when his boat sinks after his dragon, Meatlug, becomes seasick and spits lava.

Stoick returns and, rather than punishing Hiccup for disobeying, allows the contest to continue, provided it has proper rules: each white sheep is worth one point and the black sheep five, and the winners will have their portrait hung in the Great Hall. The race is tied until the twins appear with a black sheep and claim victory, but Fishlegs then arrives with the real black sheep, revealing that the other team had painted an ordinary sheep. The victory is awarded to Hiccup and Fishlegs, the first dragon racing champions. Back in the present, Hiccup concludes that Tuffnut, who devised the rules, really invented the sport, and the riders rush off to race.

title: Jigsaw
tagline: A new game begins.
overview: Dead bodies begin to turn up all over the city, each meeting their demise in a variety of grisly ways. All investigations begin to point the finger at deceased killer John Kramer.
plot:
Jigsaw is a 2017 American psychological horror film directed by the Spierig Brothers and written by Josh Stolberg and Peter Goldfinger. The movie serves as a sequel to the Saw franchise, ignoring the events of the previous films.

The story begins with Evelyn Johnson (Hannah Emily Anderson), the daughter of John Kramer's (Tobin Bell) former apprentice, who is now an old man living in a nursing home. Evelyn has been searching for her father and his legacy, hoping to understand why he was so obsessed with testing people's will to live.

Evelyn discovers that she is the target of Jigsaw's next game, which is designed to test her own will to survive. She receives a mysterious phone call from Jigsaw, who reveals that he has been watching her and knows about her father's past. Jigsaw claims that Evelyn must prove herself worthy to carry on his legacy by completing three challenges.

The first challenge takes Evelyn to an abandoned warehouse, where she finds a series of puzzles and traps designed to test her physical and mental limits. As she navigates the warehouse, Evelyn is forced to confront her own mortality and the consequences of her father's actions.

As Evelyn progresses through the game, she begins to uncover more about Jigsaw's motivations and the true nature of his tests. She also meets a new character, Logan (Matt Passmore), who becomes her ally in the game.

The second challenge takes Evelyn to a hospital, where she must navigate a series of medical puzzles and confront her own fears and weaknesses. Meanwhile, Logan is revealed to be working for a mysterious organization that seeks to exploit Jigsaw's technology for their own gain.

The final challenge takes Evelyn to an abandoned asylum, where she must face off against a group of ruthless mercenaries who are also seeking to claim Jigsaw's legacy for themselves. In the end, Evelyn emerges victorious, but not without scars and a newfound understanding of her father's complex legacy.

Throughout the movie, the Spierig Brothers explore themes of grief, redemption, and the consequences of playing god. The film features plenty of twists and turns, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats as they try to piece together the puzzle alongside Evelyn.

Overall, Jigsaw is a tense and thought-provoking thriller that expands on the Saw franchise while maintaining its signature style and suspense.

title: The Dressmaker
tagline: Revenge is back in fashion
overview: In 1950s Australia, beautiful, talented dressmaker Tilly returns to her tiny hometown to right wrongs from her past. As she tries to reconcile with her mother, she starts to fall in love while transforming the fashion of the town.
plot:
In 1926, in the fictitious outback town of Dungatar, State of Victoria, 10-year-old schoolgirl Myrtle Dunnage is blamed for the death of classmate Stewart Pettyman. A sympathetic policeman, Sergeant Horatio Farrat, sends her away. Twenty-five years later, Myrtle, now a couturier-trained dressmaker using the name "Tilly", returns to Dungatar. She remembers nothing of Stewart's death, and her mentally ill mother Molly, living in squalor, does not even remember her.
At the local football final game, the Dungatar players are distracted by Tilly's red couture dress. Teddy McSwiney, one of the players for Dungatar, points this out; Tilly changes into an equally alluring black outfit before the last quarter. When the teams swap ends of the field, the men from Winyerp are the distracted ones, and Dungatar wins.
Tilly agrees to make a dress for Gertrude Pratt for the upcoming footballers dance, in exchange for the truth. Gertrude reveals that she told Stewart where Tilly was hiding that day. At the dance, a transformed Gertrude captures the attention of William Beaumont, and they later become engaged. Impressed, the town's women commission extravagant dresses from Tilly, and Teddy pursues a romantic relationship with her.
Sergeant Farrat confesses to Tilly that Stewart's father Evan, a town councillor, blackmailed him for secretly being a cross-dresser. Tilly and Farrat bond over their shared passion for designer clothing. Evan recruits incompetent Una Pleasance to start a rival dressmaking service, but when Gertrude hires Tilly to create her wedding dress, the townspeople return to Tilly.
Bribed with a boa, Farrat lets Tilly read the witness statement given by her former schoolteacher, Beulah Harridiene. She confronts Beulah, who admits that she was not even there. Tilly tells Farrat this at Gertrude's wedding reception, but he remains reluctantly convinced that she killed Stewart. Everyone else had an alibi. He also reveals that Evan is Tilly's father. Tilly runs away, and Teddy follows after soothing his developmentally disabled brother, Barney, who screams hysterically that Tilly "moved" when Stewart died.
At the schoolhouse, Teddy helps Tilly remember how Stewart died. He had threatened to murder her mother if she did not stand against a wall. Stewart charged head-down at her, but she moved aside, so he broke his neck. Barney witnessed this from the town silo, but was afraid people would think he was lying.
Tilly and Teddy make love in his caravan and plan to marry. They sit atop the silo, and Teddy shows that he does not believe in her curse by jumping inside. He sinks into sorghum grain and asphyxiates. Molly tells the townswomen that Teddy died trying to prove that his love was stronger than their hate. Molly tends to the grieving Tilly, and tells her that Evan had Tilly sent away to hurt Molly. She encourages Tilly to use her art against the townspeople. Molly suffers a stroke and dies.

title: All Roads Lead to Rome
tagline: Sometimes first love deserves a second chance...
overview: Maggie is an uptight, single mother and college writing teacher from New York City. In an effort to reconnect with her troubled teen daughter Summer, she decides to embark on a journey to a Tuscan village where she frequented in her younger days. Upon arrival, Maggie runs into Luca a handsome former lover who is still a bachelor and lives with his eighty-year-old mother Carmen. Summer (missing her “bad boy” boyfriend in NYC) and Carmen (secretly planning a wedding against Luca’s wishes to MARCELINO, her one true love in Rome) impulsively steal Luca’s car and race off to Rome. Maggie and Luca quickly pursue allowing the two mismatched couples to spend some time together and develop a new understanding of each other.
plot:
All Roads Lead to Rome is a 2015 romantic comedy directed by Ella Lemhagen and written by Josh Appignanesi and Cindy Myers. Sarah Jessica Parker stars as Maggie Falk, an American journalist revisiting Italy with her rebellious teenage daughter, Summer (Rosie Day), alongside Raoul Bova as her former love, Luca, Claudia Cardinale as Luca's mother, Carmen, Paz Vega as Giulia, a television reporter and Luca's one-time love interest, Nadir Caselli as Luca's daughter, Valentina, and Marco Bonini as Inspector Moravia.

Maggie takes Summer to the Tuscan town where she spent part of her youth. There she runs into Luca, with whom she had a passionate romance decades earlier before she suddenly left for America and cut off all contact. Luca, who still has feelings for her, sets out to win her back. Summer, meanwhile, is desperate to return to the United States and to her selfish boyfriend, Tyler, who wants her to take the blame for a recent drug charge on the grounds that, as a minor, she would receive a lighter sentence. Luca's mother, Carmen, has her own plans: she has been exchanging love letters with Marcellino, her sweetheart from a 1960s pop band, and wants to marry him.

When Carmen and Summer steal Luca's car and race toward Rome, where Carmen and Marcellino have arranged a secret wedding in a church, chaos follows. Summer initially intends to catch a flight home from the Rome airport, but seeing Carmen's devotion makes her realize that Tyler is using her, and she unexpectedly falls for a farm girl, Ermenegilda. Maggie and Luca chase after them, bickering about their shared past along the way, and gradually rekindle their romance as they head for Rome.

Filming began in Rome on October 20, 2014. Marcellino is played by Shel Shapiro, who in real life was a member of the 1960s Italian pop group The Rokes, and Ermenegilda by Rocío Muñoz, the real-life partner of Bova. The film received a limited release in international markets, earning about $524,000, and Momentum Pictures released it on video on demand in North America in March 2016.

title: Cabin Fever
tagline: You can't run from what's inside.
overview: In this grisly remake of the 2002 horror hit, five college chums rent an isolated woodland cabin for a party. But their fun quickly ends when the group is exposed to a hideous flesh-eating virus, and survival becomes the name of the game.
plot:
Cabin Fever (2016) is a horror-comedy film that explores several themes, including social isolation, paranoia, and the breakdown of human relationships under pressure.

The movie takes place in a remote cabin where a group of friends, all with different personalities and quirks, are brought together by their mutual desire for a relaxing getaway. However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that each character has their own secrets and insecurities, which slowly start to surface, leading to a descent into chaos.

As the characters' behavior becomes increasingly erratic and paranoid, the film highlights the dangers of unchecked emotions and the devastating consequences of allowing personal demons to consume one's relationships. The movie also touches on the theme of social hierarchy, as the characters' initial camaraderie gives way to a struggle for dominance and power.

Throughout the film, the tension builds as the characters' behavior becomes more erratic, leading to a climax that is both shocking and thought-provoking. Ultimately, Cabin Fever (2016) is a commentary on how quickly social norms can break down in the face of adversity, revealing the darker aspects of human nature.

The film's tone is often described as darkly comedic, with a touch of satire, which adds to its unique charm and makes it a standout in the horror-comedy genre.

title: The Gallows
tagline: Every School Has Its Spirit.
overview: 20 years after a horrific accident during a small town school play, students at the school resurrect the failed show in a misguided attempt to honor the anniversary of the tragedy - but soon discover that some things are better left alone.
plot:
The Gallows is a 2015 American supernatural horror film in the found-footage style, written and directed by Chris Lofing and Travis Cluff. Reese Mishler, Pfeifer Brown, Ryan Shoos and Cassidy Gifford play high school students who revive a play twenty years after a fatal accident during its first staging. Jason Blum produced the film through Blumhouse Productions.

On October 29, 1993, Charlie Grimille, a student at Beatrice High School, is accidentally hanged when a prop fails during a performance of the play The Gallows, in front of his parents and the whole audience. Twenty years later, the school decides to stage the play again. Reese Houser, a football player, auditions only to get closer to Pfeifer Ross, on whom he has a crush, and unexpectedly lands the lead. Wanting out, he goes along with his friend Ryan's plan to wreck the set, and that night Reese, Ryan and Ryan's girlfriend Cassidy break into the school. Interrupted by Pfeifer, the four discover that they are locked in and have no phone signal. Cassidy confesses why they are there, angering Pfeifer.

Back on stage, they find the set has rebuilt itself, and an old television plays news footage of Charlie's death, including an interview with his girlfriend Alexis. They learn that Charlie had only gone on as an understudy, replacing the lead actor, Reese's father Rick. The group splits up, and Ryan stumbles on a hidden room and a hanging body. Cassidy is hoisted into the air by an invisible force and left with marks like rope burns. Trying to escape through an air duct, Ryan is thrown from a ladder and breaks his leg, and when the others return they find only his phone, whose footage shows him being dragged away by the neck. Cassidy is then killed by Charlie, dressed as the Hangman from the play. On the stage, the spirit begins to strangle Pfeifer, and Reese realises that Charlie wants them to perform the final scene. When Reese puts the noose around his neck, Charlie hangs him. Pfeifer and an adult Charlie take a bow as Alexis applauds. Police later visit the home of Pfeifer and Alexis, revealing that Pfeifer is Charlie and Alexis's daughter; when the officers mention Charlie's name, they are killed.

Lofing and Cluff's trailer went viral in 2011, attracting the producers who brought the project to Blumhouse. Made for just $100,000, it grossed $43 million worldwide, but critics panned it, with 15% on Rotten Tomatoes and a C CinemaScore.

title: Drumline: A New Beat
tagline: #PassTheBaton
overview: A girl from New York attends a college in Atlanta to join their once-famous marching band.
plot:
Drumline: A New Beat is a 2014 American musical drama television film directed by Bille Woodruff from a screenplay by Karen Gist and Regina Hicks. A sequel to the 2002 film Drumline, it returns to the fictional Atlanta A&T University and its marching band, telling a largely new story about a fresh generation of drummers at the historically black college. Alexandra Shipp stars as Danielle "Dani" Raymond, with Jordan Calloway as Jayven LaPierre, Jeff Pierre as her cousin Tyree, Mario Van Peebles and Lisa Arrindell as her parents, LeToya Luckett as Dr. Nia Phillips, DeRay Davis, Jasmine Burke, Rome Flynn and Tye White. Leonard Roberts reprises his role as Sean Taylor, and Nick Cannon, who also executive produced, returns as Devon Miles.

Twelve years after the first film, Dani, a drummer from a wealthy Brooklyn family, defies her parents, who want her to attend Spelman, and heads to Atlanta A&T on a partial scholarship, determined to help revive the Panthers' once-celebrated drumline and to become the first woman to lead its section. Her cousin Tyree is a senior on the line, but the new band director, Sean Taylor, gives her no special treatment. As a freshman she endures hazing from upperclassmen, a rule against romance within the band, and open resistance from a drummer who says no woman belongs on the line, while she falls in with a group of misfits and is drawn to Jayven, a charming bandmate and rival with a troubled past whose father is a well-known singer.

The Panthers' long rivalry with Southern State provides the competition, with drumline face-offs staged at football games. Dissension within the band and challenges for places on the line drive Dani and Jayven apart, and at one point she moves to transfer away from the school before returning. Devon Miles, now a music star, arrives to show the young drummers that he still has the touch, and at the Big Southern Classic A&T wins for the first time in six years, then triumphs again in a final drumline battle as Dani and Jayven reconcile.

Filmed in Atlanta in May 2014, the film premiered on VH1 on 27 October 2014 and was released on DVD in March 2015. Reviews were largely unfavorable: Blavity's Shadow and Act called it overlong and overstuffed, with hammy acting and too little drumming, while other viewers enjoyed it as a predictable but nostalgic return to the world of the original.

plot:
Avengers: Endgame is a 2019 superhero film directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and produced by Marvel Studios. The movie serves as the culmination of a decade-long story arc in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

The film takes place after the events of Avengers: Infinity War, where Thanos (Josh Brolin) has collected all six Infinity Stones and wiped out half of all life in the universe with a mere snap of his fingers. The remaining Avengers, led by Tony Stark/Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.), Steve Rogers/Captain America (Chris Evans), Bruce Banner/Hulk (Mark Ruffalo), Thor (Chris Hemsworth), and Natasha Romanoff/Black Widow (Scarlett Johansson), are left to mourn the loss of their friends and allies.

The team embarks on a perilous journey through time, visiting key moments in their pasts to collect the stones. Along the way, they encounter alternate versions of themselves from different timelines, including an older Tony Stark who has become a mad scientist, and a younger Steve Rogers who is struggling with his own identity.

As the Avengers gather the stones, they also face numerous challenges and obstacles, including Thanos' army and their own personal demons. The film's climax features an epic battle between the Avengers and Thanos, which ultimately leads to the restoration of balance in the universe.

Throughout the film, the characters grapple with the consequences of their actions and the weight of their responsibilities as heroes. Tony Stark, in particular, comes to terms with his own mortality and the legacy he leaves behind for his daughter, Morgan.

Avengers: Endgame is a emotionally charged and visually stunning conclusion to the Infinity Saga, which has become one of the most beloved and successful franchises in cinematic history. The film's themes of sacrifice, friendship, and redemption make it a must-see for fans of the MCU.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
tagline: An entire universe. Once and for all.
overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
plot:
Avengers: Infinity War is a 2018 superhero film directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, produced by Marvel Studios, and based on the Marvel Comics series of the same name. The movie brings together a vast ensemble cast of characters from the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) to fight against an intergalactic threat.

The story begins with Thanos (Josh Brolin), a powerful Titan who seeks to collect all six Infinity Stones, which would grant him unimaginable power and allow him to wipe out half of all life in the universe. The Avengers, led by Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.), Captain America (Chris Evans), Thor (Chris Hemsworth), Hulk (Mark Ruffalo), Black Widow (Scarlett Johansson), and Hawkeye (Jeremy Renner), are alerted to Thanos' plan and band together to stop him.

Meanwhile, the Guardians of the Galaxy, consisting of Peter Quill (Chris Pratt), Gamora (Zoe Saldana), Drax (Dave Bautista), Rocket Raccoon (Bradley Cooper), and Groot (Vin Diesel), also become entangled in Thanos' quest. The two groups eventually join forces to take down Thanos.

As the battle against Thanos intensifies, the Avengers and their allies face numerous challenges, including Thanos' army of Black Order warriors, the Chitauri, and other formidable foes. Along the way, characters like Doctor Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch), Spider-Man (Tom Holland), and Black Panther (Chadwick Boseman) also make appearances.

Throughout the film, Thanos' motivations are explored, revealing a tragic backstory that drives his desire to collect the Infinity Stones. The movie's climax features an epic showdown between the Avengers and Thanos, resulting in a devastating conclusion that sets the stage for the events of Avengers: Endgame.

One of the standout aspects of Avengers: Infinity War is its ability to balance individual character arcs with the larger narrative. The film expertly weaves together multiple storylines, creating a sense of urgency and stakes that propels the audience towards the movie's shocking conclusion.

Overall, Avengers: Infinity War is a masterclass in ensemble storytelling, featuring an impressive cast of characters and a narrative that is both action-packed and emotionally resonant.

title: Captain Marvel
tagline: Higher. Further. Faster.
overview: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
plot:
Captain Marvel is a 2019 superhero film produced by Marvel Studios and directed by Anna Boden and Ryan Fleck. The movie follows the story of Carol Danvers, an Air Force pilot who becomes one of the most powerful heroes in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

The film begins with Carol Danvers (played by Brie Larson) as a young Air Force pilot during the 1990s. She is part of a secret government program called S.H.I.E.L.D., which is experimenting with the power of Kree technology, an alien energy source that enhances human abilities. During a mission to rescue a group of hostages from an alien ship, Carol's plane is attacked by the Kree, and she is exposed to the energy.

The attack leaves Carol severely injured, but also imbues her with incredible powers, including superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. She becomes one of the most powerful beings in the universe, capable of flying and wielding energy blasts.

As Carol awakens from her coma, she discovers that she has become a superhero known as Captain Marvel. She is recruited by Nick Fury (played by Samuel L. Jackson), who reveals to her that she is not human but rather an alien hybrid, the result of a Kree-human experiment.

Carol soon learns that the Kree have been at war with the Skrulls, another alien species, for centuries. The Skrulls, led by Talos (played by Ben Mendelsohn), are seeking to invade Earth and assimilate its inhabitants into their own species. Nick Fury reveals that Carol's powers make her a key player in the battle against the Skrulls.

title: The Atticus Institute
tagline: The only case of possession confirmed by the U.S. Government.
overview: In the early 1970s, Dr. Henry West creates an institute to find people with supernatural abilities. When Judith Winstead comes to the facility, she exhibits amazing abilities that the military wants to turn into a weapon.
plot:
The Atticus Institute is a 2015 American independent horror film written and directed by Chris Sparling. Presented as a pseudo-documentary, it concerns a paranormal research institute that becomes home to what is described as the only case of demonic possession ever confirmed by the United States government. It stars William Mapother as the institute's founder, Dr. Henry West, and Rya Kihlstedt as his subject, Judith Winstead.

The story unfolds through footage intercut with interviews. In the early 1970s, West founds the Atticus Institute in rural Pennsylvania in the hope of proving that psychic abilities such as extrasensory perception are real, but every subject who appears to possess such powers proves to be a fraud. The demoralized team's fortunes change when Judith is brought in by her sister Margaret, who is troubled by her disturbing behavior. Judith easily masters every test, and increasingly demanding experiments reveal abilities far greater than anyone expected. As her powers grow, her behavior becomes more unstable; strange events afflict the staff and their families, and many aides resign.

Seeking help, the team turns to the U.S. military, whose advisers devise tests that draw out new abilities, including telekinesis and pyrokinesis. When a spectral photography experiment triggers a violent reaction, the images show a cloud-like entity briefly leaving Judith's body, and the researchers realize that she is possessed by a demon. Citing national security, the military takes over the institute, hoping to turn the demon into a weapon against the Soviet Union during the Cold War, and subjects Judith to increasingly inhumane experiments, including electroshock, over West's objections. When attempts to make the entity locate enemy bases fail, the military stages an exorcism with a soldier wired to Judith. The procedure goes wrong: Judith gravely injures the priest, and a blast of force knocks out everyone present. When the cameras come back on, Judith is herself again, but the demon has taken over West's body. He kills her by telekinetically bursting her heart and walks out. Closing notes state that Judith was buried in an undisclosed location and that West, who vanished on October 23, 1976, was declared legally dead in 1982.

The film was released on January 23, 2015, and was poorly received; critics praised its found-footage documentary format but faulted its pacing and lack of originality, and it holds 50% on Rotten Tomatoes from six reviews.

The 5th Wave is a science fiction film directed by Neill Blomkamp, released in 2016. The movie is based on the novel of the same name by Rick Yancey.

In the near future, an alien invasion has devastated Earth, and the extraterrestrial beings, known as "The Others," have begun to abduct humans, leaving behind a trail of destruction and chaos. The story follows Cassie Sullivan (Chloe Moretz), a 16-year-old girl who is trying to survive in this new world.

Cassie's life takes a dramatic turn when she witnesses the abduction of her brother, Sam (Harris Dickinson). She soon discovers that the Others are not just random abductors but are actually targeting specific individuals with unique skills and abilities. Cassie learns that she has been chosen as one of the "Five," a group of children who possess special talents that will help humanity fight back against The Others.

The movie begins with Cassie's life in a post-apocalyptic world, where she is forced to live on her own after her mother's death. She meets Evan Walker (Alex Roe), a mysterious and handsome young man who claims to be one of the "Five." As they spend more time together, Cassie starts to develop feelings for Evan, but their relationship is complicated by the danger that surrounds them.

The plot thickens as Cassie discovers that The Others are not just mindless abductors but are actually using the children to harvest a powerful energy source. The aliens have created a device that can harness the energy of human brains, and they need the "Five" to activate it.

As Cassie and Evan try to evade The Others, they embark on a perilous journey across the country. Along the way, they encounter other survivors who possess unique skills, including Marcus (Patton Oswalt), a genius hacker, and Bishop (Ludacris), a former soldier with exceptional combat skills.

The movie's climax features an intense battle between Cassie and The Others as she tries to activate the device that will help humanity fight back. In the process, Evan sacrifices himself to save Cassie, leaving her heartbroken but determined to continue the fight.

In the end, Cassie manages to activate the device, which sends a signal to the remaining survivors, allowing them to launch a counterattack against The Others. The movie concludes with Cassie standing alone, ready to face whatever challenges lie ahead in the fight for humanity's survival.

Overall, The 5th Wave is an action-packed sci-fi thriller that explores themes of survival, sacrifice, and the power of human connection in the face of overwhelming odds.

In the end, Tiberius and Yang Jin emerge victorious, having successfully defeated Böri Khan and saved Emperor Xiaowen's life. The movie concludes with a sense of closure, as Tiberius and Yang Jin part ways, but not before sharing a heartfelt goodbye.

Overall, Dragon Blade is an entertaining and visually stunning film that combines elements of history, action, and adventure. While it may not be perfect, it is a fun and thrilling ride that is sure to delight fans of epic historical dramas.

title: Capture the Flag
overview: When the brave and determined 12-year-old Mike Goldwing discovers that an eccentric billionaire plans to fly to the moon, steal its vast, valuable natural resources, and destroy the American flag planted by the Apollo XI astronauts during man's historic moon landing, the countdown to a spectacular adventure begins! plot:
Capture the Flag (Spanish: Atrapa la bandera) is a 2015 Spanish computer-animated science fiction adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and written by Patxi Amezcua. Produced by 4 Cats Pictures and animated by Lightbox Entertainment, it was distributed worldwide by Paramount Pictures, a milestone for Spanish animation following the studio's earlier deal for Gato's Tad the Lost Explorer. The Spanish voice cast includes Carme Calvell, Michelle Jenner, Javier Balas and Dani Rovira. It was released in Spain on 28 August 2015.

Twelve-year-old Mike Goldwing comes from a family of NASA astronauts. His grandfather Frank has been estranged from the family for years, embittered at having lost his chance to travel to the Moon on the Apollo 11 mission. Richard Carson III, a megalomaniac Texan billionaire, wants to claim ownership of the Moon in order to mine its rich reserves of Helium-3. To support his claim, he spreads the conspiracy theory that the 1969 Moon landing was faked in a studio, and plans to travel to the Moon himself to destroy the only physical proof: the American flag planted by the Apollo 11 astronauts.

The President of the United States orders NASA to mount a new lunar mission to stop him, with Frank recalled as commander, while Carson hires a saboteur to derail the launch. Mike decides to stow away on the mission to win his grandfather's respect. With his friends Marty and Amy and Marty's pet iguana, Igor, he sneaks into the Kennedy Space Center, where Marty is caught after an encounter with alligators in the surrounding marshes. When Carson's agent triggers the rocket's launch ahead of schedule, Mike, Amy, Igor and Frank blast off for the Moon with Carson in pursuit. On the lunar surface, they race to secure the flag and expose the billionaire's scheme to the world, while Mike and Frank rebuild their relationship and Frank finally realizes his dream of walking on the Moon.

Capture the Flag was well received in Spain, where it won the Goya Award for Best Animated Film, but reviews elsewhere were mixed, with a 46 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Variety called it solid family entertainment, while noting that it did not match the standards of the leading Hollywood animation studios.

title: Annihilation

overview: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
plot:
Annihilation is a 2018 American science fiction film directed by Alex Garland, based on the novel of the same name by Jeff VanderMeer. The movie stars Natalie Portman, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Tessa Thompson, and Oscar Isaac.

The story begins with a prologue that shows a catastrophic event known as "the Shimmer," which has been occurring for decades in an area of the United States where the laws of nature do not apply. The Shimmer is a mysterious, alien-infused zone that seems to be alive and constantly changing.

The main character, Lena (Natalie Portman), is a biologist who has lost her husband, Kane, to the Shimmer during one of his expeditions into the area. Lena joins an all-female team, led by Dr. Ventress (Jennifer Jason Leigh), to explore the Shimmer and uncover its secrets.

As they venture deeper into the Shimmer, the team encounters strange and terrifying creatures that defy explanation. They also discover that the Shimmer is not just a physical environment but also a psychological one, where the laws of reality are constantly shifting.

The team's journey takes them through different biomes within the Shimmer, each with its own unique characteristics and dangers. Along the way, they encounter other survivors who have been affected by the Shimmer in different ways, including a mysterious figure known as "the Biologist" (Tessa Thompson).

As Lena delves deeper into the Shimmer, she begins to experience strange visions and hallucinations that blur the lines between reality and fantasy. She also discovers that her husband's body has undergone a transformation, becoming one with the Shimmer.

The team eventually reaches the heart of the Shimmer, where they discover a mysterious structure known as "the Lighthouse." Inside the Lighthouse, Lena encounters a figure who claims to be the Biologist, but it becomes clear that this is not the same person she encountered earlier.

In the end, Lena emerges from the Shimmer with no memory of her past or her identity. She has become one with the alien entity that inhabits the Shimmer, and her body has undergone a transformation that blurs the lines between human and non-human.

The film ends with Lena walking away from the camera, into an unknown future, as the Shimmer continues to expand and change around her. The ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to wonder what happened to Lena and whether she will ever be able to return to her old life.

Overall, Annihilation is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of identity, self-destruction, and the unknown. It challenges the viewer to consider the consequences of playing with forces beyond human control and the dangers of delving too deep into the mysteries of the universe.

However, things take a turn for the worse when Rocky discovers that Mr. Gray has been waiting for them all along. Despite being blind, Mr. Gray uses his other senses to track down the intruders and set up an elaborate trap.

As the night progresses, the group finds themselves in a desperate fight for survival. Bo is killed by Mr. Gray's booby traps, while Manco is severely injured. Rocky manages to escape with his life but not without realizing that he has underestimated Mr. Gray's abilities.

Throughout the movie, Alvarez uses tension and suspense to create a sense of unease in the audience. The film's score, composed by Tom Spezialy, adds to the tension, creating an atmosphere of dread and fear.

In the end, Rocky manages to outsmart Mr. Gray and escape from his house. However, he is left with a newfound respect for the old man and a realization that some people are capable of more than we think. The movie ends on a somber note, leaving the audience to ponder the true nature of Mr. Gray's abilities and the consequences of underestimating others.

Overall, Don't Breathe is a tense and suspenseful horror-thriller that explores themes of vulnerability, trust, and the power of the human mind. The film features strong performances from its cast, particularly Daniel Radcliffe, who brings depth and nuance to his character.
